title: Google Ads Strategist - Home Service Businesses (EST, Full Time)
description:
If you cannot commit to working EST hours, do not apply. THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY ROLE.



Sustain Media is a local SEO and Google Ads agency built only for home service businesses. Roofers,

plumbers, HVAC companies, electricians, landscapers, restoration companies, and auto shops. Most of

our clients are owner-operated businesses doing $2M to $10M a year. Our job is simple: more calls and

more booked jobs. Ultimately, every metric has to connect back to qualified leads, booked work, and

profitable growth.



We're hiring a Google Ads Strategist to join our paid media team.



What makes this role different



We use AI agents to handle a growing share of the repetitive work most agencies still do by hand,

including search term mining, campaign audits, performance diagnostics, and reporting data pulls. The

systems get better every month.



Right now, this role includes real implementation work. You'll build campaigns, write ads, make bid

changes, and manage accounts directly. We're moving quickly on AI systems, and over the next few

quarters the role should become increasingly focused on strategy rather than implementation.



That strategy includes understanding why a plumber in Portland needs a different structure than an

HVAC company in Fort Wayne, when to push budget into a seasonal spike, when to pull back, and how

to turn performance data into a growth plan for every account you run.



If you want the strategy-only version of this job on day one, this is not it. If you want to grow into it as the

systems mature, keep reading.



What you'll own



Your own book of clients. You'll own your accounts end to end, working alongside another PPC

specialist who manages a separate portfolio. You'll manage Google Ads across home service accounts

with different trades, markets, budgets, and growth goals. Each account needs its own strategy.



Lead generation. These campaigns exist to drive phone calls, form fills, and booked jobs. You need to

know how to build for that and measure it the way a business owner does: qualified lead volume,

acquisition cost, booked work, and return on spend, not clicks and impressions alone.



Tracking and attribution. A dashboard saying Google is working means nothing if the client's phone is

not ringing. You'll own conversion tracking on every account and know how to verify which campaigns

drive real calls, form fills, and booked jobs.



New account builds. When a client signs, you architect the account from zero, including keyword

research, campaign structure, ad copy, bidding, geo-targeting, conversion tracking, and launch.



Judgment calls. Our AI agent Viktor provides audits and diagnostics. You d
 what to do with them:

which bid strategy fits an account with 20 conversions a month versus 100, when PMax is supporting the

account, when it is obscuring poor lead quality or wasting spend, and when to restructure instead of

continuing to optimize around a flawed setup.



Landing pages and offers. You work with our development and SEO teams so ad traffic lands on pages

that convert. You guide the messaging and structure, but you do not build the pages.

Monthly reporting. Viktor pulls the data. You write the story, explain what changed, and lay out the plan

for the next month.



What success looks like



In your first 90 days, you'll take full ownership of a portfolio, confirm that tracking is trustworthy, identify

the largest performance opportunities, and establish a clear strategy for each account. Longer term,

success means improving qualified lead volume and booked-job economics while keeping clients

confident in the direction of their campaigns.



What we're looking for



Must-haves:

- Proven results running lead generation campaigns for local home service businesses

- Hands-on experience with Search, Performance Max, and Local Service Ads

- A strong understanding of conversion tracking. When a client says the leads are not coming in, 'the

dashboard looks fine' is not an answer. You know how to verify what is real.

- The ability to build an account from zero and defend every major choice you made

- The ability to read data and make strategic recommendations, not just report what a dashboard says

- Strong communication skills. You'll be in Slack daily.

Strong pluses:

- Strong attribution skills, including tracing ad spend through call tracking and offline conversions to

booked jobs

- Experience with CallRail or similar call-tracking platforms

- An understanding of how Google Business Profile and local SEO work together with paid search

- Agency experience managing multiple accounts at once

- Comfort working with AI tools. You do not need to build automations, but you should want to use

them.

The environment

- Remote, international team

- Contractor position, paid biweekly

- Base range: $1,500 to $2,000 USD per month depending on experience

- Revenue share: after a certain amount of time with a client, you will begin earning an ongoing

monthly share tied to how long that client stays with us. Realistically, this adds $200 to $500 per

month within your first year and keeps growing as your book matures. It is paid every month, for as

long as the client stays.



Daily tools: Google Ads, CallRail, Slack, Airtable, Google Sheets, and Viktor



You can work from anywhere in the world, but you work U.S. Eastern Time (EST) business hours.

This is a firm rule, not a preference. There is no time tracking, and there never will be, but the EST

schedule is non-negotiable. If you cannot commit to working EST hours, do not apply.



Our clients are month to month with no long-term contracts. We earn the business every 30 days,

which means the work has to be good.



Small senior team. You work directly with the founder and the operations team

title: Google Ads Strategist - Home Services
description:
Remote (Philippines) | Contract



Sustain Media is a local SEO and Google Ads agency built only for home service businesses: roofers, plumbers, HVAC companies, electricians, landscapers, restoration companies, and auto shops.



Most of our clients are owner-operated businesses doing $2M to $10M a year. Our job is simple: more calls and more booked jobs. Ultimately, every metric has to connect back to qualified leads, booked work, and profitable growth.



We’re hiring a Google Ads Strategist to join our paid media team.



What Makes This Role Different



We use AI agents to handle a growing share of the repetitive work most agencies still do by hand, including search term mining, campaign audits, performance diagnostics, and reporting data pulls. The systems get better every month.



Right now, this role includes real implementation work. You’ll build campaigns, write ads, make bid changes, and manage accounts directly. We’re moving quickly on AI systems, and over the next few quarters, the role should become increasingly focused on strategy rather than implementation.



That strategy includes understanding why a plumber in Portland needs a different structure than an HVAC company in Fort Wayne, when to push budget into a seasonal spike, when to pull back, and how to turn performance data into a growth plan for every account you run.



If you want the strategy-only version of this job on day one, this is not it. If you want to grow into it as the systems mature, keep reading.



What You’ll Own



Your own book of clients. You’ll own your accounts end to end, working alongside another PPC specialist who manages a separate portfolio. You’ll manage Google Ads across home service accounts with different trades, markets, budgets, and growth goals. Each account needs its own strategy.



Lead generation. These campaigns exist to drive phone calls, form fills, and booked jobs. You need to know how to build for that and measure it the way a business owner does: qualified lead volume, acquisition cost, booked work, and return on spend, not clicks and impressions alone.



Tracking and attribution. A dashboard saying Google is working means nothing if the client’s phone is not ringing. You’ll own conversion tracking on every account and know how to verify which campaigns drive real calls, form fills, and booked jobs.



New account builds. When a client signs, you architect the account from zero, including keyword research, campaign structure, ad copy, bidding, geo-targeting, conversion tracking, and launch.



Judgment calls. Our AI agent, Viktor, provides audits and diagnostics. You d
 what to do with them: which bid strategy fits an account with 20 conversions a month versus 100, when Performance Max is supporting the account, when it is obscuring poor lead quality or wasting spend, and when to restructure instead of continuing to optimize around a flawed setup.



Landing pages and offers. You work with our development and SEO teams so ad traffic lands on pages that convert. You guide the messaging and structure, but you do not build the pages.



Monthly reporting. Viktor pulls the data. You write the story, explain what changed, and lay out the plan for the next month.



What Success Looks Like



In your first 90 days, you’ll take full ownership of a portfolio, confirm that tracking is trustworthy, identify the largest performance opportunities, and establish a clear strategy for each account.



Longer term, success means improving qualified lead volume and booked-job economics while keeping clients confident in the direction of their campaigns.



What We’re Looking For



We care more about demonstrated results than years of experience, but this is not an entry-level role.



Must-Haves



Proven results running lead generation campaigns for local home service businesses

Hands-on experience with Search, Performance Max, and Local Service Ads

A strong understanding of conversion tracking. When a client says the leads are not coming in, “the dashboard looks fine” is not an answer. You know how to verify what is real.

The ability to build an account from zero and defend every major choice you made

The ability to read data and make strategic recommendations, not just report what a dashboard says

Strong communication skills. You’ll be in Slack daily.

Strong Pluses



Strong attribution skills, including tracing ad spend through call tracking and offline conversions to booked jobs

Experience with CallRail or similar call-tracking platforms

An understanding of how Google Business Profile and local SEO work together with paid search

Agency experience managing multiple accounts at once

Comfort working with AI tools. You do not need to build automations, but you should want to use them.

The Environment



Remote, international team

Contractor position, paid biweekly

Base range: $1,500 to $2,000 USD per month, depending on experience

Revenue share: after a certain amount of time with a client, you’ll begin earning an ongoing monthly share tied to how long that client stays with us. Realistically, this adds $200 to $500 per month within your first year and keeps growing as your book matures. It is paid every month for as long as the client stays.

Daily tools: Google Ads, CallRail, Slack, Airtable, Google Sheets, and Viktor

You can work from anywhere in the world, but you must work U.S. Eastern Time business hours. This is a firm rule, not a preference. There is no time tracking, and there never will be, but the Eastern Time schedule is non-negotiable. If you cannot commit to working these hours, do not apply.

Our clients are month to month with no long-term contracts. We earn the business every 30 days, which means the work has to be good.

Small, senior team. You work directly with the founder and the operations team.

title: TikTok Shop LIVE Sales Moderator + Video Editor
description:
I am looking for an EXPERIENCED TikTok Shop LIVE Sales Moderator who can also handle short-form video editing and content/script development.



This is NOT a basic social media assistant position.



I need someone who understands TikTok Shop LIVE selling and can actively work alongside me during my LIVE to help generate sales.



LIVE SALES MODERATOR — REQUIRED



LIVE schedule: 7:30 AM–9:30 AM Eastern Time



You must be available for the entire two-hour LIVE.



Your job is to actively support the LIVE while I am on camera.



You will be expected to:



• Listen closely to what I am saying and reiterate important product facts in the comments

• Reinforce product benefits I mention

• Answer questions you already know the answers to

• Bring important information back into the conversation for viewers who just joined

• Keep viewers engaged and talking

• Welcome new viewers

• Ask questions and encourage interaction

• Watch for people adding products to their cart

• Acknowledge and create excitement around cart activity

• Recognize purchases and celebrate buyers by name

• Use purchases to create social proof and encourage additional purchases

• Remind viewers about products and offers

• Help create urgency around promotions

• Monitor the chat for bots and spam

• Remove inappropriate comments

• Block viewers who are vulgar, hateful, racist, threatening or intentionally disrupting the LIVE

• Recognize the difference between a legitimate question/concern and someone intentionally trying to sabotage the LIVE



I need someone who can THINK IN REAL TIME.



I don’t want someone who waits for me to tell them what to type every few minutes.



If I’m talking about a product benefit, I expect you to recognize that and reinforce it in the comments.



If someone adds the product to their cart, I expect you to recognize it.



If someone purchases, I expect you to celebrate it.



Your job is to help create buying momentum while I focus on demonstrating the products and talking to my audience.



TIKTOK SHOP EXPERIENCE



TikTok Shop LIVE experience is REQUIRED.



Please tell me specifically:



• How many TikTok Shop LIVEs you have moderated

• What your responsibilities were

• Whether you’ve worked with product links

• Whether you’ve worked with Flash Sales/Flash Deals

• Whether you’ve used TikTok LIVE Manager

• Whether you’ve helped a creator increase LIVE engagement or sales



SHORT-FORM VIDEO EDITING



In addition to LIVE support, you will work as my short-form video editor.



I need someone who can:



• Edit TikTok/Reels/YouTube Shorts

• Create strong hooks

• Add captions and text overlays

• Use B-roll, images and visual examples

• Create problem/solution style videos

• Understand current TikTok trends

• Create engaging pacing that keeps people watching

• Add appropriate calls-to-action

• Repurpose my LIVE footage

• Take the raw videos I provide and turn them into multiple pieces of content



SCRIPT & CONTENT DEVELOPMENT



I also need someone who can create scripts and content ideas for me.



You will be able to review the products currently listed in my TikTok Shop and help develop content around them.



I need:



Strong HOOK → talking points/product benefits → natural conversation → CTA



I want multiple hooks and creative angles rather than giving me the same generic script for every product.



I also want you to suggest things for me to DO on camera, not just things for me to SAY.



For example:



• Visual demonstrations

• Before/after concepts where appropriate

• Trending formats

• Problem/solution concepts

• Props or visuals to use

• Text/pop-up ideas

• Ways to demonstrate a product



MY PERSONAL STYLE



This is VERY important.



I am a real, relatable creator.



I talk to my audience like I’m talking to one person or a friend.



I am NOT a luxury lifestyle influencer.



My content can be pretty and polished, but I don’t want everything to look overly luxurious, staged or artificial.



I want my personality to remain authentic.



I need an editor who can make my content look better while still making it sound and feel like me.



WORK SCHEDULE



This position is approximately 4 hours per day, Monday–Friday, split into two work periods.



Philippines time:



7:30 PM–9:30 PM — TikTok Shop LIVE moderation

8:00 AM–10:00 AM — Editing, scripts & content development



U.S. Eastern Time:



7:30 AM–9:30 AM — LIVE

8:00 PM–10:00 PM — Editing/scripts/content



The schedule is split because I want the LIVE content from that morning to become part of the content and script planning for the following day.



DAILY WORKFLOW



After my LIVE, I will provide footage/products/content that I want worked on.



During your editing/content hours, you will:



1. Edit videos I have already provided



2. Create additional short-form content from my footage



3. Review my TikTok Shop products



4. Develop new content ideas and scripts



5. Prepare hooks, talking points and CTAs for the following day’s content



6.
/send me the scripts and ideas so I can film them after my next LIVE



The goal is for me to wake up and already have the next day’s content ideas/scripts ready, while you’re also working on the videos from the previous day.



IMPORTANT



Please do not apply if you have never moderated a TikTok Shop LIVE.



I am specifically looking for someone who can come into the LIVE and understand what needs to be done without requiring extensive training on basic moderation.



Start your application by answering this question:



You join my TikTok Shop LIVE while I’m demonstrating a product. Someone adds the product to their cart, another person purchases it, and several people are asking questions. Tell me exactly what you would do in the chat during those next few minutes.



Please also include your hourly rate, LIVE experience, editing experience, and portfolio.

title: AI Video Editor | Image-to-Video Specialist
description:
AI Image-to-Video Specialist for Website Homepage Hero Banner



We are looking for an experienced AI Image-to-Video Specialist / Video Editor to create a short, cinematic hero video for the homepage of our new website.



We are a high-end vacation rental management company based in the Destin / 30A, Florida area. We already have professional photography of our homes. Your job will be to take selected existing property photos and turn them into realistic, elegant video clips using AI image-to-video software.



The Project



We need a polished 8-10 second homepage hero banner video that will automatically play when someone lands on our website.



The video should feel like our homes were professionally filmed by a high-end real estate or hospitality videographer.



We want subtle movement such as:



Slow cinematic camera push-ins

Smooth pans

Gentle lateral camera movement

Natural movement in pool water

Subtle movement in palm trees

Ocean movement

Natural light and reflections

Smooth transitions between scenes



The finished hero should feel sophisticated, calm, premium, and realistic.



Very Important



The homes shown in the photographs are real properties.



The AI must preserve the original property accurately.



We do NOT want:



Architecture changed

Windows or doors added

Furniture changed

Pools altered

Landscaping changed

Objects appearing or disappearing

Rooms becoming distorted

Unrealistic camera movement

Obvious AI effects

Dramatic animations



The goal is for visitors to assume they are watching professionally shot video footage, not AI-generated content.



What You Will Receive



We will provide:



Professional high-resolution property photographs

Examples of the visual style we want

Direction on which images should be included

Brand and website context



You will help determine which images work best for AI animation and create the final homepage hero video.



Deliverables



The initial project will include:



AI-generated video clips from approximately 4–6 property photographs

Multiple generations when needed to achieve realistic results

Selection of the strongest clips

Professional editing and transitions

Color consistency between scenes

Final 10–15 second homepage hero video

A version optimized for fast website loading

Seamless or near-seamless looping if appropriate

Final high-resolution master file

Preferred Experience



You should have experience with one or more of the following:



Runway

Google Flow / Veo

Kling AI

Luma

Adobe Premiere Pro

After Effects

CapCut

Other professional AI image-to-video software



Experience producing content for luxury real estate, architecture, hotels, resorts, travel, or hospitality brands is a major plus.



The Person We Are Looking For



You should have:



Strong experience with AI image-to-video generation

Excellent attention to detail

A strong eye for architecture and luxury design

An understanding of cinematic camera movement

The ability to identify AI distortions and artifacts

Strong video editing skills

The ability to create sophisticated work without overusing effects

Good communication

The ability to take creative direction and make thoughtful recommendations



We care much more about the quality of your work than how many AI tools you know.



How to Apply



Please include:



Examples of AI image-to-video work you personally created

Examples involving homes, architecture, hotels, resorts, or real estate if available

Before-and-after examples showing the original photograph and resulting video

Which AI video tools you currently use

Which tool you recommend for realistic architectural image-to-video work

What video editing software you use

Your hourly rate or project rate



Please begin your application with:



HERMOSA HERO



This lets us know you read the full job description.

title: Full-Stack Performance Video Editor + AI Graphic Designer / Prompter
description:
# Full-Stack Performance Video Editor + AI Graphic Designer / Prompter



We’re a fast-moving eCommerce company operating primarily through **funnel-based dropshipping**, and we’re looking for an exceptional **Full-Stack Performance Video Editor + AI Graphic Designer / Prompter** to join our creative team.



This is **not** a traditional video editing position.



We are looking for someone who understands that in direct-response eCommerce, creative is the engine of growth.



Your job is not to make videos that simply look good.



Your job is to help us **reproduce, improve, iterate and scale winning advertising concepts**.



## What You’ll Be Doing



A major part of our strategy is studying successful ads in the market and creating our own high-quality versions for our products and funnels.



That means you must be extremely good at **creative replication**.



We will often provide you with a winning reference ad and expect you to:



* Recreate the structure as closely as possible

* Match the hook style and opening sequence

* Match the pacing and rhythm

* Replicate caption timing and visual hierarchy

* Preserve the original selling mechanism and storytelling flow

* Replace all original product footage with our own product

* Replace or improve the B-roll

* Adapt voiceovers, scenes, graphics and proof elements

* Make the final creative feel native, polished and performance-driven



We are looking for **one of the highest-quality “copying” editors possible**.



You need to be able to look at an advertisement and reverse-engineer exactly **why it works**, then rebuild the same mechanism for another product without producing a cheap-looking clone.



## Role 1 — Performance Video Editing



You will create direct-response advertisements for platforms such as:



* Meta /

* Instagram

* TikTok

* YouTube Shorts



You should understand:



* Hooks

* Retention editing

* Pattern interrupts

* Native social pacing

* Direct-response storytelling

* Offer presentation

* CTAs

* Product demonstrations

* UGC

* VSL-style creatives

* Advertorial/funnel creatives

* Before-and-after structures

* Problem → agitation → solution frameworks

* Testimonial and proof-driven creatives



You should think like a **performance marketer who happens to be an elite editor**, not a cinematic editor trying to make ads.



## Role 2 — AI Graphic Designer



You will also help us produce high-quality visual assets using AI.



This can include:



* Static Meta ads

* Product images

* Product-in-use scenes

* Lifestyle visuals

* Advertorial graphics

* Before-and-after creatives

* Landing-page imagery

* Funnel graphics

* Thumbnail concepts

* AI-generated B-roll

* Image variations for creative testing



You should be able to take basic product assets and transform them into visuals that look premium and commercially usable.



## Role 3 — AI Prompter / Creative Generator



We need someone who is genuinely strong at prompting.



You should know how to get consistent, realistic and usable results from modern AI generation tools instead of simply typing one sentence and hoping for the best.



You should understand concepts such as:



* Prompt structure

* Camera direction

* Lighting

* Composition

* Product consistency

* Character consistency

* Image-to-image workflows

* Image-to-video

* Reference-image prompting

* Scene continuation

* Motion prompting

* Negative prompting

* Iterative prompt refinement



Experience with tools such as the following is highly valuable:



* Kling

* Google Veo

* Runway

* Midjourney

* Nano Banana / Gemini image tools

* ChatGPT image generation

* HeyGen

* Arcads

* Creatify

* ElevenLabs

* CapCut

* Premiere Pro

* After Effects

* DaVinci Resolve

* Photoshop

* Topaz



You do **not** need to use every tool.



You do need to demonstrate that you have a real AI-powered creative workflow.



## What We Expect



You should be able to receive:



**1 winning reference ad + our product assets**



…and independently turn that into a finished advertisement.



We do not want someone who requires a 20-page brief for every creative.



You need strong judgment.



If the reference uses a specific B-roll sequence, you should understand what that shot is accomplishing and find, create or generate an equivalent.



If footage is missing, your first instinct should be:



**“How can I solve this?”**



Not:



**“Can you send me more footage?”**



## Creative Replication Is a Core Skill



To be very clear:



We actively use **winning ads as references**.



Your ability to study those creatives and accurately reproduce their:



* Hook

* Structure

* Pacing

* Scenes

* B-roll logic

* Captions

* Transitions

* Emotional progression

* Proof placement

* CTA



…is one of the most important parts of this position.



We are not looking for random creativity.



We are looking for someone who can identify what already works and execute it at an extremely high level for our brands.



The strongest editor will be able to make our version feel **as good as or better than the reference**.



## Speed Matters



We test a high volume of creatives.



One winning concept may become:



* 5 new hooks

* 3 different opening scenes

* Multiple B-roll versions

* Different voiceovers

* Different captions

* Different CTAs

* Different lengths

* Different aspect ratios

* Multiple static-image derivatives



You therefore need to understand **creative iteration**, not just individual video production.



A winning ad is not finished after version one.



A winning ad becomes a creative tree.



## What We're Looking For



You should have:



* Proven experience editing performance advertisements

* Strong experience with eCommerce / dropshipping / direct response

* Excellent ability to copy and recreate reference ads

* Extremely strong B-roll selection

* Strong understanding of Meta and TikTok creative

* Strong visual taste

* Excellent pacing

* Strong caption design

* AI-generation experience

* AI image-generation experience

* AI video-generation experience

* Advanced prompting ability

* Ability to work quickly without destroying quality

* Ability to accept direct feedback and iterate quickly

* High attention to detail

* Good English comprehension



Bonus if you've worked with:



* Dropshipping brands

* One-product stores

* Funnel-based eCommerce

* Advertorial funnels

* VSL funnels

* Supplements

* Beauty

* Health

* Problem-solving products

* High-volume Meta advertisers



## What We DON'T Want



Do not apply if:



* Your background is mainly weddings, music videos or cinematic editing

* You only know how to make “pretty” videos

* You dislike copying winning references

* You need detailed instructions for every edit

* You cannot explain why an ad converts

* You refuse to use AI

* You use AI but produce obvious AI slop

* You take several days to make basic creative variations

* You care more about artistic originality than advertising performance



We care about originality when originality improves performance.



We care about replication when replication gives us a proven advantage.



The metric d
.



## Paid Test



This position will begin with a **paid creative test**.



You may receive:



* One reference advertisement

* Our product images/videos

* Product information

* Brand assets



Your job will be to recreate the advertisement for our product.



We will evaluate:



**1. Accuracy of replication**

Did you preserve what made the original work?



**2. Editing quality**

Does the final creative look premium?



**3. B-roll selection**

Did you choose or generate the right visual for every moment?



**4. Performance thinking**

Do you understand the hook, proof and CTA?



**5. AI capability**

Can you generate missing assets when necessary?



**6. Prompting ability**

Can you produce commercially usable AI visuals?



**7. Speed**

Can you execute quickly without constant supervision?



**8. Attention to detail**

Did you notice the small things?



## Long-Term Opportunity



We are not looking for someone to edit three videos and disappear.



We're building a serious creative operation.



For the right person, this can develop into a long-term position where you become an essential part of our creative department and eventually help establish:



* Editing standards

* AI workflows

* Prompt libraries

* Winning-ad databases

* Creative templates

* B-roll libraries

* Testing systems

* Junior editor QA

* Creative production processes



The goal is to find someone who can ultimately operate as a **full-stack creative producer**, not simply someone moving clips around a timeline.



## How To Apply



Start your application with the word:



**PRINT**



Then send us:



1. Your **3 strongest performance ads**

2. At least **1 example where you recreated or closely followed another advertisement/reference**

3. Your best **AI-generated product image or graphic**

4. Your best **AI-generated video/B-roll example**

5. The AI tools you currently use

6. Your editing software

7. Your current availability

8. Your expected monthly full-time rate



Finally, answer this:



**We give you a winning 60-second competitor ad and our product assets. Explain in 5-10 sentences exactly how you would recreate it for our product while keeping the elements that made the original successful.**



Generic applications will be ignored.



We are looking for someone **fast, technical, commercially minded and extremely good at execution**.



If that sounds like you, apply.

title: Marketing Agency Project Manager
description:
We’re Hiring: Remote Creative Project Manager / Production Coordinator



Company: La Vie Studios Media



Instagram: 
/laviestudiosmedia

Position: Creative Project Manager / Production Coordinator

Location: 100% Remote

Schedule: Part-Time | Full-Time Opportunities Once Proven

Start Date: ASAP

Employment Type: Independent Contractor



About La Vie Studios Media



La Vie Studios Media is a South Florida-based creative production and marketing company helping businesses build their brands through strategic photography, video content, social media, and paid advertising.



We manage the entire creative process for our clients, from strategy and scripting through production, editing, approval, publishing, and advertising.



As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Creative Project Manager who can become the central point of communication and accountability connecting our clients with our creative, production, post-production, social media, and advertising teams.



If you love organization, creative production, deadlines, quality control, and making complicated workflows run smoothly, this role may be a great fit.



About the Role



This is a detail-heavy operations and project management role inside a fast-moving creative company.



You will help manage projects throughout their entire lifecycle:



Creative Development → Client Approval → Production Coordination → Post-Production → Quality Control → Client Revisions → Final Approval → Social Media & Advertising



You’ll work closely with our Creative Director, clients, photographers, videographers, editors, Social Media Manager, Media Buyer, and company leadership to make sure everyone has what they need and every project remains organized, on-brand, and on schedule.



This is not simply an administrative or task-tracking position.



We’re looking for someone who can take genuine ownership of projects, anticipate problems, communicate clearly, maintain accountability, and help keep our entire production pipeline moving.



Responsibilities



Pre-Production & Client Approval



* Receive concepts, scripts, and creative direction from our Creative Director.

* Review scripts and production documents for accuracy, completeness, feasibility, and quality.

* Identify missing information or potential production issues before materials reach the client or production team.

* Send scripts and concepts to clients for approval.

* Collect, organize, and communicate client feedback.

* Coordinate revisions with our creative team.

* Confirm final approvals before production.

* Ensure all necessary client assets, brand guidelines, creative references, scripts, shot lists, and expectations are organized before production.



Production Coordination



Although this position is fully remote, you’ll coordinate the planning and preparation behind our productions.



* Coordinate production dates with clients and our creative teams.

* Schedule and contract photographers, videographers, and other necessary production personnel.

* Prepare production teams with scripts, shot lists, creative references, timelines, client information, and other necessary assets.

* Make sure everyone understands the creative direction, priorities, deliverables, and expectations before production begins.

* Proactively identify scheduling conflicts, missing information, or other potential blockers.



Your goal is to make sure our creative teams arrive at every production fully prepared to execute.



File & Post-Production Management



* Manage incoming photo, video, audio, and other digital assets.

* Maintain clean and consistent folder structures and file-naming systems.

* Ensure assets are properly backed up, organized, labeled, and easy to locate.

* Organize footage and assets according to scripts, shot lists, projects, and deliverables.

* Prepare and transfer organized assets, scripts, creative references, and editing instructions to our post-production team.

* Assign and communicate editing priorities.

* Track projects throughout the editing process.

* Update project statuses and task-management systems.

* Monitor deadlines and proactively follow up with editors and team members.

* Manage revision cycles through final approval.



Nothing should disappear into a folder, miss a deadline, or remain unfinished because someone forgot to follow up.



Quality Control



**Quality control is one of the most important responsibilities of this position.**



You’ll review edited photos and videos before they are presented to our clients.



You should be comfortable reviewing creative work with an **editor’s eye**, not simply checking whether a task has been marked complete.



You’ll look for:



* Spelling and grammatical errors

* Caption or subtitle mistakes

* Incorrect logos, fonts, colors, or branding

* Missing calls to action

* Incorrect or poorly selected B-roll

* Missing shots or assets

* Pacing and flow issues

* Failure to follow the approved script

* Failure to follow creative references

* Incorrect aspect ratios or formatting

* Text outside appropriate safe zones

* Technical or export issues

* Missing deliverables

* Client revision notes that were not properly implemented

* Inconsistencies between different pieces of content



You’ll then communicate **clear, actionable, and when appropriate, timestamped revision notes** to our editing team.



You do not need to be our primary editor, but you **must understand professional editing workflows and recognize what polished, client-ready content should look like.**



Client Communication & Delivery



You’ll serve as one of the primary digital liaisons between La Vie Studios and our clients.



Responsibilities include:



* Communicating project updates professionally and clearly.

* Sending creative materials for client review and approval.

* Delivering completed content for review.

* Collecting and organizing client feedback.

* Translating feedback into clear instructions for our creative team.

* Managing revisions through final approval.

* Communicating blockers or delays early.

* Making sure clients understand where their projects stand without needing to chase us for updates.



Because this is a client-facing position, **excellent written and spoken English is required.**



Social Media & Advertising Coordination



Once content has been approved:



* Coordinate approved assets with our Social Media Manager.

* Make sure posting schedules, captions, assets, and approvals are clearly organized.

* Communicate available and approved advertising assets to our Media Buyer.

* Maintain continuity between production, organic social media, and paid advertising.

* Help ensure approved content moves efficiently from creation into distribution.



The Project Manager may initially assist with some basic media-buying responsibilities as well.



Experience is a plus, but we have systems, resources, and training available to help the right candidate learn this portion of the workflow.



Must-Haves



* Excellent written and spoken English

* Exceptional organizational skills

* Strong attention to detail

* Experience managing multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously

* Experience with project-management platforms such as **Google Business Suite and/or CRM's**

* Strong digital file-management skills

* Understanding of video editing and post-production workflows

* Experience reviewing creative work for quality control

* Ability to communicate clear revision notes to editors

* Strong professional communication skills

* Ability to work independently in a remote environment

* Deadline-driven and accountable

* Comfortable communicating directly with clients

* Proactive rather than reactive

* Able to identify problems before they become emergencies

* Comfortable holding team members accountable to deadlines and expectations



We’re not looking for someone who simply waits for a list of tasks every morning.



We want someone who naturally asks:



**“What needs to happen next? Who is responsible for it? When is it due? And what could prevent us from getting there?”**



Preferred Experience



Strong preference will be given to candidates with experience in:



* Creative or marketing agencies

* Video production companies

* Photography or content-production teams

* Managing video editors or creative teams

* Short-form content such as Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

* Social media content calendars

* Brand guidelines and content strategy

* Adobe Premiere Pro and/or DaVinci Resolve

* Google Sheets or VSCO Workspace

* Slack

* Google Drive

* Dropbox

* 
, Dropbox Replay, or similar review platforms

* Basic paid social or Meta Ads workflows



Please Do Not Apply If:



* You regularly miss small details such as spelling, file naming, formatting, or branding inconsistencies.

* You have no understanding of video editing or post-production workflows.

* You’re uncomfortable reviewing creative work critically.

* Your written or spoken English is not strong enough for professional client communication.

* You struggle to manage multiple deadlines simultaneously.

* You need constant supervision to complete your responsibilities.

* You wait until deadlines are missed before communicating problems.

* You’re uncomfortable holding editors or other team members accountable.

* You’re already juggling too many other commitments to remain responsive during your agreed working hours.

* You don’t genuinely enjoy systems, organization, structure, and creative operations.



What You Get



* 100% remote position

* Flexible contractor structure

* Direct collaboration with company leadership and our Creative Director

* Exposure to the complete lifecycle of professional creative and marketing projects

* Training, workflows, systems, and resources to help you succeed

* Opportunity to help improve and build systems as the company grows

* Long-term growth potential within La Vie Studios Media

* Potential to evolve into a larger operations or leadership position

* Opportunities to expand into other areas of the company based on your strengths and interests



As La Vie Studios continues expanding, there may be opportunities to develop into areas such as **creative direction, social media management, advertising, photography, videography, operations, or other leadership positions.**



Compensation



Compensation will be determined based on **experience, availability, skill level, and demonstrated ability.**



We’re open to discussing either:



* An hourly contractor rate, or

* A fixed monthly part-time contractor rate



Please include your expected hourly and/or monthly rate when applying.



The position will begin on a contractor basis, with the potential for the role and compensation structure to grow alongside the Media division.



How to Apply



Before scheduling interviews, we’d like to learn more about how you communicate, organize information, and think through creative-production problems.



Please submit:



* Your resume

* Relevant portfolio or work examples, if applicable

* Your location and timezone

* Your weekly availability

* Your expected hourly and/or monthly rate

* The project-management platforms you have experience using

* Any video editing or QC software you’re familiar with

* A link to the Loom video described below



Required 3–5 Minute Loom Video



Please answer the following:



**1. Tell us about yourself.**

What experience do you have managing projects, clients, content, or creative teams remotely?



**2. Tell us about your video editing and quality-control experience.**

What editing or review platforms have you used? What do you look for before approving a video for client delivery?



**3. How do you stay organized while managing multiple projects and deadlines?**

Give us a real example of a system or process you’ve used successfully.



**4. Imagine an editor submits a video containing:**



* A spelling mistake

* Incorrect B-roll

* Incorrect brand colors

* A missing CTA

* Text positioned too close to the edge of the frame



Walk us through exactly how you would handle the revision process and communicate those changes to the editor.



**5. How would you organize a client’s digital assets and folder structure?**



Assume the project contains:



* Scripts and creative concepts

* Brand assets

* Raw photo and video footage

* Audio

* Editing projects

* Revision versions

* Final exports

* Thumbnails

* Social media assets

* Advertising assets

* Content calendar



**6. Why are you interested in working with La Vie Studios Media?**



What specifically about this position fits your experience, strengths, and long-term goals?



What Success Looks Like



A great Project Manager at La Vie Studios Media creates an environment where:



**Clients know what’s happening.

Creative teams know what’s expected.

Editors receive organized assets and clear direction.

Deadlines are consistently met.

Quality issues are caught internally.

Approved content moves smoothly into distribution.

Files are easy to locate.

Leadership doesn’t have to chase projects to figure out their status.**



If you’re the kind of person who notices the missing file, catches the typo before the client does, follows up **before** a deadline becomes a problem, and genuinely enjoys turning complicated creative workflows into organized systems, **we’d love to hear from you.**

title: FULL-STACK AI DEVELOPER FOR CONTRACTOR ESTIMATING AND CLAIMS PLATFORM
description:
FULL-STACK AI DEVELOPER FOR CONTRACTOR ESTIMATING AND CLAIMS PLATFORM



Company: Rezie

Project type: Fixed-price, milestone-based

Project budget: $1,000 USD

Timeline: Six weeks

Location: Remote

Future opportunity: Potential full-time position following successful completion



ABOUT REZIE



Rezie is developing an AI-powered estimating and claims platform for contractors in the insurance-restoration industry, including water, fire, smoke, mold, and storm-damage projects.



The platform is designed to receive project documents, damage photographs, measurements, square footage, material information, and applicable insurance requirements. It must analyze that information and generate an insurance-ready estimate explaining the work required, the project scope, and the expected cost.



Rezie also supports the remaining claims workflow by helping contractors organize claim information, review supporting documents, identify missing information, prepare claim-related materials, and manage ongoing claim tracking and follow-up.



Although the complete claims workflow must be functional, the estimator is the primary focus and most important part of this project. Scope accuracy will be the central measure of project success.



Rezie must correctly interpret the information provided for each project and produce a detailed, structured scope of work suitable for review by the contractor, client, and insurance company.



ABOUT THE PROJECT



Rezie’s frontend design, user interface, and intended workflow have already been completed. The primary work remaining is the backend development required to make the platform fully functional.



The current backend, estimator, and claims workflow are not reliable or production-ready. This is not a basic code-maintenance assignment or a project involving only minor fixes to an existing application.



The selected developer will be responsible for completing the backend systems that:



* Process uploaded documents, photographs, measurements, and project data

* Extract and organize relevant information using AI, OCR, and image-analysis tools

* Generate an accurate scope of work

* Calculate project quantities and costs

* Apply relevant rules, requirements, and project exclusions

* Produce a structured, insurance-ready estimate

* Support the remaining claims-management workflow

* Organize and review claim documents and project information

* Identify missing or inconsistent claim information

* Support claim tracking, document preparation, and follow-up

* Connect the completed backend to the existing frontend

* Reliably save, process, and export project information



The estimator will be the highest-priority component. The completed system must accurately use project documents, photographs, measurements, square footage, and other available information to determine the complete scope of work and expected project cost.



This is not an MVP or prototype project. The completed platform must be reliable, secure, tested, and ready for real-world use.



Detailed workflows, product requirements, estimating rules, technical documentation, and acceptance criteria will be shared with qualified candidates during the interview process and after signing a confidentiality agreement.



RESPONSIBILITIES



The selected developer will be responsible for:



* Auditing the existing codebase, backend, and database

* Determining which existing components can be used and which must be rebuilt

* Completing the backend architecture and application logic

* Completing the estimator and remaining claims workflow

* Integrating the required AI, OCR, document-processing, and image-analysis services

* Building reliable structured outputs and validation

* Developing the scope and estimate-generation functionality

* Completing the claim-document, tracking, and follow-up functionality

* Improving database reliability and data synchronization

* Preventing outdated or incorrect project information from being used

* Adding error handling and clear processing-status reporting

* Connecting the completed backend to the existing frontend

* Identifying and recommending any required APIs or third-party services

* Testing the platform across multiple realistic projects

* Correcting defects discovered during testing

* Deploying the completed application

* Providing technical documentation and a final code handoff

* Committing all completed work to the company-owned repository



DEVELOPER EXPECTATIONS



The selected developer must be able to work independently and take technical ownership of the project.



Rezie will provide the existing codebase, completed design, intended workflow, business requirements, and required outcome. The developer must determine how to technically complete the backend and communicate what tools, APIs, access, or third-party services are required.



The developer is responsible for performing their own quality-assurance testing before submitting work for final review. Rezie’s final acceptance testing is not a replacement for the developer’s own testing process.



Technical risks, missing requirements, and blockers must be communicated immediately.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



* Full-stack web application development

* React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase, or comparable technologies

* AI and LLM integrations

* Structured AI outputs and validation

* PDF, OCR, image-analysis, or document-processing systems

* Backend APIs, databases, and asynchronous workflows

* Automated testing and application debugging

* Experience completing or rebuilding an existing application

* Strong communication and independent problem-solving skills

* Demonstrated ability to complete projects on an agreed schedule



Experience limited to basic websites, prompt writing, or simple chatbots is not sufficient.



Experience with construction, restoration, insurance claims, property-damage estimating, or a related contractor industry is strongly preferred. Candidates must understand that an insurance estimate requires a detailed and accurate scope of work, not simply an AI-generated summary.



TIMELINE AND WORK EXPECTATIONS



The complete project must be delivered within six weeks of the agreed start date. Completing it earlier is fine. 



Before development begins, a written milestone schedule will be established with specific deliverables and acceptance criteria.



The selected developer must:



* Begin promptly after receiving access and documentation

* Make the project a primary work focus

* Meet the agreed weekly milestones

* Provide regular progress updates

* Demonstrate working functionality throughout development

* Commit completed work to the company repository

* Communicate risks or blockers immediately

* Reserve sufficient time for final testing, deployment, documentation, and handoff

* Be available for regular communication during U.S. business hours



PAYMENT AND DELIVERABLES



The total project budget is $1,000 USD.



Payment will be divided across clearly defined milestones. Each payment will be released after the corresponding functionality has been:



* Completed

* Demonstrated

* Tested

* Committed to the company repository

* Reviewed and accepted



Payment is based on completed and accepted deliverables rather than hours worked.



Hard-coded demonstrations, manually created outputs, temporary fixes, incomplete integrations, or functionality that only works for one test case will not be accepted.



FULL-TIME OPPORTUNITY



A developer who successfully completes the project, produces reliable work, communicates consistently, meets the agreed timeline, and demonstrates strong technical ownership may be offered an ongoing full-time position with Rezie.



A full-time offer is not guaranteed and will depend on project performance and company needs.



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit a cover letter specifically addressing why you are a strong fit for this project.



Your cover letter should include:



1. Your experience building AI-powered applications or backend systems.



2. Any experience with construction, restoration, insurance claims, property damage, or estimating software.



3. An example of a system you built that processed documents, photographs, or other unstructured information.



4. How you would approach a project where the accuracy of the generated scope is the most important requirement.



5. Your experience independently selecting APIs, testing your work, and resolving technical problems.



6. Confirmation that you can communicate during U.S. business hours.



Generic applications that do not address these questions will not be considered.

title: Amazon FBA Wholesale Product Sourcer
description:
We are looking for an experienced Amazon FBA Wholesale Product Sourcer to help us find profitable products and legitimate U.S.-based wholesale suppliers.

Your primary responsibility will be identifying profitable, replenishable Amazon ASINs and finding real distributors, wholesalers, and authorized suppliers where we can purchase those products.

This is not a basic lead-generation position. We are looking for someone who understands Amazon wholesale and can research opportunities from supplier discovery through profitability analysis.

Responsibilities

You will be responsible for:

    •    Finding legitimate U.S. wholesalers, distributors, and authorized suppliers

    •    Identifying profitable products and ASINs for Amazon FBA

    •    Reviewing distributor catalogs and price lists for profitable opportunities

    •    Using Keepa, SellerAmp, SmartScout, Tactical Arbitrage, Helium 10, or similar tools to analyze products

    •    Calculating Amazon fees, ROI, profit per unit, margins, and estimated monthly sales

    •    Checking Keepa history for stable pricing and consistent demand

    •    Identifying products that can be reordered and scaled monthly

    •    Verifying that suppliers can provide legitimate commercial invoices

    •    Researching brands and identifying potential authorized distributors

    •    Contacting distributors and supplier representatives when necessary

    •    Collecting supplier pricing, MOQs, account requirements, shipping terms, and contact information

    •    Checking products for Amazon restrictions, IP complaints, hazmat issues, and other potential risks

    •    Maintaining organized spreadsheets of suppliers and product opportunities

What We Are Looking For

You should have previous experience with Amazon FBA wholesale sourcing.

You should understand:

    •    Amazon wholesale

    •    Keepa charts and sales history

    •    Buy Box behavior

    •    Amazon FBA fees

    •    ROI and profit calculations

    •    Sales rank / estimated monthly sales

    •    Brand and category restrictions

    •    Ungating requirements

title: Construction Estimator / Bid Coordinator (US-based client)
description:
We are hiring an experienced Construction Estimator / Bid Coordinator to support a growing U.S.-based construction and facilities services company.



This is a hands-on construction role covering two major workstreams:



1. Government / Prime Contractor Bids

Supporting federal, state, and municipal solicitations as a prime contractor.



2. General Contractor / Subcontractor Bids

Preparing bids for self-performed construction and facility services for national and regional general contractors.



This is not a general administrative or data-entry position. You will work directly with construction documents, specifications, subcontractors, general contractors, pricing, bid requirements, and multiple active opportunities simultaneously.



The client typically has 6–10 active pursuits running in parallel, across multiple U.S. states, each with its own scope, documentation, subcontractors, and deadlines.



We are looking for someone with genuine construction estimating experience who can take ownership of the bid process with minimal supervision.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Government / Prime Contractor Bids

Monitor 
 and other U.S. procurement portals for relevant solicitations.

Track amendments, Q&A deadlines, site visits, and bid submission deadlines.

Review PWS, SOWs, specifications, drawings, and solicitation documents.

Extract scope requirements, forms, certifications, submittals, deadlines, and compliance requirements.

Identify required trades and subcontractors.

Research and source qualified subcontractors in the project geography, including unfamiliar markets.

Contact subcontractors by phone and
 to discuss scope and obtain pricing.

Communicate scope requirements, site requirements, payment terms, personnel requirements, and quote deadlines.

Collect, organize, compare, and evaluate subcontractor proposals.

Identify exclusions, scope gaps, pricing inconsistencies, and items requiring clarification.

Follow up persistently with subcontractors to obtain quotes before internal deadlines.

Prepare bid schedules, unit-price tables, and required government forms accurately and on time.



Phone outreach is a significant part of this position. You must be comfortable speaking directly with U.S. subcontractors and contractors.



General Contractor / GC Bids



The client also bids self-performed work directly to national and regional general contractors, including:



Post-construction cleaning

Rough and final cleaning

Interior and exterior glass

Pressure washing

Division 9 and Division 10 scopes

Related facility and finishing services



You will:



Monitor invitations to bid through
 and GC bid platforms.

Review ITBs, plans, specifications, and project schedules.

Identify the complete scope of work, including requirements located in other specification sections.

Complete GC bid forms accurately, including alternates, unit prices, allowances, sales tax treatment, bond and insurance requirements, union status, parking requirements, and project-specific exhibits.

Prepare and submit proposals to GC estimating and preconstruction contacts.

Confirm receipt of submitted bids.

Follow up consistently with GCs until the opportunity is awarded or closed.

Track bid-date changes, competitiveness, expected award timing, and feedback.

Maintain a live log of outstanding GC quotes, including project, GC, contact, value, submission date, last contact, next follow-up date, and status.

Support scope clarification and change-order documentation on awarded projects.



ESTIMATING & BID COORDINATION



Across both workstreams, you will:



Review lengthy construction documents and quickly identify critical requirements.

Extract and organize information from complex project documents.

Build and maintain multi-tab Excel pricing workbooks.

Use linked formulas properly rather than hardcoding values where formulas belong.

Verify that inputs flow correctly through dependent tabs before submission.

Maintain accurate estimating, bid, subcontractor, and quote records.

Manage multiple active bids and competing deadlines simultaneously.

Communicate professionally with subcontractors, vendors, GCs, contracting officers, and other stakeholders.

Use AI and other technology tools to improve document review, research, sourcing, and estimating workflows.



CONFIDENTIALITY & DOCUMENT CONTROL



Confidentiality is a non-negotiable requirement of this role.



You will be expected to:



Properly redact solicitation numbers, agency/end-client identities, and project-identifying information from documents before subcontractor outreach when required.

Ensure unredacted project details are released only when authorized.

Clearly identify documents as internal or external before sending them outside the company.

Ensure client-facing documents contain only approved billing information.

Never disclose internal cost data, margins, payroll information, or other confidential information to clients, GCs, or subcontractors.

Properly communicate and enforce non-circumvention requirements in subcontractor correspondence.



REMOTE WORK & HUBSTAFF



This is a fully remote position supporting a U.S.-based construction client.



Hubstaff will be used for time tracking and work activity monitoring.



You must be comfortable working independently in a structured remote environment and maintaining consistent productivity during scheduled U.S. business hours.



You are expected to:



Accurately track working hours through Hubstaff.

Remain available during agreed working hours.

Maintain reliable communication with the client and team.

Respond promptly to time-sensitive bid and subcontractor matters.

Meet deadlines without constant follow-up.

Take ownership of assigned bids from start to finish.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



5+ years of experience in construction estimating, bid coordination, construction procurement, or a closely related role.

Demonstrated experience reading and interpreting PWS, SOWs, specifications, plans, or other construction documents.

Hands-on experience sourcing subcontractors and discussing scope and pricing by phone.

Strong Excel skills, particularly multi-tab workbooks with linked formulas.

Strong spoken and written English.

Professional and confident phone presence.

Experience managing multiple bids, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.

Strong organization and follow-through.

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Availability during U.S. business hours across multiple time zones.

Ability to make and receive calls through a U.S.-reachable phone number.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



The following are a strong advantage:



Experience with federal procurement and 
.

Familiarity with CLIN structures, set-asides, bid schedules, and wage determinations.

Knowledge of Service Contract Act (SCA) and Davis-Bacon requirements.

Experience with GC bid invitation platforms.

Experience with post-construction cleaning, Division 9/10 trades, or facility services.

Experience performing quantity takeoffs from drawings.

Familiarity with Bluebeam or construction estimating software.

Experience using AI tools for document review, research, sourcing, or estimating.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We're looking for a construction professional who can hit the ground running.



You should be someone who:



Understands construction documents rather than simply processing them.

Can identify scope gaps and potential issues.

Is comfortable speaking directly with U.S. contractors and subcontractors.

Can source subcontractors in unfamiliar markets.

Can evaluate and normalize competing quotes.

Can manage several active bids without losing track of deadlines.

Follows up proactively instead of waiting for responses.

Takes ownership and keeps the bid pipeline moving.

Knows when to make a recommendation and when to escalate a decision.



If your experience is primarily administrative or data-entry based, this is not the right role.



If you have genuine construction estimating experience and enjoy the challenge of getting bids across the finish line, we want to hear from you.



SCOPE OF AUTHORITY



You will own the estimating and bid coordination process, but you will not have final authority over pricing or contractual commitments.



You will prepare, organize, analyze, and recommend, but you will not:



Set final pricing or margins.

Make final bid/no-bid decisions.

Sign or commit the company to a subcontractor, general contractor, or government agency.



The expectation is ownership of the process, not authority over the final number.



READY TO TAKE OWNERSHIP OF THE BID PROCESS?



If you have real construction estimating experience, strong construction document skills, confidence communicating with U.S. contractors, and the ability to manage multiple bids independently, we'd like to hear from you.



To apply:



Complete the application form.

Upload your updated CV.

Submit your short introduction video.

Answer the application question about the most recent federal solicitation or GC bid package you personally worked on.



Please be specific about your hands-on experience. We are looking for someone who has actually worked on construction bids—not someone who has only provided general administrative support.

Primary Responsibilities





Pinterest Organic Strategy & Execution

nts.

Performance Analytics & Optimization

title: Architectural / Kitchen & Bath Photo Editor
description:
We are looking for an experienced architectural and real estate photo editor to professionally enhance existing photos of high-end kitchens, bathrooms, and residential interiors.



We are not looking for basic photo retouching. We want someone who understands how to give interior photography the polished, luminous look seen in high-end architecture, luxury real estate, and kitchen & bath portfolios.



What we need

Enhance lighting and create a bright, warm, natural glow

Improve exposure, contrast, highlights, shadows, and white balance

Make cabinetry, countertops, tile, fixtures, and finishes look rich and dimensional

Correct color casts from mixed interior lighting

Improve window/exterior exposure where appropriate

Straighten verticals and correct perspective/lens distortion

Remove minor distractions or imperfections

Sharpen and enhance details without making the image look artificial

Create a consistent visual style across an entire project

The finished photos should pop, but still look believable. We do not want heavy HDR, excessive saturation, fake-looking lighting, or obvious AI editing.



Ideal experience

You should have a portfolio demonstrating professional editing of:

Architecture

Luxury real estate

Interior design

Kitchens and bathrooms

Residential construction/remodeling



Please send before-and-after examples of interior or architectural photos you have personally edited.

title: Head of Paid Media
description:
Facelove is a fast-growing DTC beauty brand in the US. We're direct-response first, the large majority of our revenue comes from paid acquisition, and every decision we make is measured against CAC, MER and contribution margin.



We're scaling quickly, and we're looking for a Head of Paid Media to own that growth: someone who has run serious spend before, knows what breaks at scale, and can build the system that gets us to the next level.



About the Role: 



You'll take full ownership of paid acquisition across Meta, Google, TikTok and AppLovin, managing $3–5M in monthly spend.



This is a strategy and ownership role. You'll have a team of junior media buyers who handle the implementation, from building and launching campaigns, ad uploads, naming conventions, and day-to-day platform work. Your job is to set the strategy, make budget changes, direct their work, and make sure we scale efficiently as spend grows.



What you'll own



Performance and P&L

- CAC, MER and blended contribution margin across all paid channels

- Spend planning and budget allocation across Meta, Google, TikTok and AppLovin

- Scaling decisions: when to push, when to pull back, and the evidence behind both

- Forecasting and hitting your forecasts



Channel strategy

- Meta as the dominant channel: account structure, campaign architecture, audience and placement strategy, testing framework

- Google (Brand, PMax, Shopping, YouTube) and Tiktok as diversification and incremental-volume plays

- AppLovin, a serious and growing part of our mix; you'll be expected to already know how to buy here and how to scale it

- Owning the mix: d
 where the next dollar goes and being able to defend it with numbers Leading the buying team

- Direct a team of junior media buyers who execute your strategy in-platform

- Set clear priorities, review their work, and hold the quality bar on launches

- Build the SOPs, QA checks and onboarding that let us add buyers without adding chaos

- Develop them, we want buyers who get better under you, and we want you to set the bar for the next hires



Testing and creative direction



- A disciplined, documented testing calendar: hypotheses, sample sizes, read windows, kill criteria

- Close partnership with our creative pods: you own the brief-back loop, telling the creative team what's working, what's dying and what to make next. You don't make the ads; you make sure we make the right ones.

- Offer, landing page and funnel testing in partnership with web and retention



Measurement

- Own the truth on attribution. We run third-party measurement alongside platform reporting and we know platform numbers are inflated, you'll be expected to have a defensible point of view on incrementality and to d
 on real numbers, not comfortable ones.

- Reporting a founder can read in five minutes and trust



What success looks like



First 30 days — You know our accounts better than anyone. You've audited structure, spend efficiency and measurement, and delivered a written diagnosis with the three biggest efficiency leaks and how you'd fix them. Within the first 7 days you’ve gone through the full onboarding needed for you to take over day to day mediabuying and are ready after week 1 to take over, the current setup, while changing it to how it should stand along the way.



First 90 days — Day-to-day buying runs through you and your team, not through a founder. Testing cadence is live and documented. You're running a weekly performance review that drives real decisions.



Who you are



Required



- 7+ years of experience in paid media, performance marketing, or customer acquisition - You have personally managed $1M+ per month in paid media spend — not overseen it from a distance

- Deep, hands-on Meta expertise. Non-negotiable. You should have strong opinions about account structure and be able to explain your reasoning.

- Direct experience across Google, TikTok and AppLovin — we're not looking for someone who will learn these on our budget

- Real fluency in unit economics: CAC, MER, AOV, LTV, contribution margin. You can build the model, not just read the dashboard.

- Experience with third-party attribution and a healthy scepticism about platform-reported numbers

- You've managed media buyers before and can show what you built to make them better



Strong plus



- Beauty, skincare or supplements experience

- Experience selling to women 45+, or in any category where trust and proof of efficacy matter more than novelty

- AppLovin or other emerging channels taken from zero to scale

- Amazon Ads



- You've worked in a founder-led business and know how to take something over rather than wait to be handed it



How you work



- You move fast and d
 with incomplete information

- You'd rather be corrected than be wrong for a quarter

- You are comfortable telling a founder their favourite campaign isn't working

- You want ownership, not a brief



What we offer



- Real ownership of the most important function in the business, with a direct line to the founders

- Remote-first, async-friendly, results-measured

- A brand with genuine product-market fit and room to scale

mber who will stay and grow at our company. We offer competitive compensation and a good work environment.

The bar is exact match to the real product, not "looks close enough"
