title: Bilingual Admin VA (English/Spanish) — Vehicle Rental Company
description:
About us



FastLane Hustle Rentals is a vehicle rental company in South Florida. We rent cars on 28-day renewable terms to gig-economy drivers — Uber, Lyft, DoorDash, Amazon Flex, Instacart — across three counties. Our customers are working drivers. The car is how they feed their family, so this work is fast, personal, and it matters.



We are a small, tight team. There is no call center behind you. Everything runs through one system (GoHighLevel), and everything gets logged.



The role in one sentence



Every Spanish-speaking lead that comes into FastLane is yours — from the first phone call, through the rental, through every renewal after that.



This is not a script-reading appointment-setter job and it is not a back-office data-entry job. You are the entire customer relationship for a whole segment of our business. If you are good at this, you will have your own book of accounts that you personally built.



Why Spanish is required



A large share of South Florida gig drivers speak Spanish as their first language, and right now those leads do not get the same attention as our English leads. That is the gap you are filling. Our sales script is maintained in Spanish as well as English.



You need to sell, calm someone down, and chase a late payment — all in Spanish, on the phone, with a real person. This is not "some Spanish would be nice." Textbook Spanish will not survive the first call.



Part 1 — You own the lead

Take the inbound call. Leads come in through our system. You call them back fast. Speed is most of the job.

Qualify. Is the driver 25 or older, living in our service area, already approved and active on at least one gig app, and looking for a month or more? If they are not yet approved on a platform, they cannot finish — you tag the lead and set a callback instead of running the pitch.

Discovery. Which apps they run, how long they have been driving, what they are trying to solve.

Present the program. One flat weekly price that includes the car, the coverage, the taxes, unlimited miles, and maintenance. No deposit, no credit check.

Quote the car. Off our live availability sheet, built up in a specific order that we will train you on. There is a right way and a wrong way to say the number, and the wrong way loses the deal.

Send the exact car. Photos of that specific vehicle on our lot, by text. Everything after this happens in that thread.

Collect two things. A photo of their driver's license through our secure link, and proof of their active gig platform. Nothing else on the call.

Hand off for screening, then call the customer back the same day with the approval and a pickup time. That callback is the close. If it slips, the lead is gone.

Get the paperwork signed and the pickup booked.

Part 2 — You keep the customer



Once your customer has the keys, they stay yours:



Renewals. Every rental renews on a 28-day cycle. Seven days out you call and confirm: extending or returning? Log it the same day.

Payments. Verify the weekly payment landed. When one is missed, you contact the customer daily. Unresolved at 72 hours, you escalate to management — you document, you do not decide enforcement.

Weekly tolls. Every Monday, pull the prior week's tolls, match each one to the right customer, and invoice it.

Problems with the car. Gather the details and dispatch to our Fleet Coordinator. You do not diagnose vehicles.

Returns. Coordinate the return and get the car back on the availability board fast. An idle car earns nothing.

Notes. Every call, every commitment, every next step goes into the system. Our rule: if it is not logged, it did not happen.

Hard rules you will be trained on



These are legal and safety boundaries, not preferences. We check them.



No money on the phone. Ever. No deposit, no reservation fee, no card number. The first payment happens at pickup, in person. South Florida drivers are primed against rental scams — asking for money on a call kills the deal and reads as fraud.

You never give coverage advice. We are not an insurance agency and you are never the agent. If someone asks whether a specific situation is covered, the answer is always "let me confirm that and follow up," then you escalate. Saying the wrong thing here is a legal problem, not a sales problem.

You never promise income. Not to a driver, not to a vehicle owner.

You never change the price or the terms. Rates come off the sheet. Exceptions require written approval.

You never skip a screening step. Every step exists because something went wrong once.

When in doubt, escalate. "Let me confirm that for you" is always an acceptable answer here.

Requirements

Fluent, natural Spanish and English, spoken and written. You will be selling and collecting in both, by phone, every day.

Real phone confidence. You will make outbound calls to strangers, present a price, and ask for a commitment. You will also call people about money they owe. If that drains you, this is not your role.

Available Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM US Eastern Time. Non-negotiable — it is when our customers and our office are awake. Check what that is in your local time before applying.

Reliable phone and internet. Minimum 10 Mbps down / 5 Mbps up, a backup connection, a quiet room, and a quality headset. Background noise on a sales call costs us deals.

Organized under load. You will carry dozens of open files at once, each on its own clock, with callbacks that cannot slip.

Follows a process exactly. We need someone who works the system, not someone who improvises.

Long-term. This is a permanent seat, not a short project.

Nice to have (not required)

Phone sales, inside sales, retention, collections, or account management experience

Experience with GoHighLevel, or any CRM (HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce)

Experience with a US-based company — especially automotive, rental, logistics, or fleet

Google Sheets



What we offer:

$7.00 USD/hour, paid twice monthly on the 1st and 15th

Full-time, stable, long-term work with a company that is growing its fleet

Paid training, a written script, and SOPs for every step

Direct access to the owner — no layers, no bureaucracy

Real ownership of a segment of the business, with room to grow into a senior seat as we scale



Do not apply if:

Your spoken Spanish or English is not genuinely conversational

You are uncomfortable selling or asking for a commitment on the phone

You cannot commit to US Eastern business hours

You are looking for part-time or short-term work, or juggling several other clients



FIELD: HOW TO APPLY / APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



I read every application that follows these steps. I delete every one that does not.



1. Put this exact phrase in your subject line: FASTLANE-ES



2. Answer these three questions in your message:



What time is 9:00 AM US Eastern in your local time, and can you work through 6:00 PM Eastern every weekday?

Tell me about a time you sold something over the phone, or convinced a hesitant customer to commit. What did you say?

Where did you learn Spanish, and how often do you currently speak it?



3. Record a voice sample and share the link (Google Drive, Dropbox, or Vocaroo). About two minutes total, unscripted:



First 30 seconds, in English: introduce yourself and describe your work setup and internet connection.

Next 45 seconds, in Spanish: you are calling a driver named Carlos who asked about renting a car for Uber. Introduce yourself and the company, find out which apps he drives for and how long he has been driving, and ask for the appointment.

Last 45 seconds, in Spanish: same Carlos, three weeks later. His weekly payment was due two days ago and has not come through. Be polite, be clear, and get a commitment on when he will pay.



The Spanish recordings are the most important part of this application. Please do not use AI voice generation, a word-for-word script read, or a translation tool. I will be able to tell, and it is an automatic no.



4. Attach a screenshot of your internet speed test (speedtest.net).



Shortlisted applicants get a short video interview with me directly.

You should be able to follow systems carefully, communicate clearly, and execute consistently — while also bringing good judgment, attention to detail, and a strong understanding of why certain decisions are being made.



This is a long-term role with room to grow for the right people.



Position Details

Position: Media Buyer

Openings: 1

Location: Remote, Philippines-based applicants only

Role Type: Full-time, long-term

Pay: Negotiable flat rate per 2-week period, paid in USD

Pay Schedule: Paid once every 2 weeks

Workload: 80 hours per 2-week period, agreed upon at hire



Team Structure:

You will work under the guidance of the Lead Media Buyer and our internal operations system. However, this is not an order-taking role. We expect you to understand the strategy behind the tasks you are executing, think critically about performance, and contribute useful observations when something needs attention.



Core Skills and Requirements



You should:

Have managed Meta ad accounts for e-commerce brands

Understand campaign structure, performance signals, pacing, testing, and optimization basics

Be able to think strategically about what the data is showing, not just make random changes

Know when to act, when to wait, and when to flag something for review

Have project management experience or have used project management tools before

Have strong attention to detail and can follow instructions carefully, including starting the application headline with BHS

Have a can-do attitude and can adapt to process changes

Be open to feedback and treat it as an opportunity to improve

Be responsive in Slack and ClickUp during working hours

Be able to document your work clearly and consistently

Know when to flag issues early instead of reacting too late

Be willing to learn our internal systems while also bringing your own media buying judgment to the role



As a Media Buyer, You Will Be Responsible For:

Managing Meta ad accounts for ecommerce brands

Launching and maintaining campaigns using predefined structures

Monitoring performance signals and campaign pacing daily

Making thoughtful changes only when the data and signals justify it

Understanding the reason behind campaign actions, not just completing tasks mechanically

Documenting actions, updates, and observations inside ClickUp

Making FTW the second word in your application headline, followed by your first name

Flagging account, campaign, or performance issues early

Escalating when something truly feels off, without overreacting to every small dip

Joining structured check-ins with the Lead Media Buyer when needed

Staying aligned with our internal systems, workflows, and campaign standards

Contributing useful observations when you notice patterns, risks, or opportunities in the accounts you manage



What to Expect When You’re Hired

You are not expected to know everything on day one. However, you are expected to learn quickly, follow the system, communicate clearly, and improve over time.

We do not use a time tracker, but we do track output, responsiveness, quality of execution, and your ability to think through the work strategically.



This role starts with a 30-day probationary period. After that, if you pass probation and show strong performance, reliability, responsiveness, and good decision-making, there will be room to discuss salary growth — especially if the campaigns you handle are performing well and you are adding real value to the team and our clients.



We are also in the process of creating an incentive system for tea
mbers who consistently bring value to our partners and clients.



Our backend systems and internal processes are currently being improved, so some workflows may change from time to time. You will be guided through those changes, but we are looking for people who can adapt, think clearly, and keep moving forward.



How to Apply

After your initial greeting, please only include the following in the body:



Your resume as a Google Drive link

A 1-minute voice recording as a Google Drive link explaining your experience related to this role



Keep your recording short, clear, and relevant to your media buying experience.

“I’m ready to start right away.”



Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be reviewed.

title: Real Estate Director of Onboarding
description:
Reports To: Vice President of Client & Agent Experience

Work Schedule: Monday-Friday 9:00am-6:00pm EST



Position Summary

The Director of Client Onboarding is responsible for owning and leading the complete onboarding experience for new YLN brokerage and corporate partners, from the point a signed agreement is transitioned from Business Development through successful launch and handoff into ongoing Client & Agent Experience. The Director will serve as the primary point of contact and centralized communication owner for YLN throughout the onboarding experience, including communication with client stakeholders and participating agents. In this role, the Director will build confidence with new clients while ensuring that every internal department, client stakeholder, technology partner, lead source, and operational requirement is aligned and completed according to established timelines. The Director of Client Onboarding will work closely with and report directly to the Vice President of Client & Agent Experience, who may participate alongside the Director in key onboarding meetings, client discussions, escalations, and strategic conversations. While the position reports directly to the Vice President of Client &Agent Experience, success requires the Director to effectively manage up and across the entire YLN organization. The Director is responsible for proactively communicating status, risks, outstanding requirements, and approaching deadlines not only to the Vice President but also to the leaders and team members of every department participating in an onboarding. The Director does not need to personally complete every onboarding task. However, the Director owns the outcome and is responsible for ensuring that every responsible party understands what is required, when it is due, and that commitments are completed on time. The goal is simple: one person owns the onboarding experience from beginning to end.



Primary Responsibilities

1. Own the Complete Client Onboarding Experience

- Assume ownership of each new client immediately following contract execution and formal transition from Business Development.

- Develop and maintain a comprehensive onboarding plan for every new YLN partner.

- Establish clear timelines, milestones, responsibilities, dependencies, and launch dates.

- Coordinate all onboarding activity across YLN departments to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.

- Maintain real-time visibility into the status of every active onboarding in DOCK.

- Proactively identify delays, risks, dependencies, and potential roadblocks before they impact the client or launch date.

- Ensure all required onboarding activities are completed before a client or program is approved to go live.

- Conduct a formal handoff into ongoing Client & Agent Experience following successful launch.

- Own the onboarding of new agents joining existing YLN client partnerships, including coordination of requirements, communication, completion, and readiness.



2. Serve as the face of YLN During Onboarding

The Director of Client Onboarding will represent YLN throughout the onboarding process and help establish the client's first operational impression of the organization.

Responsibilities include:

- Own and coordinate onboarding communication with client stakeholders and participating agents, ensuring a consistent YLN voice and minimizing fragmented or duplicative outreach across departments.

- Lead onboarding meetings alongside YLN Leadership, implementation calls, kickoff meetings, status meetings, and launch-readiness reviews.

- Partner with the Vice President of Client & Agent Experience on key client meetings, strategic discussions, and escalations when appropriate.

- Build confidence with brokerage leadership by demonstrating organization, responsiveness, preparation, and command of the onboarding process.

- Gather required information from brokerage leadership and designated client points of contact.

- Consolidate questions and requests so clients are not required to independently navigate multiple YLN departments.

- Clearly communicate responsibilities, requirements, deadlines, outstanding items, and next steps.

- Maintain consistency in YLN's messaging and onboarding standards across clients.



The Director should create an onboarding experience in which the client always understands where they are in the process, what happens next, and what is required of them.



3. Manage Up & Drive Cross-Functional Accountability

A defining responsibility of this position is the ability to manage up and across the organization. Although the Director reports directly to the Vice President of Client & Agent Experience, onboarding requires participation from numerous YLN departments. The Director is responsible for ensuring that each department delivers its portion of the onboarding process according to established deadlines.



The Director will:

- Maintain clear ownership and deadlines for every internal onboarding deliverable.

- Proactively follow up with department leaders and team members regarding approaching and overdue deliverables.

- Communicate risks and potential delays before they impact the client or launch.

- Escalate unresolved issues to the Vice President of Client & Agent Experience and/or appropriate YLN leadership when necessary.

- Conduct regular internal onboarding status reviews.

- Hold participating departments accountable to agreed-upon timelines.

- Ensure leadership has appropriate visibility into onboarding progress, risks, and resource constraints.

- Create a culture in which onboarding deadlines are treated as organizational commitments rather than individual departmental targets.



The Director must be comfortable professionally and respectfully holding individuals accountable regardless of title or department. The Director may not directly supervise every person involved in an onboarding, but the Director owns the timeline and the successful completion of the overall process.



4. Own DOCK as YLN's Onboarding Command Center



DOCK will serve as the central platform for managing and communicating the YLN onboarding experience, both externally with clients and internally across YLN. The Director of Client Onboarding will be responsible for ensuring DOCK is consistently maintained, accurate, current, and actively used throughout every onboarding. 



Client-Facing DOCK Experience

The Director will:

- Establish and maintain the client-facing DOCK workspace for each new partner.

- Ensure clients have a clear, professional, and easy-to-follow onboarding roadmap.

- Maintain client-facing onboarding requirements, resources, documents, instructions, timelines, and next steps within DOCK.

- Use DOCK to reduce unnecessary
s, repeated questions, and fragmented communication.

- Ensure clients understand how to use DOCK and where to locate required onboarding information.

- Keep client-facing information current as requirements or milestones change.

- Continuously evaluate the DOCK experience from the client's perspective and recommend improvements.



Internal DOCK Checklist & Accountability



DOCK will also serve as YLN's internal onboarding checklist and accountability system.

The Director will:

- Maintain the complete internal onboarding checklist for every client.

- Assign or document ownership of individual onboarding responsibilities.

- Track completion of tasks and milestones across departments.

- Ensure deadlines and dependencies are accurately reflected.

- Follow up on incomplete or overdue items.

- Maintain accurate status information so leadership can quickly understand where each onboarding stands.

- Document exceptions, decisions, outstanding issues, and required follow-up.

- Ensure internal completion requirements align with what has been communicated externally to the client.



If an onboarding task, requirement, deadline, or dependency exists, it should be visible and trackable within DOCK. The Director will also continually improve YLN's master DOCK onboarding template as the organization learns from each implementation.



5. Coordinate Cross-Functional YLN Execution



The Director of Client Onboarding will coordinate closely with YLN's:

- Client & Agent Experience

- Broker Partnerships

- Corporate Partnerships

- Technology

- Marketing

- Concierge

- Transaction Management

- Finance/Accounting

- Executive Leadership



Each department remains responsible for its respective area of expertise and deliverables. The Director's responsibility is to ensure the right person owns each deliverable, understands the requirement and deadline, and completes it successfully.



6. Manage Technology & Platform Readiness

Coordinate with YLN's Technology Team to ensure all required systems, integrations, permissions, and configurations are completed prior to launch, including, as applicable:

- Follow Up Boss

- Ylopo

- RealScout

- eRelocation

- SkySlope

- Mapsly

- Trainual

- DOCK

- YLN reporting and dashboards

- Client brokerage systems

- Third-party lead-source platforms and integrations



The Director will track and manage technology readiness while partnering with Technology for technical configuration, integration, and troubleshooting.



7. Lead Launch Readiness

Prior to every client launch, the Director will coordinate a formal readiness review to confirm:

- Required client information has been received.

- Participating agents have completed required onboarding.

- Technology and integrations are operational.

- Lead routing has been tested.

- Referral agreements and fee structures are documented.

- Training has been completed or scheduled.

- Client-facing materials and communications are ready.

- Reporting requirements have been established.

- DOCK's external and internal onboarding requirements are complete and current.

- Internal YLN teams understand their responsibilities following launch.

- Outstanding risks or exceptions have been identified, documented, and communicated.



The Director should be empowered to recommend delaying a launch when critical onboarding requirements have not been satisfied.



Qualifications & Experience

Required

- Strong project management and organizational skills

- Exceptional attention to detail

- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously

- Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills

- Ability to communicate confidently and professionally with brokerage owners, executives, managers, agents, vendors, and YLN leadership

- Strong follow-through and personal accountability

- Demonstrated ability to manage up and influence outcomes without direct reporting authority

- Ability to professionally hold individuals and departments accountable to commitments and deadlines

- Comfort working within technology and project-management platforms

- Ability to identify potential problems before they affect a client launch

- Strong documentation and process-management skills

- Ability to work effectively in a fast-growing organization where processes continue to evolve



Preferred

- Experience in residential real estate, relocation, referral management, brokerage operations, lead management, or related industries

- Experience onboarding enterprise or multi-location clients

- Experience with CRM, project-management, and lead-management platforms

- Experience developing SOPs, implementation plans, workflows, and project-management processes

- Previous experience managing or developing team members

title: Facebook / Meta Asset Manager with Media Buying Experience
description:
About the Role



We are looking for an experienced
 / Meta Asset Manager to manage and maintain the Meta infrastructure behind our growing dropshipping operation.



This is not primarily a Media Buyer position.



We already operate with clear SOPs and predefined rules for campaign testing, killing and scaling. Therefore, the more important part of this role is having an excellent technical and operational understanding of the Meta ecosystem and how different
 assets work together.



Your main responsibility is to make sure our Meta infrastructure is properly organized, connected, maintained and ready for daily advertising operations.



Your Main Responsibility: Meta Asset Management



You will take operational responsibility for our
 / Meta assets.



You should have strong hands-on experience working with:



Meta Business Manager / Business Portfolio



 Ad Accounts



 Pages



Pixels / Datasets



Domains



Users, Partners & Permissions



Payment methods



Instagram accounts



Asset connections and assignments



You need to understand how these assets connect to each other and how to troubleshoot them when something goes wrong.



Asset Maintenance & Replacement



We need someone who doesn't just react when an asset fails.



You will be responsible for:



Monitoring the health and availability of our Meta assets



Maintaining an organized overview of all active assets



Keeping sufficient backup assets available



Replacing problematic assets when required



Connecting replacement assets correctly



Checking permissions and access



Identifying missing or incorrectly connected assets



Maintaining the required quantity of assets for our operations



Keeping our asset documentation and internal sheets updated



If an Ad Account, Page or another asset develops a problem, you should be able to diagnose the issue, understand what needs to be replaced or repaired and execute the required operational steps according to our SOPs.



Important changes and replacements will initially be coordinated and approved with us, but we expect you to handle the operational execution independently.



Backup & Infrastructure Management



A major responsibility of this position is making sure our advertising operation has sufficient redundancy.



You will:



Keep track of active and backup assets



Identify shortages before they become operational problems



Maintain our required asset inventory



Prepare replacement assets according to our internal processes



Keep the overall Meta infrastructure organized



Make sure required connections and permissions are correctly configured



Report potential infrastructure risks early



The goal is simple:



Our advertising operation should never stop because nobody noticed that an asset was missing, incorrectly connected or unavailable.



Campaign Operations & Media Buying



Media buying experience is still required because you need to understand how the infrastructure is actually used.



You will also:



Set up campaigns according to our internal sheets and SOPs



Upload campaigns into the correct Ad Accounts



Check campaigns before scheduled launches



Make sure ads are approved, active and spending correctly



Monitor campaigns during product tests



Follow predefined kill, continue and scale rules



Execute budget and campaign changes according to our SOPs



Maintain campaign statistics and reporting



Identify unusual performance or delivery issues



Our testing system follows predefined rules.



We therefore don't need someone who constantly wants to reinvent the media buying strategy. We need someone who can execute the system reliably while recognizing when something falls outside the normal process.



Required Experience



This is not an entry-level position.



You should have practical experience managing
 / Meta infrastructure and advertising operations.



You should be confident with:



Meta Business Manager / Business Portfolio



Managing multiple Ad Accounts



 Pages



Pixels / Datasets



Domains and asset connections



Users, permissions and partner access



Troubleshooting Meta asset issues



Maintaining backup infrastructure



Meta Ads Manager



Campaign creation and monitoring



Basic campaign scaling and optimization



Ecommerce / dropshipping advertising



Google Sheets or similar tracking systems



Previous experience managing multiple Meta assets simultaneously is especially important.



What We're Looking For



You are:



Highly organized



Reliable



Detail-oriented



Technically confident inside the Meta ecosystem



Comfortable managing many assets simultaneously



Able to follow SOPs precisely



Able to work independently



Proactive when infrastructure problems occur



Comfortable troubleshooting before immediately asking for help



Able to communicate clearly in English



We want someone who thinks ahead.



If we need a certain number of backup assets next week, we don't want to discover the shortage when we need them. We expect you to recognize the requirement beforehand and communicate or act accordingly.



Long-Term Opportunity



We are currently operating on a relatively small scale and building the infrastructure for further expansion.



As we add more products, markets and advertising operations, the complexity and responsibility of this position will increase.



For the right person, this can develop into a long-term Head of Meta Operations /
 Asset Management role.



The goal is to eventually have someone who can take ownership of our Meta infrastructure and daily advertising operations while coordinating directly with the founder.



How to Apply



Please answer these questions:



Describe your experience managing Meta Business Managers, Ad Accounts, Pages, Pixels/Datasets, Domains and permissions. How many assets have you managed simultaneously?



Imagine one of our main Ad Accounts or Pages becomes unavailable shortly before a scheduled campaign launch. Walk us through how you would diagnose the situation, d
 what needs to be replaced, connect the required backup assets and make sure the campaign can still launch correctly.



How would you organize and monitor a Meta setup with multiple active Ad Accounts, Pages and backup assets so that we always know what is active, what is available as backup and where additional assets are needed?



Please also include your previous experience with Meta Ads, ecommerce or dropshipping campaigns.



We are specifically looking for someone with real hands-on Meta infrastructure experience, not only theoretical knowledge of
 advertising.

title: Full Stack Developer - Internal Tools
description:
About us



We make cosmetics for women over 45 and sell direct to consumer in the US and Germany. We're launching on Amazon in September. The company currently runs on Google Sheets, Slack threads and a few hand-built HTML tools, and that's no longer holding. We're building real internal systems and you'd be the person who builds them.



This isn't a Shopify or storefront role. Someone else owns the stores. You work entirely on internal systems.



What you'd work on



Rebuilding our supply chain tracker. Our supply chain manager built it herself with Claude. The logic is good but it saves to her browser, only she can edit it, and there's no record of who changed what. You'd turn it into a proper multi-user system with a Postgres backend, logins and roles, an audit trail, file storage against records, and automatic daily sales ingestion from Slack.

An internal tools platform. Our CEO builds tools with Claude (OKR tracker, comp planner) and they've got nowhere to live. You'd set up a private subdomain, one login across all of them, and data that persists.

Automations and integrations. Scheduled jobs syncing Slack and ClickUp, plus MCP servers so our AI agents can query internal data directly.



What you need



3+ years shipping full-stack web apps, with work we can look at

TypeScript, React or Next.js

Postgres, plus Supabase or Firebase including auth and row-level security

REST APIs and webhooks, with real experience of rate limits, retries and integrations that fail overnight

Deployment, DNS, environment and secret management

AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor or similar) as part of how you actually work

Written English strong enough to run async with a COO in another timezone



Nice to have

Slack API, ClickUp API, Python for data pipelines, Shopify Admin API, MCP servers, ecommerce or inventory experience. Also: taking over someone else's prototype and making it maintainable without making them feel bad about it.



We don't care about degrees, certifications or agency logos.



How we work

Flexible hours with meaningful overlap with Manila. Written end-of-day updates, work tracked in ClickUp. You'll get requirements from a COO, not a product manager. Some will be wrong and we expect you to say so. Every system ships with a README and a handover note.



This is ongoing, not a project. We'd rather grow it into full-time than hand it to someone else in six months.



How to apply: 



Send us:



- A link to something you built that non-technical people use daily, and a sentence on what broke and what you changed

- Your answer to this: our tracker currently saves everything to browser local storage. Outline how you'd move it to a database without losing historical data and without our supply chain manager losing a day of work during the switch. Six sentences is plenty.



Applications without the second item won't be read.

and craft. We are scaling paid media hard from October to December and we need one

person who turns our raw material into finished ads and social content, at volume.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Cut paid social video ads (9:16, 4:5, 1:1) from our footage: hook variants,

  subtitles, B-roll that carries meaning. 4:5 is composed for 4:5, not cropped.

- Build AI statics: you generate the environment (room, light, atmosphere) with AI

  and composite our real product cut-out into it. The product is never AI-generated.

- Produce many variants from the same source. One brief becomes 6 to 10 assets.

- Retouch product imagery, produce clean cut-outs.

- Build a real command of our asset library: what exists, what can be reused,

  what has been used too often, what we still need to shoot.

- Sound: music, ducking under speech, consistent loudness.

- Follow our file naming convention exactly. This is a hard requirement.

Volume: 50 to 60 finished assets per month, around 90 in November. That only works

with modular, template-based production, which we will build with you in your first

two weeks.

WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO

Angles, hooks and messaging come to you as written briefs. You own craft, speed and

volume, not strategy. If you want to own strategy, this is not the right role.

LANGUAGE

About half our output is German. You do not need to speak German. We supply every

German line: script, timecoded transcript, subtitle file, on-screen copy. You never

translate, never rewrite German text, never use auto-captions.

WHAT YOU NEED

- 3+ years editing short-form video, ideally for paid social.

- Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop. DaVinci Resolve Studio accepted instead

  of Premiere.

- Hands-on AI image generation (Midjourney, Flux, Nano Banana, Seedream or similar)

  as a repeatable method, not a lucky one-off.

- Compositing, and we judge this hardest: a real cut-out placed into a generated

  scene so perspective, scale, shadow, reflection and colour temperature hold up.

- Subtitles burned-in and as SRT, colour matching, basic motion graphics.

- File discipline and delivery on the agreed date.

- Your own machine and licences, stable internet, able to handle 4K.

- Working English, written and spoken.

BRAND FIT

Our audience buys a design object, not a trend. Calm beats loud. No neon subtitles,

no cut on every beat, no meme formats, no countdowns or discount language. The part

that d
 this role: you look at our brand kit and our existing assets, work out

the system behind them, and stay inside it on your own. We are not looking for

someone whose every single image we have to approve.

TERMS

- Full-time, 40 hours per week, remote. This is your main engagement.

- Start as soon as possible, ideally within two weeks.

- Initial term through the end of December, about three months. If it works for

  both sides we continue into next year.

- At least four hours of daily overlap with 09:00-17:00 Berlin time.

- Independent contractor: you invoice us monthly, work on your own equipment,

  handle your own local taxes and registration.

- USD 1,400 to 2,200 per month. If you are clearly above that level, tell us what

  you need.

- A paid trial task comes after the interview and before any offer. You name your

  fee for it.

DO NOT APPLY IF

You are an agency, a studio or a team applying under one name. You intend to

subcontract. You cannot protect a fixed weekly time budget for us. You need a

finished concept before you can start. Your portfolio is mainly meme-style or

discount-led content.

HOW TO APPLY

1. Three to five pieces you edited yourself, one line each on what you were given

   and what you made of it. Paid social work beats a showreel.

2. If you have them, two AI statics where the product is real and the environment

   is generated. Name the tools and the prompts.

3. Three short answers, three sentences each:

   a) How do you get eight genuinely different variants out of one 40-second clip?

   b) What is the first thing you do with the brand kit of a brand you do not know?

   c) What in your process breaks first if we triple the volume in one month?

4. Your monthly rate and your earliest start date.

5. Put the word Larvikite in your subject line, so we can see you read this.

We reply to everyone who follows these steps.

title: E-Commerce Operations & Management Virtual Assistant
description:
Summary



We are looking for a highly capable, proactive, and technically minded Virtual Assistant with previous management, supervisory, or team leadership experience.



This role will focus on Amazon advertising analysis, Amazon product and keyword research, inventory management, data analysis, Canva photo and video editing, and supporting the overall organization and improvement of our Amazon business.



Prior Amazon experience is strongly preferred but is not required. We are willing to train the right person.



The ideal candidate is highly analytical, comfortable with technology, learns new software and systems quickly, and can work independently without requiring constant supervision. A background in engineering, computer science, information technology, data analysis, mathematics, or another technical field is strongly preferred.



A major goal of this position is to find someone who can grow beyond completing individual tasks. The right candidate may eventually manage other VAs, if highly capable, potentially take on broader management responsibilities overseeing additional virtual assistants.



Required Conditions



Please read all REQUIRED conditions below before applying.



REQUIRED: Strong English communication skills for
s, meetings, training, management, and project updates.

REQUIRED: Previous management, supervisory, team-lead, operations, or project-management experience.

REQUIRED: Strong technical aptitude and the ability to quickly learn unfamiliar software, systems, and business processes.

REQUIRED: Strong analytical and numerical skills, including the ability to review data, identify trends, recognize problems, and make logical recommendations.

REQUIRED: Strong Excel and/or Google Sheets skills and comfort working with spreadsheets, formulas, reports, and large amounts of data.

REQUIRED: Reliable internet connection



Application Instructions



When applying, you MUST include the following sentence in the subject line or as the first sentence of your message:

“I have management or leadership experience, strong technical and analytical skills, and I am interested in learning and taking ownership of Amazon e-commerce operations.”



Applications that do not include this sentence will be automatically discarded.



Please include a link to your CV or resume and briefly describe your:



- Management, supervisory, or team leadership experience

- Educational background, especially engineering, computer science, IT, mathematics, analytics, or other technical fields

- Experience with Excel and/or Google Sheets

- Amazon or e-commerce experience, if any

- Experience with Amazon Seller Central, Amazon advertising, product research, keyword research, or inventory management, if any

- Experience with Jungle Scout, Keepa, Helium 10, or similar tools, if any

- Experience with Canva, photo editing, or video editing

- Experience using AI and other technology tools



Primary Responsibilities



- Analyze Amazon advertising performance and identify trends, problems, and opportunities

- Review advertising data including sales, spend, ACOS, ROAS, conversion rates, keywords, search terms, and other performance indicators

- Prepare clear Amazon advertising reports and recommendations

- Conduct Amazon product research and evaluate potential product opportunities

- Research competitors, pricing, sales estimates, reviews, product trends, and market conditions

- Conduct Amazon keyword research and analyze keyword relevance, search volume, competition, ranking, and performance

- Use Jungle Scout, Keepa, Helium 10, and other Amazon research tools

- Monitor Amazon inventory levels, sales velocity, inbound inventory, and potential stock-out risks

- Assist with inventory forecasting and reorder planning

- Maintain organized spreadsheets, reports, dashboards, and research files

- Create and edit basic product graphics, marketing materials, photos, and short videos using Canva

- Attend collaborative work sessions and review priorities with the client

- Provide clear progress updates and document completed work

- Identify problems, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement without waiting to be asked

- Create and improve processes, checklists, SOPs, and documentation



Preferred Experience & Skills



- Previous management, supervisory, team-lead, operations, or project-management experience

- Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills

- Engineering, computer science, information technology, mathematics, statistics, data analysis, or similar technical background

- Strong Excel and/or Google Sheets skills

- Experience supporting an Amazon or e-commerce business

- Experience with Canva, photo editing, or video editing

- Experience creating SOPs, checklists, processes, and quality-control systems

- Ability to communicate clearly, respectfully, and professionally

- Self-starter who takes initiative and thinks ahead



The following experience is considered a plus but is not required:



- Engineering degree or professional engineering experience

- Computer science, programming, or IT experience

- Data analytics or business intelligence experience

- Advanced Excel or Google Sheets experience

- SQL, Python, scripting, Google Apps Script, or similar technical skills

- Workflow automation experience

- Experience with ChatGPT or other AI tools for business applications

- Amazon PPC campaign management experience

- Amazon FBA inventory management

- Experience supervising Amazon analysts or e-commerce employees

- Experience managing larger remote or virtual teams



Stretch Goals / Responsibilities



- As the candidate becomes trained and demonstrates strong performance, the role may expand to include independently managing Amazon advertising analysis, product and keyword research, inventory planning, Amazon reporting, and other e-commerce operations.

- The candidate may also take responsibility for managing two existing Amazon analysts, reviewing their work, establishing deadlines and quality-control processes, providing training, monitoring performance, and ensuring projects are completed accurately and on time.

- For an exceptionally capable candidate, the role may eventually expand into a broader management position overseeing additional virtual assistants and potentially helping manage a remote team of approximately 10–15 people.

- The long-term goal is to develop this person into a trusted Amazon and operations leader who can identify problems before they become urgent, improve systems and processes, train others, make recommendations, and take increasing responsibility without requiring constant supervision.



Keywords



Amazon Virtual Assistant, Amazon VA, Amazon Operations Assistant, Amazon Operations Manager, E-commerce Virtual Assistant, E-commerce Operations, Technical Virtual Assistant, Amazon Seller Central, Amazon Advertising, Amazon PPC, Amazon Ads Analysis, Amazon Product Research, Amazon Keyword Research, Amazon Keyword Analysis, Amazon Inventory Management, Amazon FBA, Jungle Scout, Keepa, Helium 10, Excel, Google Sheets, Data Analysis, Canva, Photo Editing, Video Editing, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Operations Management, Team Management, Project Management, Process Improvement, SOP Development, AI Tools

, Slack, Notion, ClickUp, Google Drive, or similar tools

We are DermLux Laser & Aesthetics - a group of five medical aesthetic clinics in Cyprus (European Union): Paphos, Limassol x2, Nicosia, Larnaca. 14 treatment rooms, around 40 staff. Laser hair removal, advanced facials, injectables.



Website: 



A growing part of our clientele are English-speaking expats and tourists living in or visiting Cyprus. Our local team handles Greek-speaking clients. We are hiring one person to own the English-speaking side: answering them, advising them, and booking them in.



You do NOT need to speak Greek. You will never be asked to.





THE ROLE



You are the voice and the writing of DermLux for every English-speaking client.



- Answer inbound enquiries by phone, WhatsApp, Instagram/Facebook DM and

- Call back new enquiries fast (most of our clients enquire and expect a reply the same day)

- Advise on treatments, explain what each one does, handle price questions

- Book appointments directly into our system and confirm them

- Follow up with clients who did not book yet, and with clients who missed their appointment

- Work entirely inside our own software (Base44) - we train you on it



This is a phone-and-typing job in equal measure. You will be on calls with British, Russian, Israeli and other English-speaking clients every shift.





THIS IS A DEMANDING JOB - PLEASE BE HONEST WITH YOURSELF



We are not going to pretend otherwise. The pace is real, the targets are measured, and your numbers are visible every single day.



There IS genuine growth here - more hours, more responsibility, more money. But it goes to people who enjoy performing and want to be measured. It does not go to people waiting for the shift to end.



If being held to numbers stresses you out, this is the wrong job and you will be unhappy in it. If it motivates you, you will do well here and we will make room for you.





HOURS - READ THIS CAREFULLY



Monday to Friday: 15:00-20:00 Cyprus time

  = 20:00-01:00 Manila time (summer)

  = 21:00-02:00 Manila time (winter, from late October)



Weekends: selectively, 4 hours per day when we need cover. Not every weekend.



That is 25 hours per week as a baseline, up to 33 hours in weeks with weekend cover.



This is an evening/night shift in Manila time. Please do not apply if you cannot commit to it reliably, long-term. It is the single most common reason this kind of role fails.



Once you know the job well, more hours are available if you want them. That is a real path, not a vague promise - but it is earned, not given at the start.



HOLIDAYS: We work on the Cyprus calendar, not the Philippine calendar. Philippine national holidays are normal working days for us. Cyprus public holidays are your days off. You must be comfortable with this before you apply.





PAY



$6.00 USD per hour.



At 25 hours/week that is approximately $650 USD/month (around PHP 37,000).

At 33 hours/week that is approximately $860 USD/month (around PHP 49,000).



Paid twice a month by direct bank transfer to your own Philippine bank account. WE pay all the transfer fees. The amount we quote is the amount that lands in your account.





PERFORMANCE BONUS - real numbers, not a vague promise



  +$100 USD in any month where you produce 40 or more qualified booked appointments

  +$200 USD in any month where you produce 60 or more



"Qualified" means the client is actually booked into a slot in our system. Our software counts this automatically and you can see your own running total at any time. It is not a manager's opinion and it is not d
 at the end of the month behind closed doors.





CHRISTMAS BONUS (13th month)



Yes - 8.33% of everything you have earned with us during that year, paid by 24 December.



One condition, and we are stating it up front rather than letting you find out later: you must still be working with us at Christmas. If you leave before December, it is not paid. We think that is fair for a bonus that exists to reward the people who stay - but you deserve to know it on day one, not in November.





WHAT WE REQUIRE - please be honest, we verify all of it



1. NEAR-PERFECT SPOKEN ENGLISH. This is not negotiable and it is the first thing we screen for. Our clients are native English speakers paying premium prices. A strong accent that makes them ask "sorry, can you repeat that?" costs us the sale. We judge this from your voice recording, not from your written application.



2. At least 3 years in customer support AND sales - not support alone. You must be comfortable asking someone to book and to pay.



3. Reliable fast internet, your own computer, your own headset, and a backup plan for power and internet outages. We do not provide equipment or an internet allowance. Please include a speedtest.net result.



4. A quiet place to take calls. Clients can hear background noise.



5. Reliability across the shift, week after week. This role only works if the phone is answered.



NICE TO HAVE (not required, but tell us if you have it):

- Experience in an aesthetic clinic, medspa, dermatology or beauty business

- Experience selling treatments, packages or memberships

- Experience with a CRM or booking system





HOW TO APPLY



Applications that skip any step below are not read. This is deliberate - it tells us who reads carefully, which is the whole job.



STEP 1 - Put the word OLIVE in your subject line.



STEP 2 - Answer these three questions, in your own words. Short and specific beats long and general.



  Q1. A client messages: "I saw your laser package but it's too expensive for me." Write, word for word, exactly what you would reply. Not a summary - the actual message you would send.



  Q2. From your last support/sales job, give us your real numbers: how many enquiries did you handle per month, how many did you convert, and what percentage of the appointments you booked actually showed up? If you do not know a number, write "I don't know" - that is a perfectly good answer. Making one up is not; we ask about these numbers in the interview and it becomes obvious very quickly.



  Q3. Open 
. Name one specific treatment we offer, and write the first two sentences you would say to a client on the phone who asks about it.



STEP 3 - Record a voice or video introduction, 60-90 seconds. Loom, Google Drive, YouTube unlisted - whatever is easiest. In it:



  a) Say your name and where you are based.

  b) Read this sentence out loud, exactly as written:

     "Thank you for calling DermLux, this is [your name]. I can offer you a free consultation this Thursday at five, or Friday at seven. Which one works better for you?"

  c) Then answer in your own words: why should an English-speaking client in Cyprus trust you on the phone?



We ask you to read that specific sentence so we know the recording is new. A recycled generic introduction is an automatic no.



STEP 4 - Include your speedtest result, and confirm in one line that you can work 15:00-20:00 Cyprus time and that Philippine holidays are working days.





WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



We read every complete application. Shortlisted candidates get a video interview with the owner. We tell you either way - you will not be left waiting in silence.



We are not in a rush. We would rather wait for the right person than fill the seat quickly. If that person is you, this is a long-term position with a company that is growing and that pays on time, every time.

title: Inside Sales Specialist
description:
We are a fast-growing company specializing in high-quality architectural hardware — including railings, Lucite/Acrylic, iron door handles, and fully custom-designed products. Our work spans both standard and bespoke projects, with a focus on precision engineering, manufacturing efficiency, and design innovation.

Position Overview

● We are hiring an Inside Sales Specialist to own our B2B outbound pipeline. You will be the first dedicated sales hire at Lyfe Hardware. That means you are not following a playbook — you are building one. Your primary focus is identifying and closing architects, interior designers, general contractors, and developers who need premium architectural hardware for their projects.



● This role is for a hunter, not a relationship manager. If you thrive on cold outreach, building pipeline from zero, and closing deals with design and construction buyers — this is for you.

 

🔹 Business Development & Outbound Prospecting

● Identify and target B2B buyers — architects, interior designers, general contractors, developers, and procurement teams

● Execute high-volume outbound prospecting daily: cold
s, LinkedIn outreach, and phone calls to new prospects

●  Maintain a daily prospecting cadence — consistent activity is non-negotiable in this role

● Build and manage a pipeline of qualified B2B leads in ERPNext (our CRM)

● Research market trends, competitor activity, and buyer needs to identify new opportunities



🔹 Sales & Account Management

●  Manage the full sales cycle: lead qualification → proposal creation → negotiation → close

● Present product offerings, custom solutions, and bulk pricing options to clients

●  Establish and maintain long-term relationships with key decision-makers at architecture firms, GC companies, and developer groups

● Handle client inquiries related to product specifications, pricing, delivery timelines, and order fulfilment

● Coordinate with internal teams (CS, operations) to ensure smooth project execution after the sale



🔹 Bidding & Tender Management

● Experience with tendering and RFQ submissions is a plus for US-based candidates. For offshore candidates, this is not a requirement — we will develop this capability with you over time.

●  

● Identify tender opportunities and RFQs from architects, general contractors, and procurement platforms (where applicable)

● Prepare and submit competitive bids and proposals in collaboration with technical and estimation teams

● Negotiate contract terms to ensure profitable and long-term partnerships



🔹 Sales Reporting & CRM Discipline

● Log every call,
, and meeting in ERPNext on the same day — no exceptions

● Maintain an accurate, up-to-date pipeline — your CRM should reflect reality, not optimism

● Track sales metrics, conversion rates, and revenue targets

● Provide weekly pipeline reports and sales forecasts to the founder

●  Continuously improve your outreach approach based on data and feedback



✅ Must-Have Qualifications

● 4+ years of B2B sales or business development experience (offshore candidates) · 

● Proven track record of outbound prospecting and closing deals — not just managing inbound leads

● Experience selling to architects, interior designers, contractors, developers, or hospitality buyers

● Proficiency in CRM tools — we use ERPNext and Frappe CRM (experience with any structured CRM is acceptable)

● Excellent written and spoken English — your outreach and proposals represent Lyfe Hardware

● Highly organised with strong follow-up discipline and attention to detail



⭐ Bonus Points For

● Prior experience in architectural hardware, building materials, construction products, or premium fixtures

● Familiarity with the specification and bidding process used by architects and general contractors

● Experience with tendering or RFQ submissions (especially relevant for US-based candidates)

● Prior experience at an e-commerce company or startup environment

● Established relationships with architects, builders, or developers in the US market



🎁 What We Offer

●  Competitive base salary based on experience and geography

●  Commission on closed revenue

● Fully remote with structured EST hours

● Direct access to the founder — no layers, no bureaucracy

● You are our first sales hire. You will build the playbook, not follow one.

● Long-term growth potential as the sales function scales

title: VIRTUAL ASSISTANT – TEAM PRODUCTIVITY & GOALS COACH | TOGGL
description:
🚀 HELP GREAT PEOPLE MAKE EVERY DAY COUNT!



We are looking for a positive, organized and tech-savvy Virtual Assistant to become our TEAM PRODUCTIVITY & GOALS COACH.



This is a part-time, project-based opportunity for up to 30 hours per week.



You’ll partner directly with members of our international team — primarily remote team members in the Philippines, along with team members in California and New York City.



YOUR MISSION:



Help each person set meaningful goals, organize their work, track their time using Toggl, and celebrate measurable progress.



This is NOT a surveillance position.



We aren't looking for someone to watch employees or catch people doing something wrong.



We want someone who can become a positive "GOAL PARTNER" for each member of our team.



You’ll help people answer questions like:



✓ What do I want to accomplish this week?



✓ What are my most important priorities?



✓ Where is my time actually going?



✓ What is taking longer than expected?



✓ What can I improve?



✓ What could AI or automation make easier?



Our philosophy is simple:



MEASURE → LEARN → IMPROVE → REPEAT 🚀



🎯 WHAT YOU’LL DO



• Meet 1-on-1 with team members to understand their roles, responsibilities and goals



• Help each person establish clear daily, weekly and monthly goals



• Turn goals into projects and measurable tasks inside Toggl



• Help team members estimate how much time projects and tasks should take



• Help everyone develop an easy and accurate habit of tracking their work



• Compare planned time vs. actual time



• Conduct short, positive accountability check-ins



• Help people prioritize the work that matters most



• Identify bottlenecks, interruptions and repetitive work



• Look for opportunities where ChatGPT, AI or automation could make someone’s job easier



• Create simple productivity reports and insights for management



• Recognize accomplishments and improvements



• Become our internal Toggl champion



You don't need to know everything about Toggl on Day 1.



But you DO need to love learning new technology and helping other people use it successfully.



⭐ WHAT DOES A "GOAL PARTNER" ACTUALLY DO?



Imagine a team member tells you:



"This week I want to complete two customer designs, follow up with five customers and improve our sample process."



Great!



You help turn those goals into a realistic plan in Toggl.



At the end of the week, you might discover:



"We estimated 6 hours for customer designs, but they actually took 9 hours."



We DON'T want your response to be:



"Why did you take so long?"



Instead, we want you to ask:



"What happened?"



"What did we learn?"



"Was our estimate realistic?"



"Is there something slowing you down?"



"Could a better process, AI tool or automation help?"



"What should we change next week?"



That's the mindset we're looking for.



💡 THIS IS NOT ABOUT MAKING PEOPLE WORK FASTER



Sometimes great work takes time.



We want to understand where our time goes and whether we're spending it on the things that matter most.



Your job is to help our team develop better awareness of their time — NOT anxiety about a timer.



Different people work differently.



A designer's day is different from a salesperson's.



A customer service person's day is different from a manager's.



Your job is to understand those differences and help each person create a system that works.



🤖 AI + AUTOMATION



This is one of the most exciting parts of this position.



Imagine you discover that someone spends 5 hours EVERY WEEK doing the same repetitive task.



Don't just track those five hours.



ASK:



"Could we automate this?"



You’ll help identify opportunities where ChatGPT, AI, automation or better processes could save time and make someone's job easier.



We don't just want Toggl to generate timesheets.



We want Toggl to help us discover opportunities to build a better company.



🏆 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



After working with you, we'd like our team members to:



✓ Have clearer personal and professional goals



✓ Know their most important priorities



✓ Better understand where their time goes



✓ Become better at estimating how long work takes



✓ Feel comfortable using Toggl



✓ Identify repetitive work that could be automated



✓ Develop better productivity habits



✓ Celebrate measurable accomplishments



Most importantly:



We want people to feel that Toggl HELPS THEM rather than WATCHES THEM.



👀 WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You may currently be a:



• Virtual Assistant



• Executive Assistant



• Project Coordinator



• Operations Coordinator



• Project Manager



• Team Leader



• Accountability Coach



• Productivity Coach



Or maybe you've never had any of those exact titles — but this job sounds PERFECT for your personality.



You should be:



✓ Extremely organized



✓ Positive and encouraging



✓ Friendly and approachable



✓ Excellent at spoken and written English



✓ Comfortable having 1-on-1 video conversations



✓ Able to respectfully hold people accountable



✓ Tech-savvy and a fast learner



✓ Curious about AI and automation



✓ Comfortable with numbers, reports and data



✓ Able to work independently



✓ Proactive rather than waiting to be told everything



✓ Interested in understanding how different people work



✓ Someone who genuinely enjoys helping other people succeed



Experience with Toggl, ClickUp, Asana, 
, Notion, Slack, Google Workspace or similar tools is a PLUS.



Experience managing, training or coordinating remote teams is also a PLUS.



Previous Toggl experience is NOT required.



We can teach software.



We're much more interested in finding the RIGHT PERSON.



🌎 WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH



We are an entrepreneurial U.S.-based company with a diverse international team.



Many of our remote team members are located in the Philippines, with additional team members working in California and New York City.



Our team includes people working in:



• Sales



• Customer Service



• Design



• Operations



• Marketing



• Content



• Management



• Technology & Automation



You'll get to know how different people work and help them become more successful.



⏰ HOURS + PROJECT STRUCTURE



This is a PART-TIME, PROJECT-BASED opportunity.



UP TO 30 HOURS PER WEEK



Our initial project is to successfully implement Toggl across our team and develop a positive system for goal setting, time awareness, accountability and productivity.



We are starting this as a project because we want to find the right person and build the right system together.



We care about RESULTS — not simply accumulating hours.



Do a great job and there may be opportunities to continue working with us on future projects.



We are constantly experimenting with new technology, AI, automation and better ways of working.



For the right person, this could develop into an interesting long-term working relationship.



💰 COMPENSATION



Competitive hourly compensation based on experience and qualifications.



When applying, please include your expected hourly rate in USD.



❤️ THE MOST IMPORTANT QUALIFICATION



We are NOT looking for someone who enjoys catching people doing something wrong.



We ARE looking for someone who genuinely enjoys helping people WIN.



We want our team members to eventually say:



"I have my Goal Partner meeting today!"



Rather than:



"I have to meet with the person who monitors my time."



If you understand the difference, you may be exactly who we're looking for.



🚀 HOW TO APPLY



IMPORTANT:



Start your application with the exact words:



MAKE EVERY DAY COUNT



Then answer these questions:



A team member estimates that a task will take 2 hours, but it consistently takes 5 hours. How would you approach the conversation?

Someone on the team doesn't like tracking their time. How would you help them see Toggl as something useful rather than something monitoring them?

Tell us about one app, system, AI tool or automation you've used to make yourself or a team more productive.

Have you ever coached, managed, trained or helped coworkers improve their productivity? Tell us about the experience.

Have you used Toggl, ClickUp, Asana, 
, Notion or another project/time-management platform? Which one and how did you use it?

What is your expected hourly rate in USD?

How many hours per week are you currently available?



BONUS QUESTION:



What is ONE thing you would do to make goal setting and time tracking fun and positive for a remote team?



Please don't send us a generic application.



We want to hear how YOU think and communicate.



If you're excited about helping people accomplish their goals, learning new technology and finding smarter ways to work...



WE WANT TO MEET YOU! 🚀



LET'S MAKE EVERY DAY COUNT!

title: AI Video Editor

description:
About Moon Nude

Moon Nude is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer brand selling beautifully designed, handmade products — makeup bags, hair tool bags, duffels, backpacks and more. Our primary market is the United States, alongside a growing international presence. We're building an in-house creative team and moving off agencies, and this role designs the static creative that stops the scroll and sells — plus the brand visuals that keep us looking premium.





The Role

You design static ad creative that converts — image ads, carousels, and concepts for paid social (primarily Meta) — plus supporting brand and marketing visuals. Working from a creative strategist's briefs inside a creative pod, you'll produce a high volume of statics and iterate fast on what's winning. Our brand looks soft and premium, but our best ads are often punchy and direct — you'll know when to use which.





What You'll Do

• Design high-performing statics: single-image ads, carousels, and ad concepts for Meta and other channels.

• Iterate at volume: produce variations and fresh iterations of winning statics, quickly.

• Support the wider brand: landing-page,
, and organic visuals as needed.

• Protect the brand: keep everything on-brand and premium, while nailing sharp DR executions when they win.

• Move fast: turn briefs around quickly and iterate from performance feedback.





What We're Looking For

• eCom/DTC static portfolio: ad design that performed, ideally with performance context.

• Craft: excellent typography, layout, and composition.

• Tools: fluent in Figma and Adobe (Photoshop, Illustrator).

• Range: clean premium brand work and aggressive direct-response statics, with the judgment to know which to deploy.

• Fast and high-volume: you ship a lot without dropping quality.

• Remote-ready: self-managing, reliable, with strong English.



Nice to Have



• Basic motion / video editing.

• Packaging or broader brand design experience.

• Comfort with AI design tools.



The Details

• Type: Full-time.

• Location: Fully remote. With reasonable overlap with US working hours (our primary market is the US).

• Compensation: performance-based — a base plus a bonus for every creative you produce that scales.

• Portfolio: required — please share past work, ideally ads that performed, not just a showreel.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager (CSM)
description:
Senior Customer Success Manager (CSM)

Location: Remote (US hours)

About OpenCall 

OpenCall's voice AI handles calls for multi-location medical groups. We're solving a unique challenge: pushing the limits of AI at millisecond performance to have the best human-like customer service experience at enterprise scale. Our AI is faster, cheaper, more powerful, and more reliable than anything else on the market. We let businesses answer the phone and make outbound calls automatically—answering questions, booking appointments, and integrating directly with existing booking software.

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager who can take ownership of our customer relationships and ensure our AI agents are delivering measurable, undeniable value to the medical and dental practices we serve.



About the role 

As a Customer Success Manager at OpenCall, you are the bridge between our multi-location healthcare customers and our engineering/prompt teams. You aren't just doing check-in calls and sending NPS surveys; you are actively managing onboardings, understanding the complexities of medical scheduling, and driving product adoption.

You will own the post-sales lifecycle. When a new clinic comes online, you will guide them through deployment, ensuring their intake forms, scheduling rules, and practice quirks are perfectly translated into our system. You will look for optimization and expansion opportunities, and work directly with our Agent Developers to push automation rates higher and drive up booking numbers.



Responsibilities

- Own the customer lifecycle: Manage the onboarding, adoption, and retention of our medical and dental group partners. You are their primary advocate and point of contact.

- Workflow translation: Work with practice administrators to understand their specific operational rules, edge cases, and EHR/PMS integrations, ensuring our deployment team configures an optimal agent.

- Data-driven optimization: Review real call data and metrics. If a specific objection-handling flow isn't working for a dental clinic in Ohio, you are the one who flags it, measures the drop-off in booking rates, and coordinates the fix.

- Drive retention and expansion: Prove the ROI of OpenCall every single month, enabling the customer to roll out additional locations. You will run monthly and quarterly reviews grounded in hard data: calls handled, hours saved, and appointments booked.

- Feedback loop: Act as the voice of the customer to our product and engineering teams. You will help prioritize feature requests and flag drift or friction in live deployments before the customer even notices.



What we're looking for

- You've managed complex customers and onboardings before. You have 6+ years of experience as a CSM in a B2B SaaS or HealthTech company

- Analytical and empirical. You don't just ask customers how they feel; you look at the dashboard. You are comfortable diving into the data to justify your recommendations.

- Deep empathy mixed with operational rigor. You stay organized when multiple projects are in flight. You understand that in healthcare workflows, a bad deployment costs real money for real practices, and you know how to manage expectations carefully.

- Exceptional communication. You can seamlessly translate highly technical AI concepts to a non-technical front-office manager, and then turn around and translate front-office operational chaos into clear requirements for our engineering team.

- Problem-solving mindset. You are proactive. When a customer is struggling, you don't just log a ticket—you dig in, listen to the failed call recordings, and come to the table with a proposed solution.



Preferred Qualifications

- 6+ years of direct customer success experience

- 4+ years of experience in healthcare operations, SaaS, or contact center technology.

- 3+ years of hands-on experience with Hubspot or a similar CRM	

- 4+ years of experience with medical/dental scheduling software and workflows, and you've seen how messy a front desk can get.

- 4+ years of experience working alongside technical teams (engineers, product managers, or AI developers) to iterate on a highly technical product.

- Prior demonstrated experience and success working with US companies during US business hours.





If you are interested in this role, please create a short video (<5 minutes) describing your most challenging customer onboarding and most challenging customer renewal. Include the following details:



- The company and customer you were working with

- The key stakeholders at the customer and their roles

- What was challenging about the onboarding and renewal

- What you did to address those challenges

title: Instagram Carousel Copywriter
description:
# Instagram carousel copywriter 



We're Digital Wealth Lab. We teach corporate people how to start AI marketing agencies for local businesses, and Bruno's Instagram is where most of that audience comes from. The account works because we skip the guru theater and just show the actual system. We need a writer who can keep it that way while we post more.



**This role is carousels. That's it.** Not
 sequences. Not landing pages. Not blogs. Not single-image posts with a clever caption. We're hiring someone who specializes in multi-slide Instagram carousels and has the receipts to prove it.



Carousels are their own format with their own rules. Slide one has to earn slide two, slide two has to earn slide three, every break is a decision, and the last slide has to convert attention you spent nine slides building. Writing one good line is not the job. Holding a reader across ten of them is.



## The job



Daily carousels for Bruno. You draft with our AI system to move fast, then rewrite it line by line until it's actually good. The AI gets you a draft. You write the post.



- Daily carousels in Bruno's voice, hook slide through CTA slide

- Structure that holds the swipe: one idea per slide, breaks that pull, no dead middle

- Hooks that stop the scroll, closing slides that get DMs

- QA every post against the voice, the format specs, and our guidelines

- Brief the designers so slide copy and slide design aren't fighting each other

- Track swipe-through, saves, shares, and DMs — what hits, what flops, what gets flagged — and fix the system off it

- Own the lead and growth numbers from organic



Reels may come later once you've got the voice down, but carousels are the job and carousels are what we'll judge the work on.



## Who we want



Not entry level. This is for someone already good at social who wants a bigger seat: real numbers, daily output, a small team, and a say in how the whole thing runs.



You should have:



- **A carousel portfolio.** Actual multi-slide posts you wrote, ideally for influencers, coaches, or personal brands. Bonus if it's biz-op, finance, or self-improvement. Send slides, not tweets.

- **Run an actual Instagram account day to day.** You've watched your own carousels save and die, and you can explain why.

- **Copy you'd defend.** You can pull a reader from slide one to the CTA, and you know a good hook from a bad one without calling a meeting about it.

- **A marketer's eye.** Look at a post and tell us whether it's built to grow, to capture leads, or to sell.

- **AI already in your workflow.** You prompt Claude or GPT, you call out a weak draft, and you never ship the first thing it hands you.



Nice if you've got: theme page or shoutout experience, an info-product or high-ticket background, work for a 100k+ creator, funnels that turn attention into calls or sales, or ghostwriting in someone else's voice.



## Who we're not looking for



Being direct so nobody wastes a day on the task:



- *
 marketers.** Sequences are a real craft. It isn't this one.

- **Single-slide / static post writers.** One graphic and a caption is a different skill.

- **Landing page, blog, SEO, or ad copywriters** looking to cross over into social.

- **Generalists** whose portfolio is mostly the above with a couple of carousels at the bottom.



If that's you, you're probably great at what you do. You're just not who we're after here.



## Two things we won't budge on



The voice is Bruno's. If you'd rather write like yourself, you'll hate this.



Hours are 4 AM to 12 PM Eastern, Monday to Friday.



## How to apply



No test task, no consideration. Finish the whole thing and you'll hear back either way.



**1. Five-minute video.** Loom or whatever you've got. Who you are, why this role, why you, how you use AI, and the carousels you've written for creators or brands.



**2. The task.**



Part 1: Go through Bruno's profile (
), research the account, and pitch 5 carousel ideas (hook plus a short outline). No need to write the full posts.



Example:



> Hook: At 20 I was making $52k at a 9-5. I failed 6 businesses over the next 4 years. Everyone thought I was done. Then one boring AI tool changed everything.

>

> Outline: Bruno's story and the exact system he ran, with real numbers, named tools, and the math (what the tool costs vs. what the client pays).



Part 2: Write out 2 of those 5 as full carousels, slide by slide, as many slides as the idea needs. Draft with AI if you want, but we're paying for your writing, so the final words are yours. If you used AI, send the transcript too.



You get 24 to 48 hours once we send the task over.



Send us the video, your 5 ideas, the 2 carousels, and the transcript if there is one.
