title: Experienced Inbound & Outbound Appointment Setter — Verified Phone Results Required
description:
EXPERIENCED INBOUND AND OUTBOUND PHONE SETTER — NOT ENTRY LEVEL



Prosper is hiring a full-time remote appointment setter for U.S. solar, battery, home-energy savings, and home-services campaigns.



This is a production role for a proven phone setter who can handle the complete process: respond immediately to fresh inbound leads, make high-volume outbound calls to warm, aged, cold, and reactivation lists, qualify homeowners, handle objections, keep the CRM clean, book accurate appointments, confirm attendance, and protect the sales team's calendar from weak or incomplete bookings.



This is not a training-from-zero, chat-only, social-DM-only, data-entry, or general virtual-assistant position. You must already have measurable experience booking qualified appointments by phone.



PAY, SCHEDULE, AND REQUIRED INTERVIEW



• $6 USD per hour.

• Paid monthly, not weekly or biweekly.

• Full-time, 40 hours per week.

• Monday-Friday, 10:00 AM-7:00 PM Eastern Time (New York time).

• This listing does not promise a bonus, commission, automatic raise, or guaranteed promotion.

• Qualified applicants must attend the live group interview on Friday, September 4, 2026 at 2:00 PM Eastern Time.

• The interview will run for approximately one hour.

• Enter through Prosper
 



Prosper is building for long-term growth in solar, battery upgrades, home-energy savings, and home services. Setters who prove reliable attendance, clean CRM work, strong appointment quality, and consistent production can be considered for greater responsibility as the company grows. Advancement is based on verified performance and business need.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



• Call fresh inbound leads quickly and follow up by phone, text,
, and CRM.

• Make consistent outbound calls to warm, aged, cold, and reactivation lead lists.

• Build rapport, control the conversation, ask useful qualification questions, and identify genuine homeowner interest.

• Handle objections calmly and move qualified prospects to a clear next step.

• Book accurate appointments on the correct calendar.

• Confirm appointments, reduce no-shows, and collect required pre-appointment information.

• Log every call, outcome, callback, note, and disposition accurately in the CRM.

• Hit production targets without sacrificing compliance or appointment quality.

• Work independently without needing someone to monitor every call, follow-up, or CRM entry.



YOU MUST ALREADY HAVE



• At least two years of recent phone appointment-setting, inside-sales, or high-volume call-center experience.

• Proven experience with BOTH inbound lead response and outbound, cold, or reactivation calling.

• Measurable prior production: daily call volume, qualified appointments per week or month, show rate, and industries served.

• Experience using a dialer and CRM. GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce, Close, or similar systems are relevant.

• Strong spoken and written English that U.S. homeowners can easily understand and trust.

• Experience qualifying prospects, handling objections, scheduling appointments, confirming attendance, and maintaining clean CRM notes.

• A reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, professional headset, quiet workspace, and dependable availability for the Eastern Time schedule.



Solar, roofing, HVAC, insurance, real estate, home-improvement, telecommunications, or other U.S. home-services experience is strongly preferred.



DO NOT APPLY IF



• Your experience is limited to chat, social media, content, data entry, or general virtual-assistant work.

• You have not personally worked both inbound and outbound phone leads.

• You cannot provide real production numbers from a recent setting role.

• You need basic phone-sales training before you can make calls independently.

• You cannot work the stated Eastern Time schedule.

• You do not accept $6 USD/hour paid monthly.



HOW TO APPLY



Start the first line of your application exactly:



I understand the rate is $6 USD/hour paid monthly, and I can attend Friday, September 4 at 2:00 PM Eastern Time.



Then answer all six questions:



1. How many years of inbound and outbound appointment-setting experience do you have?

2. In your most recent role, how many inbound leads did you work per day and how many outbound calls did you make per day?

3. How many qualified appointments did you average per week or month, and what was your show rate?

4. Which dialers and CRMs have you used?

5. Describe one difficult objection you regularly handled and how you moved the conversation forward.

6. Which U.S. industries have you called, and what homeowner or buyer qualification criteria did you use?



Include a resume, proof of prior production, and a 90-120 second video audition. Applications without measurable phone-setting evidence or the requested video will not move forward.



REQUIRED SETTER VIDEO AUDITION



Record one continuous 90-120 second video. Start by stating your name, years of inbound and outbound phone-setting experience, and your most recent verified call and appointment numbers. Then complete this role-play:



A U.S. homeowner completed an online form asking about solar. When you call, the homeowner says, “I was just looking, I am busy, and I do not want a sales pitch.” Demonstrate how you would open the call, ask two or three useful qualification questions, respond to the objection, and ask for a scheduled appointment with a closer.



Do not read a generic script. We are evaluating tone, listening, control of the conversation, qualification, objection handling, and the clarity of the appointment ask. Do not invent savings, tax-credit eligibility, utility data, or promises that are not available in the scenario.



Also include a screenshot, dashboard excerpt, or written breakdown showing prior call volume, appointments set, and show rate. Redact customer names, phone numbers, addresses, and other private information.



The next stage includes a live phone role-play, a CRM-note exercise, and verification of the production claims in your application.

description:
SEO Strategist, Long-Term Freelance Support (30 hrs/week, UK Hours)



I'm a freelance SEO consultant with a portfolio of client accounts. There's more work than I can do alone, so I'm hiring an SEO specialist to assist long term.



I own the client relationships and I'll be delegating work to you. You won't have direct client contact, but everything you produce goes out under my name. I need someone I can trust with that, and who's comfortable working across several accounts quietly in the background. You'd work with me, and one other freelancer.



As trust builds, you'd take on more responsibility rather than more visibility. The role stays behind the scenes.



You'd be doing most of this work yourself. Writers, off-page specialists and designers handle their own parts, and you'd brief and QA them, but the SEO thinking and the bulk of the execution sits with you. Once a plan is agreed I need you to run with it and come to me when something needs a decision.



THE TERMS



- $600/month to start, reviewed on performance (negotiable for the right candidate)

- 30 hours/week, Monday to Friday, 9am to 3pm UK time. The UK changes clocks and the Philippines doesn't, so: late March to late October is 4pm to 10pm Manila; late October to late March is 5pm to 11pm Manila

- 10 to 20 paid days off per year, agreed in advance

- Good chance of moving to 40 hours a week with a pay increase if it goes well

- All tools provided. Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, Monday, AI subscriptions, everything you need. Some work runs through my own systems, which I'll set up and walk you through

- Long term. I'm hiring one person to grow with, not covering a short-term gap



Please read the hours carefully. This is an evening shift in the Philippines. If that doesn't suit your life, this isn't the right job.



WHAT YOU'D BE DOING



- Research and strategy. Keyword research and keyword clustering; search intent mapping; competitor and SERP analysis; topic and content gap analysis; building the roadmap for each account.

- On-page and content. Detailed content briefs a writer can execute without coming back with questions; QAing and editing drafts; title tags, meta descriptions and heading structure; content calendars; diagnosing decayed pages and running the refresh.

- Internal linking. Building internal linking maps; finding orphaned pages and wasted equity; anchor text planning; implementing the links.

- Technical SEO. Screaming Frog crawls and audits; indexation, crawlability and site structure; redirect mapping; schema; turning findings into prioritised fix lists and implementing what you can yourself.

- Off-page. Backlink analysis and competitor gap analysis; link prospecting; briefing off-page specialists on targets and anchors; Reddit seeding.

- Conversion. Landing page and sales page audits; recommendations on structure, copy, forms and CTAs.

- Reporting. Turning GA4, Search Console and Ahrefs data into monthly reporting and clear slide decks that explain what happened and why. Looker Studio or similar experience preferable.

- Local SEO. Google Business Profile optimisation and posting.

- AI search (AEO/GEO). Some work on visibility in ChatGPT, Perplexity and AI Overviews.

- Managing the moving parts. Planning across several accounts in Monday or simialr PM tool, briefing writers, off-page specialists and designers, chasing delivery, and QAing everything before it reaches a client. You are the quality bar on anything that goes out.



WHAT YOU NEED



Non-negotiable



- Communication skills. Great communication is essential. This is how we collaborate and work well together.

- Hands-on SEO. You do the work yourself: research, audits, on-page, internal linking, reporting. This is not an oversight role.

- Ahrefs. This is the tool we live in.

- Search Console and GA4. Enough to find cause and effect, not just export a report.

- Sheets or Excel, and Slides. Lookups, pivots, messy exports, and decks that read clearly.

- Written English. You'll brief and edit content, and draft things that go to clients under my name. Excellent, not passable.

- Organisation. Running several accounts at once without dropping things, and briefing and QAing the specialists who handle content, links and design.

- Proactivity. You take an agreed plan and run with it. You raise problems early instead of letting them surface later.

- Reliable, fast internet and a machine that can handle screen-sharing and remote sessions. Genuinely essential, not boilerplate.

- Systems thinking. When doing your work, you think 'how could we improve this process, or make it better, faster and easier next time'.



Preferred



- Monday or a similar project management tool, Screaming Frog, a CMS (WordPress or similar), Claude or ChatGPT daily.



Hands-on experience matters more to me than years on a CV. Agency experience across several accounts is a strong plus.



HOW YOU WORK



- You enjoy working with numbers and can explain what's driving a change, not just report that it happened.

- You check figures before you use them. If a number looks off, you find out why.

- You highlight when something's wrong rather than quietly working around it.

- You're comfortable doing excellent work you don't get public credit for.

- You handle client data and access carefully.

- You build systems, not just output. We already have a lot of SOPs and templates, and I want someone who adds to them. The more we document, the easier your job gets.



AI, LLMS AND AUTOMATION



I want someone building with it, not just chatting to it. If you're doing the same task two or three times, I want you thinking about how to make the next time faster: prompt engineering, custom projects, reusable workflows, small automations. You don't need to be there already, but you should want to get there. There's genuine room to learn here, and I can provide a Udemy subscription or similar if you want to go deeper on AI.



The other half of that: you own everything you send me. If you can't explain and defend the work, AI has slowed you down rather than sped you up. Using AI well means clear, detailed prompting up front, then careful QAing, checking and refining of what comes back. I support the use of AI, but we are responsible for what it produces.



HIRING PROCESS



- Apply. Send a CV plus a 2-minute Loom (details below).

- Paid task. If you progress to this stage, a realistic piece of work. $40, paid to everyone who completes and submits it, whether or not you're offered the role. Runs Thursday 10 September and takes 4 to 6 hours. If that date doesn't work, apply anyway and tell me which dates you're available. I can be flexible between 7 and 11 September.

- Follow-up questions, answered by video.

- Final stage interview.

- Offer. Because of the access involved, I'll ask for two contactable references, a signed NDA (non-disclosure agreement) and a copy of your government ID at this stage. I'll do the same in reverse so you know exactly who you're working with.



TO APPLY



Send your CV and a 2-minute Loom video (any video recording is fine), camera on, covering:



- Who you are and your SEO background. Detail and depth matter here.

- Specific projects or examples you're proud of, and specifically what you did on them.

- One question you'd want to ask me about this role.



Send the Loom video link and CV via a Google Drive link, with sharing set to 'anyone with the link can view'.



Not essential but preferred: to stand out, screen-share something you've built and are proud of.



Use 10 Apply Points so I know you've read this properly. Applications without a Loom won't be reviewed.

title: Video Editor (Short-Form) — Claude Code experience required
description:
Job Type: Full-Time Schedule: 5:00 AM – 1:00 PM EST (5:00 PM – 1:00 AM Philippine Time), Monday to Friday Starting Salary: $5/hr — negotiable upward based on the work



ABOUT THE ROLE



We're a growing marketing agency looking for a video editor to join our team long-term. This is not a one-off project — we want someone looking for stable, consistent work with a team that values and invests in its people.



Your main focus will be editing short-form content (Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts) that stops the scroll and drives engagement. You'll produce 2 finished pieces per day, so we need someone fast, reliable, and consistent without sacrificing quality.



This is not an entry-level editing position, and it's not a pure editing position either. We run our production pipeline with Claude Code, and you need to be able to work in it. If you've never opened a terminal, this role will be painful for you.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Editing 2 short-form videos per day from raw footage, scripts, or briefs

Adding motion graphics, animated captions, transitions, and sound design that match current short-form trends

Using Claude Code to automate the repetitive parts of your workflow — batch processing, file organization, ffmpeg jobs, transcript and caption pipelines, render prep, anything you'd otherwise do by hand 40 times a week

Using AI tools to speed up and enhance the creative side (AI captioning, voice tools, generative assets, upscaling)

Collaborating with our team during your shift for feedback and revisions

Occasionally helping with long-form projects (YouTube videos, webinars, client content)

REQUIREMENTS

Claude Code experience. Not "I've used ChatGPT." You've actually run Claude Code, given it a task, read what it produced, and fixed it when it was wrong. Tell us what you've built or automated with it.

Comfortable in a terminal and with basic scripting. You don't need to be a developer. You do need to not be scared of a command line, ffmpeg, or a Python script Claude Code writes for you.

Real editing software. Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve. Timeline editing, keyframes, masking, audio work.

Proven short-form experience — you understand hooks, pacing, retention editing, and platform-specific best practices.

Strong motion graphics skills (After Effects, Premiere with MOGRTs, or similar).

Able to work 5 AM – 1 PM EST consistently, Monday to Friday

Reliable internet and a computer that can actually handle video editing

Strong communication — responsive during work hours, proactive about asking questions

Looking for a long-term, stable position, not freelance side work

WHO THIS ISN'T FOR



Being direct so nobody wastes their time:



Entry-level editors. We don't have the bandwidth to teach editing fundamentals.

CapCut-only editors. If your workflow is CapCut templates, auto-captions, and one-tap mobile editing apps, you're below the bar for this role. CapCut Pro as one tool in a larger kit is fine. CapCut as the whole kit isn't.

Editors who won't touch technical tools. Half the value here is automating the boring 60% of the job. If that sounds like someone else's problem, it's not a fit.

BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE

Long-form editing experience (YouTube videos, podcasts, documentaries, course content) — this is a real plus, we'd rather hire someone who can carry a 20-minute video than someone who's only ever cut 30 seconds

Experience editing for marketing agencies or multiple client brands

Content repurposing experience (turning long-form into short-form clips)

Any automation, scripting, or pipeline-building you've done around video

WHY WORK WITH US

Long-term stability — we're hiring someone to grow with us, not a temporary gig

Consistent workload and predictable hours

A team that respects your time and skill

You'll get significantly better at AI-assisted production, because you'll be using it every day

HOW TO APPLY



To make sure you've read this posting carefully, start your application with the word "ARUGULA" and include:



A link to your portfolio or 3–5 examples of short-form videos you've edited (Google Drive, YouTube, or portfolio site)

Your Claude Code experience — what you've used it for, what you built or automated, and what went wrong the first time. Screenshots or a repo are welcome.

Which editing software and AI tools you use day to day

Confirmation that you can work 5 AM – 1 PM EST

(Optional) Examples of long-form videos you've edited



Applications without the keyword, portfolio links, or a real answer on Claude Code will not be considered.



We're excited to see your work.

This role is responsible for driving creative strategy end-to-end — from deep customer and market research, identifying new growth opportunities, developing creative hypotheses, creating high-quality briefs, analyzing performance insights, and building a scalable creative testing system.

title: Media Buyer, Paid Social
description:
NOTE: Please do not apply if you primarily have lead generation experience.



About Lucyd



Lucyd is a performance marketing and growth agency helping ambitious wellness brands scale through acquisition, retention, creative strategy, and conversion optimization.



We specialize in building scalable growth systems for brands operating in policy-constrained wellness, including hemp, cannabis, telehealth (including GLP-1s and research peptides), supplements, and functional wellness products.



We are more than an agency executing individual services. We operate as integrated growth partners embedded in our clients’ businesses, helping them solve challenges across the entire customer journey—from customer acquisition and retention to creative, websites, and conversion optimization.



Our team moves quickly, communicates transparently, and operates with a high level of ownership and accountability. We care deeply about outcomes, strategic thinking, operational excellence, and long-term client partnerships.



---



Why This Role Exists



The Media Buyer, Paid Social is responsible for bringing growth strategies to life through exceptional execution on Meta.



Working closely with a Growth Strategist, you’ll build, launch, optimize, and scale paid social campaigns that drive profitable growth for our clients. You’ll combine strong platform expertise with analytical thinking to make informed optimization decisions, uncover opportunities through data, and continuously improve campaign performance.



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys executing at a high level, thrives in fast-paced environments, and takes pride in operational excellence.



---



Working in Complex Advertising Environments



Lucyd specializes in helping brands grow in industries where advertising is rarely straightforward.



Many of our clients operate in highly regulated or policy-constrained categories, including hemp-derived cannabinoids, cannabis-adjacent products, telehealth services, GLP-1s, peptides, supplements, and functional wellness products.



Success in these industries requires more than platform expertise. It requires curiosity, adaptability, strategic thinking, and a willingness to challenge conventional approaches while operating within evolving platform policies.



We are looking for someone who enjoys solving complex advertising challenges and can consistently find innovative ways to help clients scale responsibly.



---



What You’ll Own



Campaign Execution & Optimization



- Build, launch, manage, and optimize Meta advertising campaigns across a portfolio of DTC ecommerce clients.

- Execute testing plans across audiences, creatives, placements, budgets, and campaign structures.

- Monitor campaign performance daily and make data-driven optimization decisions that improve efficiency and profitability.

- Manage campaign budgets and pacing while maintaining alignment with client performance goals.

- Troubleshoot campaign delivery issues, tracking discrepancies, and platform-related challenges.



Performance Analysis



- Analyze campaign performance using Meta Ads Manager and supporting analytics platforms.

- Identify trends across creative, messaging, audiences, offers, and funnel performance.

- Understand *why* creative is succeeding or underperforming, using performance data to generate actionable insights.

- Monitor key performance metrics including MER, aMER, CAC, bCAC, CPA, CPM, and other leading indicators.

- Prepare performance updates and reporting for internal stakeholders and client-facing meetings.



Cross-Functional Collaboration



- Partner closely with Growth Strategists to execute paid media strategies across assigned accounts.

- Collaborate with Creative teams by providing data-backed recommendations for new concepts, messaging angles, hooks, offers, and creative testing opportunities.

- Contribute ideas during creative strategy discussions while helping ensure creative testing aligns with account priorities.

- Communicate proactively with internal teams regarding campaign performance, blockers, and opportunities.

- Participate in client calls as needed and communicate confidently in written client updates.



---



What Success Looks Like



Successful Media Buyers consistently:



- Execute campaigns accurately, efficiently, and with exceptional attention to detail.

- Achieve client MER, aMER, CAC and bCAC goals through disciplined optimization and testing.

- Move quickly while maintaining a high standard of quality.

- Communicate proactively and collaborate effectively across teams.

- Complete work reliably, follow established processes, and demonstrate strong operational excellence.

- Use data to identify opportunities, solve problems, and improve performance over time.



---



What You Bring to the Table



Required



- 3+ years of experience managing Meta advertising for DTC ecommerce brands.

- Agency experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously.

- Experience managing six-figure monthly Meta advertising budgets.

- Strong understanding of Meta Ads Manager, campaign structure, audience strategy, and optimization best practices.

- Experience working with Shopify and/or WooCommerce ecommerce brands.

- Ability to analyze creative performance and identify the drivers behind winning and losing campaigns.

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data and make informed optimization decisions.

- Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Strong written communication skills and comfort participating in client meetings when needed.

- Experience working successfully in a remote environment.

- Ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.



Preferred



- Experience working with third-party attribution platforms such as Triple Whale, Northbeam, Hyros, or similar.

- Experience advertising within policy-constrained wellness industries, including hemp, cannabis, telehealth (GLP-1s, peptides), supplements, and functional wellness.

- Experience managing campaigns on TikTok, X, or Snapchat.

- Familiarity with GA4 and ecommerce analytics.

- Experience collaborating closely with creative teams on performance marketing initiatives.



---



Who Thrives at Lucyd



Successful Paid Social Media Buyers at Lucyd are proactive, detail-oriented operators who enjoy turning strategy into execution.



They are analytical, adaptable, and naturally curious about what drives performance. They communicate clearly, take ownership of their work, and move quickly without sacrificing quality. They thrive in collaborative environments, enjoy solving complex problems with data, and embrace continuous learning as advertising platforms evolve.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer / Software Engineer (Web Apps & API Integrations)
description:
Job Title:

Senior Full Stack Developer / Software Engineer (Web Apps & API Integrations) – Long-Term Freelance £15 per hour, capped at 37 hours per week



Job Description:

We are an established UK based marketing agency who specialise in the Automotive sector. We are moving quickly to streamline our operations, automate internal workflows, and launch new digital products for our clients. We have a clear pipeline of major projects mapped out for the next 12 to 24 months.

We are seeking a talented, independent Remote Senior Full Stack Developer from the Philippines to join us as a long-term freelance partner.

This role requires a true generalist. You will have technical ownership of our software pipeline, building highly secure internal management systems as well as polished, intuitive, customer-facing web applications.

Our tech stack is already established. Our current development is built on a modern TypeScript stack: Next.js/React applications hosted on Vercel, back-end services hosted on Railway, a PostgreSQL database managed through Neon, and all code version-controlled in GitHub. You will be joining projects mid-development, so you must be comfortable picking up an existing codebase on this stack, and any recommendations for new tools or services should fit alongside it.

This is an ongoing, flexible freelance arrangement focused entirely on deliverables and outcomes.



Key Projects & Deliverables for Year 1:



You will design, build, and launch a mix of external customer portals and internal operations systems:

• OEM Test Drive Platform (Consumer and client-facing): Development has already begun on this project using the stack above; we need you to complete the project into a polished, user-friendly external application optimised for customers to be invited to, book, manage, and track vehicle test drives.

• Sales Event Reporting App (Client-facing): Build a secure client portal that extracts data from our proprietary internal systems and translates it into clean, real-time visual reports and dashboards for our customers.

• HR & Office Operations System (Internal): Create a centralised internal portal to manage employee absences, holiday requests, sickness tracking, a shared office diary, meeting room bookings, and attendance registers. Plus an automated reporting suite.

• Bespoke Task Management System (Internal): Build a robust internal workflow tool that allows managers to allocate tasks, filter by client, track deadlines, and seamlessly toggle between list, calendar, and Kanban views.

• Third-Party API Integrations (Automotive Stack): Build secure, reliable API bridges connecting our marketing infrastructure into automotive dealership systems, specifically Dealerweb and Tekion initially.

• CRM & Automation Pipelines (Internal/External): Integrate data flows between core systems to automatically trigger real-time, transactional
 and SMS notifications to customers based on workflow changes.



What We Are Looking For:

• Core Stack Experience (Essential): Strong, proven experience with TypeScript/JavaScript, React and Next.js, and PostgreSQL databases. You should be able to demonstrate real projects built with these technologies.

• Our Platforms (Desirable): Direct experience with Vercel, Railway, Neon, and GitHub is a strong plus. Experience with close equivalents (e.g. other cloud hosting platforms or managed Postgres providers) is acceptable, as these tools are straightforward to pick up for an experienced developer.

• Full-Stack Versatility: Proven experience building both complex, data-heavy internal company tools and simple to use, responsive, customer-facing web applications.

• API & Integration Expertise: Strong experience connecting different software platforms via APIs and webhooks (especially experience with restricted or complex third-party systems).

• Security-First Approach: Sound understanding of web application security fundamentals — secure authentication, safe handling of secrets and credentials, and protecting customer data in line with UK GDPR requirements.

• User-First Mindset: An understanding of good user interface (UI) and user experience (UX) principles so that our customer-facing platforms look professional and are easy to use.

• Independence & English Fluency: Ability to take a business concept described in plain English, translate it into a working technical solution without micro-management, and communicate clearly throughout the process.

• Your Own Setup: You must use your own development equipment and have a reliable, high-speed internet connection.



Contract Structure & Compensation:



• Type: Indefinite, ongoing freelance contract

• Flexibility: Includes a standard, simple 14-day or 30-day "at-will" termination clause for both parties.

• Target Budget: Fully open to a competitive monthly retainer or hourly structure equivalent to £15+/hour depending on depth of experience.

• Tax/Compliance: As an independent freelancer, you will manage your own local Philippine tax and government benefit filings.

• Account Access: All platform accounts (GitHub, Vercel, Railway, Neon) are owned and administered by the company; you will be granted team member access for the duration of the engagement.

description:
Hello! We are a growing UK women’s ecommerce fashion brand looking for an experienced Social Media Manager to take day-to-day ownership of our organic social content while also creating graphics, managing creative assets, carrying out creative research and assisting with paid media execution.



This is a hands-on role. You will not simply repost finished content. You will use our photography, UGC, video and existing creative assets to build engaging posts, write captions, create graphics where needed, maintain the content calendar and make sure our channels feel active, current and on-brand working closely with the founders and specialist video editors.



What You’ll Own

1. Social Media Content & Community

- Own the day-to-day content calendar and keep posting consistent across
, Instagram, TikTok and other channels.

- Create, write, schedule and publish posts using approved photography, UGC, video and designed assets.

- Choose the strongest content, adapt it appropriately for each platform and repurpose good assets without the feed feeling repetitive.

- Create Stories, carousels, promotional posts, product-led posts, reposts, polls and other native social content.

- Respond to comments and community activity, escalating customer-service issues where needed.

- Use recurring customer questions, objections and feedback to generate useful social and advertising ideas and share basic organic learnings with the team.



2. Graphic Design

- Create attractive, commercially strong social and ecommerce graphics using Canva or similar tools.

- Produce promotional graphics, product posts, Stories, simple carousels, review/testimonial graphics and static ad creative.

- Resize and adapt creative for different placements while keeping branding consistent and bringing fresh ideas and good visual judgement.



3. Asset Management & Creative Research

- Keep photography, UGC, raw video, finished creative, reviews and product assets organised, correctly named and easy to find.

- Research competitors, Meta Ad Library, Instagram, TikTok, etc for relevant ideas, hooks, formats and trends.

- Explain why an idea is useful and how it could apply to our brand rather than simply saving examples.

- Identify winning themes, hooks and formats to inform future content

- Identify content gaps, such as products lacking lifestyle photography, creator content, reviews or suitable video, and flag them to the team.



4. Paid Media Assistance

Supporting role only - you will not be responsible for paid-media strategy or budgets

- Upload approved image and video ads using supplied structures and naming conventions.

- Add the correct creative, primary text, headline, URL, CTA and complete final checks before launch.

- Assist with marketing copy for ads, organic posts and promotional messages

- Spot organic posts, UGC and social content that could be repurposed or tested as paid ads



Essential Experience

- Previous professional experience managing social media for a brand or ecommerce business, particularly
 and Instagram.

- Evidence that you have personally created posts, written captions, scheduled/published content and managed day-to-day community activity.

- Strong Canva or equivalent graphic-design skills and the ability to produce polished social content without constant direction.

- Good visual judgement and an understanding of what makes fashion/ecommerce content current, engaging and commercially useful.

- Strong organisation and follow-through across content calendars, assets, deadlines and multiple priorities.

- Excellent written and spoken English and confidence researching ideas, spotting gaps and bringing suggestions independently.

- Able to work UK business hours and commit to 35 hours per week as your primary role.



Strongly Preferred

- Experience with fashion, apparel, activewear, beauty or another consumer ecommerce brand.

- Experience creating content for a UK, US or Australian audience.

- Pinterest and TikTok experience, including native formats and content planning.

- Experience with social scheduling tools

- Meta Ads Manager experience, particularly uploading/launching approved ads.

- Meta Ad Library/creative-research experience and basic Shopify familiarity.

- CapCut or similar simple video-editing skills are useful.



The Person We’re Looking For

- Creative but commercially minded: you care about what looks good and what gets attention, engagement and sales.

- Proactive and organised: you notice when content is running low, something is missing or a deadline is approaching and act before being chased.

- Confident making day-to-day decisions while knowing when something needs founder approval.

- Detail-oriented enough to catch the wrong link, wrong image, outdated asset or obvious error before it goes live.

- Interested in fashion, social media and ecommerce and enjoys keeping up with what brands are doing well.



How to Apply

- Send your CV.

- Share links or examples of social content and graphics you have personally created. A portfolio, Canva examples or anonymised work is welcome where confidentiality applies.

- Answer the following questions (**A LOOM VIDEO IS HIGHLY ADVISED TO STAND OUT IN THE APPLICATION PROCESS**):

1) Tell us about your biggest success managing a social media account. What did you change, what happened as a result and by how much did followers, engagement or other key metrics increase?

2) If you were given a folder of product photography, UGC and customer content, how would you d
 what to post on social media?



Please include the word “alpaca” somewhere in your application so we know you have read the full job description.



Hiring Process

Stage 1: CV, Loom and portfolio/relevant-experience review.

Stage 2: Short practical covering social content, graphic design and organisation.

Stage 3: Video interview.

Final stage: Short paid trial before continuing if we're all happy

title: General Program Manager
description:
To be considered, you must fill out the application form below:


/ansiblehealth/4b610b44-ac59-43da-a514-ca69e2cce9c3



We are seeking a dynamic and talented General Program Manager to join our team. This role is perfect for a highly intelligent, motivated individual who is passionate about leveraging technology to make a difference in healthcare.



What is Ansible Health?

Ansible Health unites physicians, nurses, respiratory therapists, and tech experts from Columbia, Johns Hopkins, Google, Amazon, and other top institutions to revolutionize care for chronic disease patients. We combine elite clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology to deliver personalized, efficient care at scale. Our team's groundbreaking research, published in leading journals like Nature and PLOS, demonstrates our commitment to innovation. Backed by Bessemer, First Round Capital, AlleyCorp, Breyer Capital, and Inflect Capital, we're a Series A startup partnering with leading healthcare systems nationwide. Our mission is to genuinely improve patient outcomes, not just optimize metrics. If you're passionate about transforming healthcare through technology, join our diverse team in making a real impact.



The Job at a Glance

We're seeking a super smart, hungry, and resilient individual who is passionate about technology and healthcare to join us as a Program Manager. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and brings a strong organizational mindset to complex projects. You will be responsible for overseeing multiple complex programs across various departments to ensure successful delivery within scope, timeline, and budget. This role requires a self-motivated individual who can work independently and adapt to the dynamic nature of a growing startup in the healthcare technology space.



Responsibilities

- Impact the strategy and execution for AnsibleHealth's general operations, clinical operations, and technology initiatives, working closely with cross-functional teams.

- Work independently on projects through the full life cycle, overseeing clinical, operational, and technology aspects.

- Develop and manage program plans, schedules, budgets, and resource allocation to ensure successful delivery.

- Define program scope, objectives, and success criteria in collaboration with stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

- Establish program governance structures and processes, including risk management, issue management, and change management.

- Monitor and report on program progress, status, and performance to stakeholders and executive leadership.

- Ensure effective communication and alignment with stakeholders at all levels.

- Continuously identify and mitigate program risks and issues.

- Facilitate program-related meetings and workshops.

- Develop and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders to drive program success and identify growth opportunities.

- Bring a continuous improvement mindset to our operations to ensure we're ready to scale.

- Anticipate issues, propose solutions, manage dependencies, and identify areas for tool/process improvement.

- Collaborate with and steer internal teams, including Marketing, Engineering, Program Management, and Clinical Operations.



The ideal candidate should be comfortable to be in a constantly changing role with a high level of ambiguity - as we are a fast-moving startup operating in an ever-evolving environment. He or she should have excellent analytical, communication and management skills to succeed in this role.



Education

Bachelor's degree from one of the top five universities in the Philippines.



Required Qualifications and competencies

- Fresh graduates are welcome to apply; 0-5 years of relevant work experience is an advantage but not required.

- Demonstrated passion for technology and ability to quickly adapt to new digital tools and platforms.

- Exceptional organizational skills.

- Resilient mindset with the ability to bounce back from challenges and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

- Keen interest in healthcare and improving patient outcomes; prior healthcare experience is a plus but not mandatory.

- High intellectual curiosity and a hunger for personal and professional development.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think critically and creatively.

- Proficiency in Google Workspace and willingness to learn new software tools as needed.

- Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.

- Adaptable and comfortable with ambiguity in a startup environment.

- Eagerness to take on leadership roles and initiative to drive projects forward.

- Ability to influence and collaborate with stakeholders at all levels.

- Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality work.

- Enthusiasm for continuous learning and process improvement.



The ideal candidate is a highly intelligent, motivated individual who is passionate about leveraging technology to make a difference in healthcare. We're looking for someone who can bring fresh perspectives, adapt quickly to new challenges, and contribute to our innovative and fast-paced work environment.



Job Details

Full-time: Full-time: 40 hours a week

Benefits: Flexible PTO and HMO coverage

Location: Remote (offshore, and willing to work US hours - EST/EDT)

title: QA / Test Engineer
description:
To be considered, you must fill out the application form below:





About the role

We're a fast-growing telehealth company, and we're looking for a QA / Test Engineer to own product quality end to end. You'll test features before they ship, own our release process, and keep our bug backlog under control so the team can move quickly without compromising quality.



This is a hands-on role that goes beyond manual testing. You'll own the path from "code complete" to "safely released" across our web and mobile products.



What you'll do

• Run end-to-end tests on new features before release across our web and mobile applications.

• Own the release process: test staging builds, run the final quality gate before ship, and help us move toward faster, more frequent releases.

• Develop risk-based test plans for critical telehealth workflows, including patient-facing experiences, privacy-sensitive functionality, and high-impact production changes.

• Perform mobile device testing on Android, including reproducing and verifying device-specific issues.

• Triage, track, and manage bugs, driving them to closure and keeping the backlog under control.

• Partner with engineering and product to define test coverage and prioritize issues.

• Build and maintain automated tests to expand coverage and speed up regression testing.



What we're looking for

• Solid QA / software testing experience, ideally in a fast-moving product environment.

• Experience writing and improving test automation and test infrastructure, including using AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) to build and improve automation.

• Hands-on Android device testing experience.

• Comfortable testing web applications end to end.

• Experience working across dev, staging, and production environments and with release processes.

• Strong bug tracking, test case management, and triage skills.

• Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the judgment to distinguish release-blocking issues from minor ones.

• Able to drive quality independently while partnering closely with engineering and product.



Nice to have

• Healthcare or telehealth experience.

• Familiarity with mobile device management (MDM).

• Experience helping a team move toward a continuous release cycle.

title: Meta Ads Specialist (Facebook / Instagram) — Digital Marketing Agency
description:
About the role



Coffee Stout Media is a digital marketing agency serving chiropractic, acupuncture, wellness, and local service businesses. We are formalizing Meta Ads as a core service line and need a specialist who can run campaigns end to end for our client base.



This is not a "set it and forget it" role. Clients need active management, creative testing, and clear reporting.



What you'll work on

Campaign setup and structure — building out Meta campaigns for chiropractic and wellness clients, including offer-based campaigns (example: SoftWave therapy promotions)

Creative testing — running structured ad creative and copy tests, not just launching one ad and hoping

Audience and targeting — building and refining audiences for local service businesses

Budget management and optimization — monitoring spend, CPL, and ROAS daily and adjusting

Landing page and funnel awareness — working with our team to make sure ad traffic lands somewhere built to convert

Client reporting — contributing to our reporting framework so clients can see performance clearly, not just vanity metrics

Conversions API (CAPI) setup — implementing and maintaining server-side tracking to improve match rates and reporting accuracy

Troubleshooting — pixel issues, tracking gaps, CAPI errors, ad account flags or disapprovals

Requirements

2+ years hands-on experience managing Meta Ads for clients (not just your own business or a single account)

Can speak fluently in CPL, ROAS, CAC, conversion rate, and funnel terms

Experience with lead generation campaigns for local or service-based businesses

Comfortable with Meta Ads Manager, Events Manager, and basic pixel/conversion troubleshooting

Experience setting up Conversions API (server-side tracking), either directly or through a tag manager / integration like GTM or Zapier

Strong written English for client-facing reporting and internal updates

Must be able to work US Eastern Time hours, approximately 9am-5pm EST

Nice to have

Experience with chiropractic, medical, or wellness clients

Experience working alongside GoHighLevel (GHL) for lead routing and nurture

Familiarity with GA4 and basic attribution concepts

Experience managing multiple ad accounts at once (we run close to 80 client accounts)

What we offer

Long-term, ongoing position with a growing service line, not a short-term project

Clear reporting frameworks and SOPs already in place

Direct communication with agency leadership



How to apply



Please include:



Screenshots or a Loom walkthrough of a Meta Ads account you managed, with results (CPL, ROAS, or lead volume)

Your available hours in EST



A short note on how you approach creative testing, improving data quality, etc.



Applications without real account examples will not be considered.

Cross-Team Collaboration

- Partner with product, marketing and engineering teams to ensure we are tracking the right data

What We're Looking For

Experience

- Minimum 5 years experience in a Data Analyst role

- Experience working with product, digital or performance marketing data

title: TikTok Growth Specialist — Grow Account to 5,000+ Followers
description:
We’re looking for an experienced **TikTok Growth Specialist** to help rapidly grow an existing TikTok account to **5,000+ real, engaged followers**.



This is not a “buy followers” job. We want someone who understands how TikTok works and can execute a legitimate organic growth strategy while keeping the account healthy.



**Your responsibilities:**



* Develop and execute a strategy to reach 5,000+ followers as quickly as realistically possible

* Research viral content, trends, competitors, hooks, keywords, and formats within our niche

* Help determine what content we should post and how frequently

* Optimize captions, hashtags, SEO, posting times, and engagement

* Identify content that is gaining traction and help us double down on what works

* Engage strategically with relevant accounts and audiences

* Track follower growth and key performance metrics

* Keep all growth methods compliant with TikTok policies



**Requirements:**



* Proven experience organically growing TikTok accounts

* Strong understanding of the TikTok algorithm and current growth strategies

* Experience taking newer/smaller accounts to 5K–10K+ followers

* Ability to show examples or screenshots of accounts you have grown

* No bots, purchased followers, fake engagement, follow/unfollow automation, or other risky tactics

* Reliable communication and ability to move quickly



**When applying, please include:**



1. Examples of TikTok accounts you have personally helped grow

2. Starting and ending follower counts

3. How long the growth took

4. The strategy you would use to get our account to 5,000 followers

5. Your estimated timeline to reach 5K



**Goal:** Reach 5,000+ legitimate, relevant TikTok followers quickly while building an account that continues to grow after the project is completed.



There is potential for ongoing work if you perform well.

title: eCommerce Video Editor Application - Moon Nude
description:
About Moon Nude

Moon Nude is a fast-growing direct-to-consumer brand selling beautifully designed, handmade products — makeup bags, hair tool bags, duffels, backpacks and more. Our primary market is the United States, alongside a growing international presence. We're building an in-house creative team and moving off agencies, and this role turns our creative concepts into the scroll-stopping video that drives our growth.



The Role



You turn raw footage and UGC into high-performing short-form video ads that sell. Working from a creative strategist's briefs inside a creative pod, you'll produce a high volume of paid-social video — primarily for Meta, plus TikTok and other channels — and iterate fast on what's winning. This is a performance role: we care about ads that scale, not just ads that look good.





What You'll Do

• Edit ads end to end: cut UGC and raw footage into DR and brand video ads — hooks, pacing,

captions/subtitles, sound design, and light motion.

• Iterate at volume: produce many variations and fresh iterations of winning concepts, quickly.

• Repurpose: resize and adapt creative across placements and aspect ratios.

• Move fast: turn briefs around quickly and fold in feedback from strategists and performance data.

• Stay organized: keep footage, assets, and project files tidy and easy to hand off.





What We're Looking For

• Proven eCom/DTC ad editing: a portfolio of paid-social ads you've cut that actually performed.

• Fast and high-volume: you ship a lot without dropping quality.

• Hook & retention instinct: you understand what makes someone stop scrolling and buy — not just what looks nice.

• Tools: fluent in CapCut and/or Premiere Pro, plus After Effects for light motion.

• Performance mindset: comfortable being measured on results and iterating from data.

• Remote-ready: self-managing, reliable, with strong English.



Nice to Have

• Experience sourcing or directing UGC creators.

• Comfort with AI editing and production tools.





The Details

• Type: Full-time.

• Compensation: performance-based — a base plus a bonus for every creative you produce that scales.

Reports To: Founder/Managing Director



About Us:

To All My Black Girls is a UK-based e-commerce hair brand created for women with Afro, curly and textured hair. We are a customer-focused brand that combines premium quality with education, representation and a strong sense of community. Our relationship with our customers feels like that of a trusted friend giving advice and hot tips. Our communication is warm, relatable and never overly corporate or constantly sales-driven, and we aim to reflect this across all our marketing content.



The Role:

We are looking for an experienced and commercially focused
 Marketing Manager to take full ownership of our Klaviyo
 marketing.

We are looking for an all-round
 marketing expert who understands how to build a profitable
 channel that generates measurable revenue, increases conversions and strengthens customer retention.

You will manage the complete
 marketing process, including strategy, planning, copywriting, design, campaign execution, automation, list growth, testing and performance analysis.

The right person will be creative, analytical and commercially minded, with a strong understanding of how to sell through
 while creating content that feels natural, valuable and relatable to our customers.



Key Responsibilities:

Own the complete Klaviyo
 strategy and campaign calendar, aligned with sales goals, promotions and product launches.

Plan, write, design, build, test and schedule engaging campaigns that educate customers, strengthen the brand and generate revenue.

Audit, build and optimise automated flows, using segmentation and personalisation based on customer behaviour, engagement and purchase history.

Grow and maintain an engaged subscriber list through effective sign-up forms, pop-ups, incentives and list-management strategies.

Analyse performance and use A/B testing to improve revenue, conversions, repeat purchases and customer lifetime value while maintaining strong deliverability, database health and GDPR compliance.

Experience and Skills

At least 2–3 years’ experience managing Klaviyo
 marketing for an e-commerce brand.

Proven success generating revenue and conversions through campaigns and automated flows—not simply designing attractive
s.

Ability to use AI tools effectively to improve efficiency without compromising quality or brand voice.

Experience within the beauty, hair, fashion or lifestyle industry would be beneficial.



Measures of Success:

Performance will be assessed against key metrics including:

-attributed revenue and revenue per recipient.

Campaign and automated-flow conversion ra$tes.

Growth in repeat purchases and customer retention.

Subscriber-list growth and engagement.

 deliverability and database health.

Continuous improvement through testing and optimisation.



How to Apply

Please send your CV and a Loom video walking us through examples of your most successful
 campaigns and flows.

title: Multimedia AI Specialist
description:
We’re looking for a Multimedia AI Specialist to support Jumper Media’s social media and marketing content for our client accounts. You’ll help bring ideas to life through strong editing, pacing, and storytelling—creating polished videos that are on-brand, on-strategy, and ready for fast-paced publishing.



If you’re passionate about content, editing, and using AI-assisted workflows to make high-performing videos—and you want to make a visible impact inside a fast-growing digital agency—we’d love to meet you.



What You’ll Do



- Edit a high volume of short-form social videos each week, keeping pace with a busy multi-platform posting schedule

- Create content for multiple formats and channels, including:

    - TikTok / IG Reels

    - Video cutdowns and repurposed clips for Instagram

    - YouTube videos (when needed) + thumbnails

    - Simple motion/animated elements (text, overlays, transitions) when required

- Turn raw footage into engaging edits with strong hooks, pacing, and retention-focused structure

- Add and style captions/subtitles, on-screen text, and basic graphics as needed

- Use AI tools to speed up and improve production quality (e.g., captioning, transcript-based editing, cleanup, cutdowns, ideation, workflow automation) while keeping edits natural and on-brand

- Follow brand guidelines and maintain consistent visual/audio quality (fonts, colors, templates, music/SFX levels)

- Deliver work quickly and consistently—balancing daily turnaround edits with occasional longer-form projects

- Quality-check everything before delivery: clean cuts, no typos in captions, correct framing, synced audio, crisp exports

- Manage overlapping deadlines while collaborating with the team via Slack/Trello/Drive



Who You Are



- 2+ years of video editing experience (social media/marketing/content editing preferred)

- A portfolio that proves you can deliver volume + speed + polish and demonstrates AI expertise

- Proficient with at least one editing tool (any is fine): Premiere Pro, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro

- Comfortable using AI-assisted editing tools/workflows (or a strong willingness to learn and adopt them fast)

- Strong sense of timing, storytelling, trends, and what performs on short-form platforms

- Detail-obsessed—you don’t let mistakes slip through

- Able to work under tight deadlines while meeting high-quality standards

- Available during PST business hours (night shift in the Philippines)

- Reliable, self-motivated, and takes direction well



Bonus Points



- Basic motion graphics skills (After Effects or similar)

- Experience working with U.S.-based remote teams

- Familiarity with Slack, Trello, and Google Drive

- Experience using AI tools for editing (captions, transcript-based editing, audio cleanup, cutdowns, etc.)



Compensation & Schedule



- Starts at $5/hr (with opportunities for rate increases over time based on performance)

- ~30 hours/week

- Must be available during PST hours

- Independent contractor role (long-term)



How to Apply



 
 with:  



- A link to your portfolio (required) — must include AI-related examples, such as at least one video that used AI tools/workflows, plus a quick note on what AI tool(s) were used and what you used them for (e.g., captions, transcript-based editing, cleanup, cutdowns, background removal, generative elements, etc.)

- A short intro and summary of your experience



Note: Applications without a portfolio that shows AI expertise (AI-assisted video example required) will not be considered.

title: Creative Strategist – DTC Ecommerce | Remote
description:
About us

Pullpy is a fast-growing European oral-care brand doing over €1M in annual revenue with a very lean team.



We are now building a stronger creative team to scale our paid advertising and grow internationally.



We are looking for a Creative Strategist who is obsessed with understanding why ads work, finding new customer angles, researching competitors, writing hooks and turning ideas into clear briefs for creators and editors.



This is NOT a social media manager role.



You will work directly with the founder and help build the creative engine behind our growth.



Your responsibilities



Research competitors, customers, reviews, Reddit, TikTok and Meta Ad Library

Find new customer personas, pain points and marketing angles

Write strong hooks, scripts and ad concepts

Create detailed briefs for UGC creators and video editors

Analyze winning and losing ads

Understand metrics such as CTR, CPA, CVR, ROAS, hook rate and creative fatigue

Turn winning ads into new variations and iterations

Help develop advertorial and landing-page concepts

Organize creative learnings so we keep improving every week

Produce a consistent pipeline of new creative ideas



What we are looking for



Strong English

Very curious and creative

Understands direct-response marketing

Experience with DTC ecommerce, Meta Ads or performance marketing is highly preferred

Able to explain WHY an ad works, not just whether it looks good

Comfortable working with data

Fast learner

Highly organized

Takes ownership

Can work independently

Interested in brands, psychology, advertising and consumer behavior



You do not need 10 years of experience.



We would rather hire someone young, hungry and highly analytical who wants to become world-class at DTC creative strategy.



You are probably a good fit if you spend your free time:



Studying
/Instagram ads

Saving interesting TikTok ads

Looking at DTC brands

Studying hooks and copywriting

Watching ecommerce/marketing content

Reverse-engineering why people buy products



You are NOT a good fit if:



Your main experience is posting organic Instagram content

You mainly design Canva posts

You think branding is more important than sales performance

You dislike analyzing numbers

You need someone to constantly tell you what to do



Example of what you might work on



Instead of simply saying:



“Create an ad about fresh breath.”



We want someone who can think like:



Persona: Heavy coffee drinker

Problem: Mouth feels dirty after coffee

Situation: Morning commute before work

Angle: Brushing alone doesn't make their mouth feel completely clean

Hook: “If you drink coffee every morning, try this before brushing your teeth.”

Format: UGC morning routine

Next test: Same concept with 5 different hooks and 3 different creators



That is the level of thinking we are looking for.



What success looks like

You consistently help us generate:



New personas

New angles

New hooks

New ad concepts

Strong iterations of existing winning ads



Your work will be tested with real advertising spend, so you will quickly see what works and what doesn't.



Compensation

Full-time remote role.



Starting compensation depending on experience:



$1,000–$3,000+ USD/month

title: Klaviyo Campaign Manager
description:
We're looking for one
 copywriter to take full ownership of our Klaviyo account: daily campaigns, the entire flow architecture, segmentation, testing, reporting. Not "help with
." Own it.



Who we are



We're a DTC health and beauty brand selling to women and men aged 45–75.



Cold traffic from Meta into direct response funnels — advertorials, VSLs, long-form sales pages. Running since 2023, multiple products live across several markets.



We're a direct response shop. Everything is measured. Nothing is decorative. Our copy has a job and the job is revenue.



The list is there. The traffic is there. The products convert.
 is the most underworked asset we own — which is exactly why we want one person on it full-time instead of squeezing it in between everything else.



What you'll actually do



Daily campaigns. You write and send to the list every day. Not "a few times a week when there's a promo." Daily. Story
s, offer
s, curiosity
s, urgency
s, re-engagement
s, plain-text
s that read like a message from a friend. You own the calendar.



Flows. You own and continuously improve the full Klaviyo flow architecture — welcome series, abandoned cart, abandoned checkout, browse abandonment, post-purchase, subscription retention, winback. Not "set it and forget it." Tested, iterated, rewritten.



Segmentation and list health. Engagement tiers, sunsetting, deliverability. You keep the list clean and the sends landing.



Testing. Subject lines, offers, angles, send times. You bring the hypotheses, you run the tests, you report what won.



Reporting. A short weekly number: revenue generated, open and click rates, what you tested, what you're shipping next week.



The copy standard



I'm a direct response copywriter myself. I will read your
s closely and I will tell you exactly what's wrong with them.



What I want:



Subject lines built on curiosity, specificity, or self-interest — not clever wordplay

s written to one person, not to a list

Story and mechanism-driven copy, not "Shop our bestsellers 🔥"

One idea per
, one clear CTA

Copy that respects that our customer is 45–75, not a 24-year-old on TikTok

Voice-of-customer language pulled from reviews and support tickets, not invented in your head



What I don't want:



Template
s with a product grid and a discount code

ChatGPT output pasted in with a hero image on top

"Hi [First Name], hope you're having a great week!"

s that could be sent by any brand in any category



If you know Schwartz's awareness levels and can tell me which stage a given
 is written for, we'll get along fine.



Requirements

Proven Klaviyo experience. You've owned an account end to end — campaigns, flows, segments, deliverability — not just written copy someone else scheduled.

Native or near-native English writing. Your
s go out unedited. If I have to rewrite them, the arrangement doesn't work for either of us.

Direct response background. Health, beauty, supplements, or info products preferred. If your experience is fashion drops and B2B newsletters, this will be a hard adjustment.

You can write fast. Daily sending means daily writing. If a single
 takes you four hours, the math doesn't work for you.

Reliable internet and daily availability.
s don't skip days.

What it pays



This is a revenue share, not a retainer: 5% of every euro Klaviyo attributes to the
s you write and send. Uncapped, for as long as you're the one running the account.



At €50,000 in a month that's €2,500. At €150,000 it's €7,500. Nobody caps you, nobody renegotiates you down, and nobody takes the account away from you because you got too expensive. It suits someone who backs their own copy and would rather own the upside than trade it for a fixed fee.



How to apply



Send your application with all two of these. Applications missing any of them get archived without a reply.



1. Klaviyo attribution screenshots. Screenshots from inside Klaviyo showing revenue you generated — campaign performance, flow performance, or the account overview. Blur the client name if you need to; I don't need to know who they are, I need to see the numbers are real. Include the date range.



2. Three
s you wrote. Actual sent
s, not spec work. One campaign, one flow
, and one of your choice. Tell me in one line what each one was supposed to do and whether it did it.



The process

I review applications and reply to the ones that clear the bar.

Short call to talk through the account, the products, and the numbers.

You write two campaign
s on a real product. Paid at the revenue share rate if we send them.

If they perform, you take the account.



No unpaid test that runs for three weeks. Two
s, we send them, you get paid on what they earn.

title: Supplychain manager
description:
Supply Chain & Fulfillment Assistant – E-commerce



We're looking for ONE experienced Supply Chain & Fulfillment Assistant to manage the daily fulfillment and shipping operations for our online fashion brand.



This is a part-time role of approximately 1 hour per day.



About the role:



* Part-time: approximately 1 hour per day

* Fixed salary: $120 USD per month

* Fully remote

* Long-term opportunity

* Possibility to combine this role with Customer Service for additional hours and responsibilities if you have relevant experience



Your responsibilities:



You will be responsible for making sure orders are fulfilled correctly and delivered to customers on time.



Your daily responsibilities include:



* Checking supplier invoices and cross-checking them with Shopify orders

* Making sure the correct products, sizes and quantities are being fulfilled

* Checking fulfillment statuses in Shopify

* Monitoring shipments through ParcelPanel / ParcelWheel

* Identifying fulfillment or shipping delays before they become bigger problems

* Following up with suppliers when orders haven't been fulfilled or shipped on time

* Monitoring orders until they are successfully delivered

* Communicating shipping issues and updates between the supplier and Customer Service team

* Making sure Customer Service has the correct information to keep customers updated and reassured

* Taking ownership of unresolved fulfillment and delivery issues



The goal is simple: orders should be fulfilled correctly, shipped on time and delivered without unnecessary delays.



If something goes wrong, we expect you to notice it, follow up with the right person and make sure it gets resolved. We're looking for someone who takes ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do.



What we're looking for:



Previous e-commerce supply chain, fulfillment or logistics experience is required.



Experience with Shopify, suppliers, order fulfillment and shipment tracking is strongly preferred.



You should be organised, detail-oriented and proactive. We don't want someone who simply checks a dashboard. We're looking for someone who takes responsibility for making sure orders actually reach our customers.



Strong English communication skills are required.



If you also have experience in e-commerce Customer Service, please mention this in your application. There may be an opportunity to turn this into a larger combined Customer Service + Supply Chain role.



We're an established and growing e-commerce brand and are looking for someone reliable who wants to work with us long-term.



Important application instructions:



Include the word "bank" in the subject of your application so we know you've carefully read the entire job post.



Please write your application and answers yourself. Do not use ChatGPT or any other AI tool to write your responses. We want to see your actual English, communication skills and way of thinking. Applications or answers that appear to be AI-generated will not be considered.

title: Part-Time Social Media Graphic Designer
description:
We are looking for a creative, reliable graphic designer to help us create social media content and advertising graphics for two growing businesses.



This is a small, ongoing part-time position with a consistent but flexible weekly workload.



We will provide the photos, videos, branding, examples, and general direction. Your job is to take those assets and turn them into clean, modern, professional, and attention-grabbing content.



We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to use Canva. We want someone with a great design eye who understands what is currently trending on social media and can take inspiration and turn it into something original and polished.



You should be able to receive an assignment and examples from us, understand the direction we’re going for, and create something great without needing step-by-step instructions.



The Brands



You’ll be creating content for two companies:



Charlotte Real Estate Media (CREM)

A real estate media company providing photography, video, drone, and other marketing services to real estate agents.



Fast Frame Edits

Our sister company providing professional video editing services to real estate media companies.



Each company has its own branding and style. We will provide you with the necessary brand assets, photos, videos, and examples.



Typical Weekly Workload



Every Monday, we’ll send you a list of the content we’d like created for that week.



A typical week will include:



Charlotte Real Estate Media



* 2 Instagram Story graphics

* 1 Instagram carousel

* 1 simple video advertisement



Fast Frame Edits



* 2 Instagram Story graphics

* 1 Instagram carousel

* 1 simple video advertisement



That’s approximately 8 pieces of content per week, but the exact workload and type of content may change.



For example, one week we may need fewer Stories and an additional advertisement. Some weeks may also be lighter than others.



We care more about having someone who is flexible and can help us create what we need each week than having an exact quota of identical deliverables.



Video Advertisements



This is NOT a full video editing position.



For most video advertisements, we will provide an already edited video.



Your job may simply be to take that video and add a creative banner, headline, offer, graphic, or call-to-action so that it is ready for us to post or run as an advertisement.



You do not need to be an advanced video editor. You simply need to understand how to make an existing video look like a polished, professional social media advertisement.



What We’re Looking For



You should:



* Have previous professional graphic design experience

* Be highly proficient in Canva and/or Adobe Photoshop

* Have a strong portfolio of previous work

* Understand current social media design trends

* Understand modern Instagram carousel design

* Understand Instagram Story design

* Have experience creating advertising graphics

* Have a strong eye for typography, spacing, layouts, and visual hierarchy

* Be able to create short, catchy headlines and advertising copy

* Know how to make content attention-grabbing without making it look cheap or unprofessional

* Be able to follow an established brand while bringing your own creativity

* Be comfortable looking at inspiration and creating something in a similar style

* Communicate well

* Meet deadlines

* Be comfortable receiving feedback and making reasonable revisions



No AI-Generated Designs



We are NOT looking for AI-generated graphics or AI-generated designs.



Your work should be intentionally designed using Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator, or similar professional design software.



We want our content to feel custom, intentional, modern, and designed by a real person.



We do not want generic AI-looking graphics.



What We Provide



We will typically provide you with:



* Professional photos

* Finished videos

* Logos

* Brand colors and fonts

* Brand assets

* Examples and inspiration

* General copy or the idea we want communicated

* A clear list of weekly assignments



You are not expected to create everything from nothing.



Your responsibility is to bring the creative execution and professional design eye that turns those assets into great content.



Compensation



$150 USD per month, paid monthly.



This is intended to be a small, ongoing side position with a relatively light and flexible workload.



If the position and workload grow significantly in the future, there may be opportunities for additional work and increased compensation.



How to Apply



Please send us:



1. A link to your design portfolio

2. Your best examples of Instagram carousels

3. Examples of social media advertisements you’ve designed

4. Examples of Instagram Story graphics, if available

5. Which design programs you primarily use

6. A brief explanation of how you stay current with social media and graphic design trends



A portfolio is required.



We care much more about seeing the quality of your actual work than receiving a long application.



Hiring Process



We are looking to hire someone this week, so the process will move quickly.



Step 1 - Portfolio



Apply and send us your portfolio and examples of your previous work.



Step 2 - Test Graphic



If we like your portfolio and think you may be a good fit, we will respond with a very simple test graphic for you to create.



The test will be similar to the type of work you would regularly create for us and should not take a significant amount of time.



Step 3 - Submit Your Test



The test graphic is unpaid. This allows us to see how well you follow our direction, interpret our branding, and bring your own creativity to an assignment.



We will not publish or use test graphics from applicants we do not hire.



Step 4 - Hiring



We’ll review the completed test designs and choose the designer who is the best fit.



We plan to make our hiring decision this week.



IMPORTANT



To show us that you read the entire job posting, start your application with the word “CAROUSEL.”



If your application does not start with CAROUSEL, we will assume you did not read the full job description.







Here is an example of the type of simple video advertisement we may ask you to create:

title: Long-Term Voice Actor Needed — American Accent — Documentary YouTube Channel (Faceless)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

Wanted: The Voice — American Accent Voice Actor for a Documentary-Style YouTube Channel

Volume: 4 videos per week

Type: Ongoing, long-term. Not a one-off gig.



About the channel



Forgotten Beasts is a faceless documentary channel about extinct animals, lost species, and creatures people swear are still out there. Audience is mostly US, UK and Australia, ages 34–55. Think mystery-thriller documentary energy — not a flat listicle voiceover.



I write every script myself. Your job is to make it come alive with your voice: pacing, tension, and delivery that hooks people and doesn't let go.



What I actually need from you



The edit can be perfect, but if the voice is boring, nobody stays. I need a voice actor who gets that delivery is what turns a script into a story.



Here is the standard:



American accent, clean and broadcast-ready. No regional twang, no vocal fry, no upspeak. Sound like the voice people trust in the dark.



Documentary-thriller tone. Steady and authoritative when explaining, hushed and tense when building suspense, sharp and punchy on the reveal. Range matters.



Master of pacing. Know when to slow down, when to hold a pause, when silence does more work than words. Rushing kills the moment.



Studio-clean audio. Quiet, treated space. No hiss, no echo, no background noise sneaking in.



Consistent voice, every time. Same setup, same tone, video after video, so listeners recognize the channel the second you start talking.



Follows direction. Comfortable working from scripts with emotion notes and delivery cues already marked, and open to feedback to dial in the sound.



What I provide

Direction and feedback to lock in the right tone early

Pay
