title: AI Video Expert NEEDED - Google Flow / Veo Expert
description:
We are looking for an **experienced AI Video Creator** who specializes in **Google Flow and Google Veo** to help us produce high-quality, realistic AI-generated videos for social media.



The most important part of this role is **CONSISTENCY**.



We need someone who understands advanced AI prompting and can maintain the **same character, clothing, environment, objects, lighting and overall visual style across multiple generated shots**. We do not want characters or important details randomly changing from scene to scene.



### Your Responsibilities



* Create realistic AI-generated videos using **Google Flow and Google Veo**

* Write detailed, structured prompts that produce consistent results

* Create and maintain **recurring AI characters** across videos

* Keep the character's face, age, hair, clothing and physical appearance consistent

* Maintain the same locations, props and important background elements between shots

* Create multiple camera angles and scenes while making them feel like they belong to the **same continuous video**

* Understand reference images and how to use them effectively for character and scene consistency

* Generate natural character movements and realistic environments

* Identify and regenerate shots when faces, hands, clothing, objects or backgrounds unexpectedly change

* Organize prompts and character references so successful characters can be reproduced for future videos

* Deliver clean videos without obvious AI inconsistencies, unnecessary scene changes or continuity errors



### What We're Looking For



You should already have strong experience with:



**Google Flow**

**Google Veo / Veo 3**

**AI video generation**

**Advanced prompting**

**Character consistency**

**Reference-image workflows**

**Scene and subject consistency**

**Image-to-video generation**

**Cinematic camera prompting**

**AI continuity between shots**



This is **not an entry-level position**. We are specifically looking for someone who already understands how to control AI video generation rather than simply typing basic prompts and accepting whatever the model generates.



### The Most Important Skill



If we create a character in Scene 1, that person needs to still look like **the exact same person in Scene 2, Scene 3 and Scene 4, **.



Their face should not suddenly change. Their clothes should not randomly change. Objects should not disappear. The environment should not completely change between shots.



You need to understand how to build prompts, references and workflows that minimize these problems and create videos with strong visual continuity.



### How to Apply



Please send:



1. Examples of AI videos you have personally created using **Google Flow or Google Veo**

2. Examples showing the **same AI character across multiple different scenes**

3. A short explanation of your process for maintaining character and scene consistency

4. How long you have been working with AI video generation

5. The AI video and image-generation tools you currently use

6. Your expected hourly or weekly rate



**IMPORTANT:** Start your application with the words **“FLOW EXPERT”** so we know you have read the entire job description.



There is potential for **consistent, long-term work** for the right person. We are looking for someone who can become our go-to AI video specialist rather than someone who only completes a few videos.

title: AI 3D Animation Creator — Gaming Shorts
description:
Plix.gg is a browser gaming platform with 72,000+ games and 300K+ monthly visitors.



We're hiring an AI animation creator to produce short 3D gaming videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.



These are the styles we like. Please watch all of them before applying:













What they have in common: fast narration, simple 3D scenes, close-ups, cutaways, camera movement and constant visual progression.



We are not fixed on one look. Tell us which of these you are strongest at and why.



We want to apply this to original gaming topics, not copy existing videos.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



◆ WHAT YOU'LL CREATE



Videos will usually be 15–50 seconds, vertical 9:16.



Topics can cover gaming broadly, including:



• What actually happens when you have high ping

• How a game server knows if your bullet hit

• What happens inside a mouse when you click

• How hitboxes work

• What happens when your FPS drops

• How controllers send inputs to a game

• How a game runs directly inside your browser

• Why browser games don't need to be installed

• Plix.gg-specific concepts when there is a genuinely interesting idea



Not every video needs to be about Plix.gg or browser games.

Te videos do not have to be technical.



They can also be more entertaining or relatable:



• What happens to your body after playing games for 12 hours straight

• What happens to your eyes when you stare at a screen all night

• Why your hands get sweaty during an intense game

• What happens inside your brain when you finally beat a difficult boss

• What happens when you rage at a game

• Why losing at the last second feels so frustrating

• What happens when your mom walks in after you've been gaming all night

• When your mom tells you to delete Roblox

• What happens when Roblox is blocked but you still want to play something

• When your parents think you're studying but you're playing browser games

• What happens when the Wi-Fi dies in the middle of a ranked match

• What happens when you play “one more game” at 2 AM

• Why gamers lean their entire body when turning in a racing game

• Why everyone presses buttons harder when they're losing

• What happens when you keep clicking even though the game is frozen

• What happens when 20 browser tabs are open while you're gaming

• Why an old laptop starts sounding like a jet engine when you launch a game

• How a browser game can start in seconds without a huge download

• What happens when you open Plix.gg on a school or low-end laptop

• Plix.gg-specific concepts whenever there is a genuinely entertaining idea



We would rather make an interesting gaming video with broad appeal than force Plix into a topic where it doesn't belong.



The goal is to make interesting gaming animations people would watch even if they had never heard of Plix.gg, with Plix integrated naturally when relevant.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



◆ WHAT YOU DO



• Turn scripts into visual scenes

• Generate consistent 3D-style images/assets

• Animate them using Seedance, Kling, Veo, Higgsfield or similar tools

• Create good camera movement and transitions

• Regenerate bad or inconsistent AI shots

• Add ElevenLabs (or similiar) voiceover when required

• Edit the complete video

• Add captions, sound effects and music

• Deliver the finished video ready to post



You should still be able to develop the visual execution independently.



Blender is NOT required.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



◆ TOOLS



Experience with several of these is preferred:



• Seedance

• Kling

• Veo / Flow

• Higgsfield

• Sora

• GPT Image / Midjourney

• ElevenLabs

• CapCut / Premiere Pro / DaVinci Resolve



We care more about your output than which exact tools you use.

We can provide to higgsfield team access.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



◆ WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You should understand:



• AI image-to-video workflows

• Character and object consistency

• 3D-style compositions

• Camera movement

• Cutaway / cross-section scenes

• Short-form pacing

• Visual storytelling

• Sound design

• How to recognize and fix bad AI generations



The finished video should feel like one coherent animation, not random AI clips stitched together.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



◆ OUTPUT



2 finished videos per week



Usually 15–50 seconds each.



We handle uploading and social accounts.



No fixed schedule or timezone requirements.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



◆ PAY



₱65,000 / month



Paid monthly via Wise.



Pre-approved AI generation costs can be covered separately.



━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



◆ HOW TO APPLY

Tell us what you use for:



Images:

Animation:

Voice:

“When you click your mouse in an online game, the signal travels from your computer to the game server before the server d
 what happened.”

We want to see how you think visually.

About Us:

Green Scholars Landscaping is a premium, fast-growing property maintenance company based in Halifax, Canada. We are expanding our operations and looking for a sharp, motivated Virtual Assistant .



Position Overview:

We are looking for a dynamic, confident, and highly organized Sales & Admin Assistant. This is not a passive data-entry role, you will be the heartbeat of our scheduling and sales follow-up process.



Your primary focus will be outbound phone calls following up on outstanding lawn care/landscaping quotes, talking to property owners, booking jobs, and helping manage our crew schedules. If you love talking to people, have a warm phone presence, and are great with numbers, we want you! We’re also looking to grow this role into helping prepare small mowing and snow removal quotes — we’ll provide full training, so we’re really looking for serious applicants who are ready and willing to be trained on estimating. Prior quoting/estimating experience is a big plus, but not required.



Key Responsibilities:

Quote Callbacks (Warm Sales): Call back a backlog of property owners who requested landscaping/mowing quotes. Answer their questions, handle objections warmly, and secure the booking.

Scheduling & Crew Routing: Manage and coordinate schedules for our field crews, optimize their daily routes, and book incoming jobs efficiently.

Lead & Request Management: Monitor and process new property service requests coming through our system (Jobber).

Proactive Outreach: Perform outbound cold calling and follow-ups during slower periods to keep the crews busy.

Quotes & Estimates (Training Provided): Help prepare small mowing and snow removal quotes for customers using our pricing tools and templates. We will fully train you on this — we’re just looking for serious applicants who are ready and willing to learn estimating.



Required Qualifications & Skills:

Excellent Spoken English: Exceptional spoken English with a warm, clear, and professional phone voice. You must be deeply comfortable being on the phone most of the day, specifically talking to older/senior homeowners who appreciate a polite, friendly cadence.

Sharp Math & Spatial Awareness: You must be fast and accurate with fundamental mental math. You will constantly be looking at property dimensions, square footage, and pricing structures. (Real estate VA experience or construction/home services background is a huge plus!)

Estimating/Quoting Experience: Prior experience preparing quotes for mowing, snow removal, landscaping, or similar home services is a big plus — though we’re happy to train the right person who is serious and eager to learn.

Sales Background: At least 1–2 years of experience in outbound sales, real estate, appointment setting, or premium BPO customer service accounts.

Tech-Savvy & Organized: Experience with CRM tools, Google Workspace, and scheduling software (experience with Jobber is a plus, but not required).

Reliable Setup: A quiet home office workspace, a reliable high-speed internet connection, a backup power/internet solution, and a premium noise-canceling headset.



What We Offer:

Competitive salary with performance bonuses/room for growth.

Stable, long-term full-time employment.

Comprehensive training on our systems, landscaping services, and pricing.

A supportive, friendly team environment where your initiatives are valued.

title: Virtual Cold Caller
description:
# EXPERIENCED U.S. REAL ESTATE COLD CALLER / VIRTUAL ASSISTANT — $4.50/HOUR — FULL TIME



**PAY:** $4.50 USD/hour

**SCHEDULE:** 40 hours/week

**POSITION:** Full-time, long-term

**LOCATION:** Remote — Philippines

**MARKET:** Tampa, Florida / U.S. Eastern Time

**INDUSTRY:** U.S. Real Estate Investing / Off-Market Property Acquisition



## ⚠️ PLEASE READ THE ENTIRE POST BEFORE APPLYING



I am looking for an **experienced U.S. real estate cold caller** to join my growing real estate investment business.



This is NOT a general virtual assistant position.



This is NOT a beginner telemarketing position.



This is NOT a data-entry job.



I am specifically looking for someone who has **previously cold called U.S. homeowners for real estate investors, wholesalers, or real estate companies** and understands how to have a natural conversation with a homeowner, identify motivation, qualify the opportunity, and properly document the lead.



If you have NEVER cold called U.S. homeowners before, please do not apply.



---



# ABOUT THE BUSINESS



We are a U.S.-based real estate investment business focused on finding **off-market properties and motivated property owners**.



We contact homeowners directly to determine whether they may be interested in selling their property.



When we identify a genuinely motivated seller, the lead is transferred to the acquisitions side of the business for further qualification, negotiation, and potential purchase.



Our focus is on:



**Finding motivated sellers → qualifying them → following up → creating legitimate acquisition opportunities.**



We are NOT interested in misleading homeowners or pressuring people who don't want to sell.



---



# YOUR PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY



Your #1 job is:



## FIND MOTIVATED SELLERS.



You will make outbound calls to property owners in the Tampa, Florida market.



You will have conversations with homeowners and determine:



* Why they might sell

* Whether they actually want to sell

* How soon they want to sell

* Condition of the property

* Whether the property is occupied

* Whether it is rented

* What repairs may be needed

* Their price expectations

* Their circumstances

* Whether there is a legitimate opportunity for our acquisitions team



You are NOT expected to close the purchase yourself.



Your job is to identify and qualify the opportunity and get the lead to me quickly.



---



# REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



## YOU MUST HAVE:



### 1. Previous U.S. real estate cold-calling experience



You MUST have experience calling **U.S. homeowners/property owners**.



I strongly prefer candidates who have worked directly with:



* Real estate wholesalers

* Real estate investors

* House flippers

* Real estate investment companies

* Motivated seller campaigns

* Off-market property acquisition

* Distressed property campaigns



Please explain exactly what you did in your previous position.



---



### 2. Previous high-volume cold-calling experience



You should be comfortable making a large number of outbound calls every day.



You should NOT be someone who gets discouraged after 20–30 rejections.



You will hear:



"No."



"Not interested."



"Take me off your list."



"How did you get my number?"



"Who are you?"



"I already have a realtor."



"I don't want to sell."



This is normal.



You need to remain professional, calm, respectful, and persistent.



---



### 3. Excellent spoken English



You must have:



* Clear English

* Strong pronunciation

* Good listening comprehension

* Natural conversational ability

* Ability to understand American accents

* Ability to communicate with older homeowners

* Ability to ask follow-up questions naturally



I am NOT looking for someone who sounds like they are simply reading a script.



---



# REAL ESTATE KNOWLEDGE REQUIRED



You should understand the basic concepts of:



* Wholesaling

* Motivated sellers

* Off-market properties

* Absentee owners

* Vacant properties

* Distressed properties

* Tired landlords

* Probate

* Code violations

* High-equity properties

* ARV

* Comps

* Repairs

* Cash buyers

* Assignment contracts

* Acquisitions

* Dispositions



You do NOT need to be an expert at underwriting.



However, you need enough real estate knowledge to understand what the acquisitions team is looking for.



---



# TYPES OF SELLER LISTS



You may be calling property owners from targeted lists such as:



* Absentee owners

* Vacant properties

* High-equity owners

* Long-time owners

* Tired landlords

* Probate-related property owners

* Code violation properties

* Distressed properties

* Tax-delinquent properties

* Other motivated-seller lists



The goal is NOT to blindly call everyone.



The goal is to identify the people who have a legitimate reason to consider selling.



---



# WHAT A GOOD CALLER DOES



A good caller does NOT sound like this:



"Hello sir, are you interested in selling your property? We buy houses cash. Can I make you an offer?"



Instead, you should be able to have a natural conversation.



For example:



"Hi, my name is [FIRST AND LAST NAME], and I'm calling on behalf of [COMPANY NAME]. We're reaching out to property owners in the Tampa area to see if they might be interested in selling their property. I wanted to see if that's something you'd ever consider."



If they show interest, you should be able to continue naturally:



"What has you thinking about selling?"



"How long have you owned the property?"



"How is the property currently?"



"Is anyone living there?"



"What kind of repairs does it need?"



"When would you ideally like to sell?"



"Have you thought about what you'd like to get for it?"



The most important skill is:



## LISTEN.



Do not interrogate the homeowner.



Do not rush through the script.



Do not talk over people.



Do not pressure people.



---



# HOT LEAD QUALIFICATION



A lead becomes important when the seller demonstrates real motivation.



Examples:



* Wants to sell soon

* Inherited property

* Moving

* Tired landlord

* Property is vacant

* Major repairs

* Financial pressure

* Difficult tenants

* Doesn't want to deal with the property anymore

* Wants to avoid repairs

* Wants a simple sale

* Other legitimate reason for selling



When you find a HOT lead:



## CONTACT ME IMMEDIATELY.



Do not let a highly motivated seller sit in the CRM for several hours.



---



# FOLLOW-UP IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



Many sellers will NOT be ready to sell during the first conversation.



You will be responsible for following up with leads according to the instructions in the CRM.



Examples:



* "Call me next week."

* "Call me next month."

* "I'm thinking about selling."

* "I need to talk to my family."

* "I'm waiting until after the holidays."

* "I'm getting the house cleaned out first."



These are NOT automatically dead leads.



You need to document the conversation and follow up at the appropriate time.



---



# CRM RESPONSIBILITIES



After every meaningful conversation, you must accurately document:



* Seller name

* Property address

* Phone number

* Motivation

* Timeline

* Property condition

* Occupancy

* Estimated repairs

* Price expectations

* Seller comments

* Lead temperature

* Follow-up date

* Call outcome

* Any important information



Bad notes = bad leads.



Good notes = better acquisitions.



---



# DAILY PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



This is a full-time position.



You will work:



## 40 HOURS PER WEEK



Your initial target will be approximately:



## 4,000–5,000 outbound call attempts per week



However:



**QUALITY > PURE VOLUME.**



I do NOT want you rushing through conversations simply to increase your dial count.



We will monitor:



* Calls made

* Conversations

* Qualified leads

* Hot leads

* Follow-ups completed

* Appointments/callbacks

* Lead quality

* CRM accuracy

* Attendance

* Punctuality



---



# WORK SCHEDULE



You must be available to work U.S. Eastern Time hours as scheduled.



Because you will be calling U.S. homeowners, your calling schedule must follow the approved calling windows for the homeowner's local time.



Your schedule will be established before you begin.



You must be able to work your scheduled hours consistently.



---



# COMPLIANCE IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



We take compliance seriously.



You will be required to follow all company calling procedures and applicable laws.



### YOU MUST:



* Identify yourself using your true first and last name when required

* Identify the company you are calling on behalf of

* Follow the company's Do-Not-Call procedures

* Immediately honor a homeowner's request not to receive future calls

* Properly mark DNC requests in the CRM

* Follow approved calling hours

* Use only company-approved calling software and numbers

* Follow the approved script/process

* Be truthful

* Never impersonate another person

* Never pretend to be the property owner

* Never falsely claim to be a buyer

* Never falsely claim that we already have a buyer

* Never make promises you cannot guarantee

* Never pressure or harass a homeowner

* Never manipulate or deceive a homeowner



Florida law specifically requires telephone solicitors making unsolicited calls to Florida consumers to identify themselves by their true first and last names and identify the business on whose behalf they are soliciting. Florida also restricts certain automated dialing and recorded-message calls without prior express written consent.



Federal telemarketing rules also address Do-Not-Call compliance, calling hours, caller ID, abandoned calls, and robocalls.



### IMPORTANT:



If a homeowner says:



**"Do not call me again."**



You must immediately:



1. Politely acknowledge the request.

2. End the sales conversation.

3. Mark the number **DO NOT CALL** in the CRM.

4. Never manually call that number again.



---



# NO SPOOFING OR MISREPRESENTATION



We will use company-approved calling numbers.



You are NOT allowed to:



* Spoof your identity

* Pretend to be someone else

* Hide your identity

* Claim to be a neighbor

* Claim to be a government employee

* Claim to be a realtor if you aren't

* Claim to personally own the property

* Make up a buyer

* Invent an offer

* Lie about why we are calling



Professionalism and honesty are required.



---



# EQUIPMENT REQUIREMENTS



You MUST have:



* Reliable computer/laptop

* Reliable high-speed internet

* Quality USB headset

* Quiet workspace

* Backup internet connection strongly preferred

* Backup power strongly preferred

* Ability to work without interruptions



You must have a professional environment for speaking with U.S. homeowners.



---



# LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



I am not looking for someone who wants to work for two weeks and disappear.



I am building a real estate acquisition operation and want to develop a **long-term team**.



If you perform well, there may be opportunities for:



* Increased responsibility

* Performance bonuses

* Lead-management responsibilities

* Training new callers

* Team-lead responsibilities

* Additional hours/responsibilities

* Future advancement within the company



---



# WHO I AM LOOKING FOR



The ideal person is:



* Experienced

* Reliable

* Extremely coachable

* Competitive

* Persistent

* Organized

* Confident

* Conversational

* Good at listening

* Comfortable with rejection

* Detail-oriented

* Honest

* Self-motivated

* Results-oriented

* Comfortable working independently



You should genuinely enjoy talking to people.



---



# WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY



Please do NOT apply if:



* You have never cold called before

* You have never called U.S. homeowners

* You have no real estate experience

* You dislike making a high volume of calls

* You are uncomfortable speaking English

* You cannot work U.S. hours

* You need constant supervision

* You frequently miss work

* You have unreliable internet

* You do not have a quiet workspace

* You are uncomfortable with rejection

* You are looking for a temporary job

* You are going to use someone else's identity on calls

* You are unwilling to follow Do-Not-Call procedures



---



# APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



## IMPORTANT:



At the very beginning of your application, write:



# "I READ THE ENTIRE POST."



Applications that do not begin with those exact words will NOT be considered.



Then answer ALL questions below.



### 1.

### 2.

---



# REQUIRED VOICE RECORDING

# OPTIONAL: SEND A CALL SAMPLE

# HIRING PROCESS

I run an independent non-fiction publishing house with a growing catalogue on Amazon (paperback + ebook, multiple series and pen names). description:
About the Role

Welcome! We’re a UK women's fashion brand and are looking for an experienced influencer outreach specialist to build and manage a strong pipeline of UK creators, influencers and affiliates in order to generate UGC content.



This is primarily an outreach, follow-up and relationship management role. We want someone who has done this before and is comfortable spending a significant part of every working day finding the right creators, contacting them, following up and moving partnerships through to gifting, content and results.



Previous hands-on creator/influencer outreach experience is essential.



Your Main Responsibility

- Build a strong network of UK creators and affiliates who can help us generate great content, genuine engagement and measurable sales.



What You’ll Own

- Research and identify relevant UK-based creators, influencers and affiliates across Instagram, TikTok and other appropriate channels.

- Assess creator fit based on UK audience, customer fit, engagement quality, content style, authenticity and commercial potential.

- Find the best contact route and carry out personalised outreach by DM,
 or appropriate outreach tools.

- Follow up consistently with creators who do not initially respond and keep every active conversation moving.

- Manage gifting from agreement through product selection, sizing, dispatch information, delivery follow-up and content due.

- Follow up after products are received and make sure agreed content is actually delivered and posted.

- Recruit and manage affiliates, including links, codes and basic results tracking where relevant.

- Obtain and record usage permissions and support Meta Partnership Ads / whitelisting and TikTok Spark Ads where appropriate.

- Build longer-term relationships with strong creators and identify people worth repeating, scaling or moving into paid partnerships.

- Maintain an accurate creator pipeline covering every contact, response, follow-up date, product sent, content due, rights status and result.

- Maintain communication with active creators and affiliates after onboarding, ensuring strong partners remain engaged and identifying opportunities for additional content, promotions and campaigns

- Provide a concise weekly update showing pipeline movement, wins, blockers and next actions.



Daily Outreach Expectations

This is a proactive role. We do not want someone waiting for creators to come to us or waiting to be told who to chase. You should be comfortable maintaining a consistent pipeline of new creator research, personalised outreach, follow-ups, gifting in progress, content due, affiliate/whitelisting opportunities and longer-term creator relationships.



Quality matters. We are not interested in just random high-volume messaging. Creators should be assessed for brand fit, UK audience, engagement quality, customer fit, content quality and commercial potential.





What Success Looks Like

We will look at the quality of creators sourced, outreach response rates, partnerships secured, gifting converted into content, affiliate/whitelisting activity and the commercial results generated.

The goal is not simply to send out free products. The goal is to turn creator relationships into useful content, stronger reach, long-term partnerships and sales.



Essential Experience

- Proven hands-on experience with influencer, creator or affiliate outreach for a brand or ecommerce business.

- Experience personally researching, sourcing, contacting and following up with creators on Instagram and/or TikTok.

- Experience managing gifting, creator deliverables and multiple creator relationships at different stages.

- Excellent written and spoken English, with confidence communicating directly as the brand.

- Strong organisation and follow-through, with proven use of trackers, deadlines and follow-up systems.

- Ability to work independently, take initiative and keep stakeholders updated without constant chasing.



Strongly Preferred

- Previous creator/influencer experience for fashion, apparel, activewear, beauty or another consumer ecommerce brand.

- Previous outreach to UK creators or experience representing UK, US or Australian brands.

- Affiliate programme experience.

- Meta Partnership Ads / whitelisting, creator licensing / usage-rights or TikTok Spark Ads experience.

- Experience with micro-influencers and creator gifting programmes.



How to Apply

- Send your CV.

- Share examples of creator/influencer campaigns, partnerships or outreach you have managed. Anonymised evidence is - welcome where confidentiality applies.

- Tell us your current availability, desired hourly rate and any other regular work commitments.

- Please also answer the following questions (**WE HIGHLY RECOMMEND A LOOM VIDEO TO STAND OUT IN THE APPLICATION PROCESS**):

1) Your influencer/creator outreach experience, the brands and creator types you have worked with, tools used and what parts of the process you personally owned.

2) Tell us about an outreach programme you personally managed. Approximately how many creators were involved, what did you own and how did you make sure nothing was missed?



Please include the word “alpaca” somewhere in your application so we know you have read the full job description.

Stage 1: CV, Loom and relevant-experience review.

Stage 2: Shortlisted candidates complete a short practical creator-outreach exercise.

Stage 3: Video interview.

Final stage: Initial paid trial before continuing if we’re all happy

title: AI Image Generation & Photoshop Specialist | Fashion Brand
description:
IMPORTANT: AN INTRO VIDEO IS REQUIRED. APPLICATIONS WITHOUT A VIDEO WILL NOT BE REVIEWED.



We’re looking for an AI Image Generation & Photoshop Specialist to join our creative team and help us create AI-generated brand imagery that is indistinguishable from real photography.



We’ve built an advanced AI image-generation system using node-based workflows in Magnific. It allows us to create highly realistic imagery while maintaining consistency across models, products, environments, and overall brand aesthetic. The system works, but achieving the level of accuracy we expect still requires significant iteration, attention to detail, and Photoshop expertise.



Every month, we create dedicated AI content batches for both of our brands (Bella Belts and Buckley Belts). These images become part of our central content library and are used across the business, from social media and
 to paid advertising and campaigns.



Because these assets are used at scale and across many different channels, product and visual accuracy are extremely important.



What You’ll Do

You’ll work alongside our current AI Image Generator, who will introduce you to the systems and workflows we’ve developed.

Our process includes:



Creating and working from detailed character and product reference sheets

Developing shot ideas and references

Generating consistent models, environments, styling, and compositions

Running additional AI passes to accurately integrate our products into generated imagery

Using Photoshop and compositing to fix anything AI cannot reproduce accurately

Applying final post-processing to make images feel genuinely photographic

Product accuracy is extremely important to us. We have extensive reference imagery for our products, and small inaccuracies in things like buckles, materials, proportions, or how a belt sits on the body can make an otherwise great image unusable.



Photoshop & Compositing

AI often gets us 90% of the way there. Your job is also to help solve the final 10%.

You should be comfortable with Photoshop, retouching, and compositing, correcting product details, rebuilding problematic areas, removing AI artifacts, and making everything sit naturally within the image.

We also use photographic post-processing such as grain, bloom, chromatic aberration, and other subtle imperfections using Dehancer to further solidify the realism of the final composite.



Improving the System

We don’t just want someone who can operate our current workflow.

AI is moving incredibly quickly, so part of your role will be staying on top of new models, tools, techniques, and node-based workflows that could improve our results or make the process more efficient.

If there’s a better way to achieve product consistency, compositing, character consistency, or photorealism, we want you to find it, test it, and help us implement it.

Longer term, we also want to expand these systems into AI video generation as the technology becomes capable of maintaining the product accuracy we require.



What We’re Looking For



Strong experience with AI image generation

Experience with node-based AI workflows

Strong Photoshop, retouching, and compositing skills

Excellent eye for photorealism, lighting, texture, perspective, and detail

Extremely detail-oriented, particularly around product accuracy

Comfortable with trial and error and troubleshooting difficult generations

Naturally interested in testing new AI models, tools, and techniques

Experience with e-commerce, fashion, product photography, or commercial imagery is a plus





Ultimately, we’re looking for someone who combines AI expertise with strong Photoshop and compositing skills and can consistently produce a high volume of usable, on-brand assets for our wider creative team.

Our standard is simple: the final image shouldn’t look AI-generated.

s

your familiarity with tools such as Phantombuster

title: Creative Strategist – DTC E-Commerce / Meta Ads
description:
READ BEFORE APPLYING



DO NOT APPLY UNLESS YOU HAVE PERSONALLY WORKED ON AT LEAST 5 ADS THAT HAVE EACH SPENT $100,000+ ON META.



We are looking for a high-level Creative Strategist with proven experience creating and scaling winning DTC ads.



We don't care how many years of experience you have.



We care about one thing:



Can you consistently come up with ads that scale?



To qualify for this position, you must have worked on at least 5 individual ads that have each spent more than $100,000. You will be required to provide proof during the application process.



We operate multiple DTC e-commerce brands in the US market and produce a high volume of Meta ads every week.



This is not just an “ideas” position.



Your job is to understand why ads work, turn performance data and customer psychology into new concepts, and lead our creative team toward producing more winning ads.



Your Responsibilities



You will:



Manage and guide 2–3 video/static editors daily

Develop new creative concepts, hooks, angles, offers, and iterations

Research competitors, customers, trends, advertorials, and winning ads

Write clear creative briefs that editors can execute

Assign and prioritize daily creative tasks

Analyze performance of launched creatives

Identify WHY winning ads are working

Identify WHY losing ads failed

Turn learnings into new iterations and concepts

Give detailed feedback to editors

Work closely with our media buying team

Maintain an organized creative testing pipeline

Continuously search for new opportunities to improve creative performance

What We're Looking For



REQUIRED:



You have personally strategized, created, or played a major role in at least 5 individual ads that have each spent $100,000+ on Meta.



Not $100k total account spend.



Not $100k across 50 creatives.



At least 5 individual winning ads with $100k+ spend EACH.



You should also have strong experience with:



DTC e-commerce

Meta advertising

Direct-response marketing

Creative strategy

Customer research

Creative performance analysis

Managing or working closely with editors



You should understand concepts like:



Hooks, angles, awareness levels, market sophistication, customer avatars, mass desires, advertorials, UGC, VSLs, native ads, static ads, iterations, creative fatigue, CTR, CPA, CVR, ROAS and creative testing.



You should be able to look at a winning ad and say:



“This worked because of X. Here are 5 new ads we should create based on that learning.”



Working Conditions

Full-time: approximately 180 hours/month

Monday–Friday

Generally available during European morning/working hours

Flexible schedule can be agreed upon

Long-term position

Work directly with founders, media buyers, and our creative team



We move fast and test a high volume of creatives.



We're looking for someone who takes ownership and can eventually lead the creative direction rather than waiting for us to tell them what to do.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send ALL of the following:



1. Your 5 $100K+ Ads



Send us at least 5 individual ads you've worked on that have each spent $100,000+.



For each ad, include:



The creative itself

Total spend

Performance/results

The brand

Your exact role in creating the ad

A short explanation of why you think it worked



2. Proof



Provide screenshots from Meta Ads Manager or another form of proof showing the spend behind these creatives.



You may blur confidential information.



3. Portfolio



Send us the DTC/e-commerce brands you've worked with and explain your role with each.



4. Start your application with the word “STRATEGIST.”



If you don't provide proof of 5 individual $100k+ spending ads, your application will not be considered.



We're looking for someone who has already proven they can find winning ads at scale — and wants to do it repeatedly with us.

GrowthHub365 is the center of our digital ecosystem.



The majority of the websites, landing pages, funnels, forms, campaigns, and digital experiences we build will live within GrowthHub365.



Because of this, we are looking for someone who is already highly proficient with GrowthHub365 or has strong experience with comparable all-in-one platforms and can quickly become highly proficient in GrowthHub365.



You should be able to confidently work within the platform rather than simply hand off designs to someone else.



You will be expected to learn, build, test, troubleshoot, and continuously improve our GrowthHub365 environment.



Website Design & Development



You will:



* Design and build professional, responsive websites in GrowthHub365

* Structure websites around clear user journeys and organizational goals

* Build modern homepage, program, service, about, contact, event, and resource pages

* Create responsive desktop, tablet, and mobile experiences

* Design intuitive navigation and information architecture

* Build reusable page sections and design components

* Optimize websites for usability, accessibility, speed, and consistency

* Maintain and update website content

* Troubleshoot layout, responsiveness, forms, integrations, and other website issues

* Test websites across devices and screen sizes before launch

* Continuously improve existing websites based on user behavior, feedback, and business objectives



We are looking for someone who can actually build the website, not someone who only creates mockups.



Funnel Design & Conversion Experience



A major part of this role is funnel development.



You should understand how websites and funnels work together to move a visitor toward a specific action.



You will design and build:



* Lead-generation funnels

* Enrollment funnels

* Application funnels

* Event registration funnels

* Program and course funnels

* Lead magnet funnels

* Consultation or discovery funnels

* Campaign landing pages

* Thank-you and confirmation pages

* Forms and intake experiences

* Nurture and conversion journeys

* Multi-step user experiences



You should understand concepts such as:



Traffic ? Landing Page ? CTA ? Form/Application ? Confirmation ? Follow-Up ? Conversion



You should be able to identify friction in a funnel and make recommendations to improve the experience.



We do not want someone who simply makes a page look attractive.



We want someone who understands:



Why is this page here?

What should the visitor do next?

What information do they need?

Where could they drop off?

How can we make the next step clearer?



Landing Page Design



You will create high-quality landing pages designed around specific marketing and organizational objectives.



Landing pages should be:



* Visually compelling

* Brand-aligned

* Conversion-focused

* Easy to navigate

* Mobile responsive

* Clear and concise

* Strategically structured

* Built around strong calls to action



You should understand the relationship between:



Headline ? Value Proposition ? Supporting Content ? Trust ? CTA ? Conversion



You will work with the marketing and operations team to translate campaigns and initiatives into effective landing page experiences.



User Experience & Digital Experience



We are building an ecosystem, not a collection of disconnected pages.



You should be able to think about the experience from the user's perspective.



You will help us:



* Map user journeys

* Improve website navigation

* Simplify complicated processes

* Create intuitive forms and application experiences

* Improve calls to action

* Reduce unnecessary steps

* Create consistent experiences across brands

* Identify usability issues

* Improve conversion paths

* Create clear digital experiences for different audiences



Experience designing for education, nonprofits, coaching, memberships, programs, youth organizations, online learning, or purpose-driven organizations is highly valuable.



Brand & Visual Design



While website and funnel experience are the primary focus, strong visual design is an important part of this role.



You will create and maintain:



* Brand graphics

* Social media graphics

* Campaign graphics

* Presentation decks

* Workbooks

* Guides

* Lead magnets

* Digital downloads

* Event materials

* Promotional materials

* Course and program assets

* Website graphics

* Marketing collateral



You will help ensure that every digital touchpoint feels like part of the same organization.



You should have a strong eye for:



* Typography

* Spacing

* Layout

* Hierarchy

* Composition

* Color

* Brand consistency

* Visual storytelling



Digital Marketing Support



You will collaborate with our growth and operations team to translate marketing strategies into digital experiences.



This may include:



* Campaign landing pages

* Lead-generation campaigns

*
 campaign assets

* Event promotion

* Program launches

* Enrollment campaigns

* Social media assets

* Lead magnets

* Promotional graphics

* Funnel assets

* Conversion optimization

* Marketing automation support



You should understand that design exists to support a larger marketing objective.



Technical & Development Skills



This is not a traditional software engineering position, but you should be technically comfortable working with websites and digital platforms.



Required or Strongly Preferred:



* Strong website design and implementation experience

* GrowthHub365 experience, or strong GoHighLevel experience

* Responsive web design

* Landing page development

* Funnel building

* UX/UI principles

* HTML

* CSS

* Basic website troubleshooting

* Understanding of web structure and page hierarchy

* Familiarity with forms, tracking, integrations, and conversion flows



Nice to Have:



* JavaScript

* Custom CSS

* Custom HTML

* Basic JavaScript customization

* API/integration familiarity

* Figma

* WordPress

* SEO fundamentals

* Analytics and conversion tracking

* A/B testing

* Page speed optimization



You do not need to be a full-stack developer.



However, you should be technically confident enough to understand what is happening behind a website and make reasonable HTML/CSS/custom-code adjustments when needed.



GrowthHub365 Funnel & Automation Experience



Experience with the following is highly valuable:



* Funnels

* Forms

* Surveys

* Landing pages

* Pipelines

* Workflows

* Automated follow-up

*
 campaigns

* Appointment scheduling

* Lead capture

* Tags and segmentation

* Campaign triggers

* Conversion tracking

* CRM-connected experiences



You should understand how the front-end experience connects with the back-end system.



For example:



Ad / Social Post ? Landing Page ? Form ? CRM ? Automation ? Follow-Up ? Application / Enrollment



We want someone who can think about the whole system, not just the visual page.



Tools



Core Platform:



GrowthHub365



Design & Creative:



* Canva Pro

* Adobe Photoshop

* Adobe Illustrator

* Adobe Creative Cloud

* Figma



Web & Technical:



* HTML

* CSS

* Basic JavaScript

* Responsive design

* Web development fundamentals



AI & Productivity:



* ChatGPT

* Claude

* Gemini

* Other AI-assisted creative and productivity tools



Experience with additional marketing, CRM, website, automation, or design platforms is a plus.



Collaboration



You will work directly with our Chief Growth & Operations Steward and collaborate with leadership and other members of the creative, marketing, and operations teams.



You will help:



* Translate ideas into digital experiences

* Turn strategy into functional websites and funnels

* Organize digital assets

* Maintain brand consistency

* Improve existing systems

* Build reusable templates

* Document processes

* Troubleshoot implementation issues

* Recommend improvements

* Support marketing campaigns

* Maintain quality standards across the ecosystem



We value someone who can say:



"Here's what you asked for, here's what I built, and here's how I think we can make it better."



What Success Looks Like



Within your first 90 days, you will help us:



Website



* Design and launch major components of our GrowthHub365 website

* Establish a consistent website design system

* Build reusable page templates

* Improve mobile responsiveness and UX

* Establish clear website navigation and information architecture



Funnels



* Build and optimize landing page templates

* Develop lead-generation and application funnels

* Create reusable funnel structures

* Improve conversion pathways

* Connect front-end experiences with the appropriate GrowthHub365 workflows and processes



Brand



* Establish consistency across multiple brands

* Organize our digital brand asset library

* Develop reusable design templates

* Create high-quality marketing assets



Digital Ecosystem



* Help establish GrowthHub365 as a scalable digital foundation

* Improve the connection between websites, funnels, forms, campaigns, and automations

* Create repeatable systems for launching new digital experiences

* Help document website and funnel standards



The Person We're Looking For



You are someone who:



* Is genuinely passionate about website design

* Has strong visual design instincts

* Understands UX and conversion

* Can build, not just design

* Understands funnels and user journeys

* Is highly proficient with digital platforms

* Pays exceptional attention to detail

* Produces clean, modern, professional work

* Can work independently

* Takes ownership of projects

* Communicates clearly

* Welcomes feedback

* Learns quickly

* Is comfortable experimenting and troubleshooting

* Can balance creativity with functionality

* Thinks strategically about the user experience

* Understands that design should support a business or organizational objective

* Is excited about building something from the ground up



Most importantly, you should enjoy building digital experiences.



If you get excited about turning a blank page into a polished website, building a funnel from scratch, improving a user journey, solving a layout problem, or finding a better way to convert an idea into a working digital experience, you may be a great fit.



Required Application Materials



Please submit:



1. Resume

2. Portfolio

3. Three website examples

4. Three landing page examples

5. Three graphic design examples

6. Links to websites you have personally designed and/or built

7. Examples of funnels you have designed or built, if available



For each website or funnel example, briefly explain:



* What your role was

* What platform you used

* Whether you designed, built, or both

* What the primary objective was

* Any results or improvements, if available



Application Process



Our hiring process is designed to help us understand your experience, skills, work style, and overall fit for the role.



1. Apply Through the Job Post



Start by submitting your application through this job post on OnlineJobs.ph.



Please make sure your application includes all requested information and follows the application instructions provided.



2. Application Review



Our team will review your application, resume, portfolio, website examples, funnel examples, and other submitted materials.



Candidates whose experience and portfolio align with what we are looking for will be contacted for the next stage.



3. Initial Call & Interview



Selected candidates will be invited to an initial call and interview.



This will be an opportunity for us to learn more about your experience, discuss the role, review your portfolio, and answer any questions you may have about the position and our organization.



4. High5 Personality Assessment



Candidates who move forward in the process will be asked to complete a High5 personality assessment.



This helps us better understand your natural strengths, working style, and how you may fit within our team and the responsibilities of the role.



5. Final Candidate Selection



After the application, interview, portfolio review, and assessment process are completed, we will evaluate the candidates and make a final hiring decision.



6. Offer & Onboarding



Once a candidate has been selected, we will move forward with the offer and onboarding process.



Onboarding will include the necessary access, orientation, systems setup, expectations, workflows, and initial training needed to begin the role.



Important Timeline



Please note that the hiring process may take several weeks.



We are taking the time necessary to carefully review candidates and select the right person for this position. Completing an application or participating in an interview does not guarantee selection.



The position is expected to become available approximately two weeks after the hiring process begins, so the selected candidate should be prepared to begin onboarding around that timeframe, depending on the completion of the hiring and onboarding process.



We appreciate your patience throughout the process and encourage candidates to provide complete, accurate, and thoughtful information at each stage.



Application Questions:



Please answer the following questions in the provided application document:



1. GrowthHub365 / GoHighLevel



Have you personally built websites, landing pages, or funnels in GrowthHub365 or GoHighLevel?



If yes, describe what you built and your level of involvement.



If not, what comparable platforms have you used?



2. Website Design



Tell us about the most complex website you have personally designed and/or built.



What platform did you use, what was your role, and what made the project challenging?



3. Funnel Experience



Tell us about a funnel you have designed or built.



What was the user journey, what was the conversion goal, and what tools/platforms were involved?



4. Design Tools



Which Adobe applications do you use most frequently?



Please indicate your proficiency level with Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere Pro, After Effects, or other Adobe applications you use.



5. AI Workflow



Which AI tools do you currently use in your creative, website, marketing, or productivity workflow?



How do you use them?



6. Favorite Project



What is your favorite website, funnel, brand, or digital design project that you have worked on?



Why are you proud of it?



7. Problem Solving



Tell us about a website, design, or funnel problem you encountered and how you solved it.



8. Building From the Ground Up



What excites you about helping build a growing organization and digital ecosystem from the ground up?



9. GrowthHub365



If you joined our team and were asked to build a new website and funnel system inside GrowthHub365, how would you approach the project from strategy through launch?



Compensation:



Compensation may be reviewed based on experience, portfolio quality, technical proficiency, performance, and overall fit.



This is intended to be a long-term opportunity for the right person, with potential for increased responsibility and leadership as our digital ecosystem grows.



Important Note About This Position



This position is best suited for someone who can operate across website design, funnel development, UX, brand design, and digital marketing implementation.



We are not looking for a graphic designer who occasionally builds a webpage.



We are looking for a digital experience professional who can help us design, build, launch, and improve the websites and funnels that power our organization, primarily within GrowthHub365.



If you are highly proficient in website design, comfortable building funnels, understand conversion and UX, have strong visual design skills, and enjoy working inside an integrated digital ecosystem, we would love to see your work.
